shows.title: Loving Laughing: FINAL
shows.description: An annual showcase of the comedic talents of primary school children from across Leicester and Leicestershire! We have been working with young people to teach them the basics of comedy performance and sketch writing. In this showcase the participants will take to the stage to show off what they have learnt as we crown “Leicestershire’s Funniest School”.

shows.title: Beyond A Joke: Live Comedy AGM
shows.description: Join us for the second UK live comedy AGM. Your opportunity to meet others working in live comedy and learn more about the work of the Live Comedy Association and other organisations supporting the sector. We will also be publishing the report from the 2025 live comedy survey at the event. PWYW. All proceeds support the Stand Up And Give fund. Please note, this event is listed in our physical brochure as starting at 12.30pm, which has been updated to 2pm.

shows.title: The Howes Percival Comedy Club
shows.description: Law firm and festival business partner Howes Percival LLP present a night of comedy for their contacts and clients. Hosted by Festival Patron Eshaan Akbar (Mock the Week, Netflix, QI) and headlined by multi-award comedian Ian Smith (Live at the Apollo, Have I Got News For You), with performance from Jake Donaldson (BBC New Comedy Award finalist 2024) and Pun Champion Adele Cliff; it is sure to be another fantastic event. Private event, by invite only. Enquiries to gary.pitt@howespercival.com

shows.title: Andy Bucks: WIPping Boy
shows.description: A work-in-progress hour of stand-up nonsense from award winning nerd. There’ll be some older material about Laughing Cow cheese, some newer material that hasn’t been written yet, and a sing-a-long to a severely underrated 2000s girl group. How will this come together? Will the tech for the Pussycat Dolls section work? Is humanity redeemable? All will be decided in Leicester, a city located at the confluence of the M1/M69 motorways and the A6/A46 trunk routes. Winner of Leicester Square Theatre Sketch Off and Get Up Stand Up. “A classy writer, able to make a fantastic running joke” – Chortle

shows.title: Chloe Petts: Big Naturals
shows.description: Chloe Petts (Have I Got News for You, Live at the Apollo) returns to the stage following another sell-out run at the Edinburgh Fringe. In her new show, she’s taking a deep dive into her upbringing at the height of lad culture. From Page 3, to fronting a Christian rock band, to accidents on the golf course, join Petts for her most loutish hour yet. ★★★★★ “HILARIOUS… THIS IS CERTAINLY COMEDY THAT PACKS A PUNCH” The i ★★★★“ONE OF OUR MOST COMPELLING YOUNG COMICS” The Guardian ★★★★ “IT’S A HOOT WATCHING HER” Time Out ★★★★ “A ROCK SOLID HOUR” The Telegraph

shows.title: Daniel Sloss
shows.description: Don’t miss your chance to catch one of the biggest global names in live stand-up, as Scotland’s international comedy superstar Daniel Sloss unleashes his brilliant and devastatingly hilarious brand-new show “BITTER”. Daniel’s massive live tours span 55 countries (so far). He has been performing standup for more than half of his lifetime and has, in the process, broken multiple box office records to become one of the top ticket-selling comedians on the planet. BITTER is his 13th solo show. “Dirty, sweet and clever.” New York Times

shows.title: David Ingram: You Better WORK! (In Progress)
shows.description: Fresh from sell-out performances of his Edinburgh show ‘Carrot Top: Memoirs of a Gay’, “A deeply personal, hilarious and empowering journey” – The Scotsman, ‘Cutting, clever and dirty all at the same time’ – One4Review, retired twink and international flight attendant David Ingram brings a brand new Work in Progress to Leicester. Expect high energy, bold confessions and non-stop punchlines.

shows.title: Verity Sharpe: Landlord’s Wet Dream
shows.description: Verity Sharpe, comedian, poet, and “queer everywoman” crafts a humorous take on the realities of renting—damp walls, exploitative landlords, and the looming threat of eviction— that offers a silver lining of laughter to the dark cloud that is temporary housing. Landlord’s Wet Dream squares up to the wider issue of profit-driven housing, exposing it as a system which destroys communities and fosters instability. Come for the comedy, stay for the biting capitalist critique. Or, come for the biting capitalist critique but be warned… you will laugh. Hard.

shows.title: Freaks and Fools
shows.description: Welcome to Queerdom where people aren’t like other people. Nicky’s the circuit’s least masculine musical comedy man, trapped in the 1980’s where ‘Rentaghost’ is on the telly, the word ‘autistic’ hasn’t arrived in East Grinstead. Marigold’s viciously gentle. She’s silly, snarling and subversive. Join West End New Act of the Year finalists, Nicky Vere-Compton (“Unnerving charm” ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Neurodiverse Review) and Marigold Lately (“Brilliantly Bonkers” The Liverpudlian) ⭐⭐⭐⭐

shows.title: Proper Funny Comedy’s Festival Launch Party
shows.description: The “Proper Funny Launch Party” returns to kick the Leicester Comedy Festival off with a bang! As always the show includes sets from a wide-variety of acts, ranging from previous Festival Award Winners/Nominees to some of the very finest emerging acts. All of which is seamlessly held together by Leicester’s own Jay Neale (MC). The show has SOLD OUT for the last 10 years running so book your tickets early to avoid disappointment!

shows.title: Mad Ron presents Identity Theft
shows.description: A surreal gameshow where Uxbridges third hardest man and multi award winning Mad Ron tries to guide his comedy apprentice, as a glamorous game show host. “…keeps the onslaught of jokes coming, contributing to the rowdily fun atmosphere.” (Steve Bennett – Chortle) “The funniest most inventive nut bag show I think I’ve ever seen I love it love it love it!!” (Terry Alderton)

shows.title: Finn(egan): Death by Congas
shows.description: Finn (Finnegan to his mum): a renowned percussionist, but only because of his dancing. A really cool guy (according to his mum), yet never taken seriously as a musician… until now. You are cordially invited to the album launch of Conga Opus—Finn(egan)’s masterpiece (according to his mum). Or pretentious nonsense, if you believe the naysayers. A beautiful musical comedy, written and performed by multi-award-winning Paul Richards, about dignity, drums, and occasional disasters.

shows.title: Funny Women – The Glitter Project Mentoring Meetup
shows.description: Join Funny Women for a Mentoring Meetup as part of The Glitter Project – A Safe Place supported by funds raised from The Glitter Challenge. Enjoy some informal networking and receive first-hand advice from visiting experts. Funny Women develops new comedy talent at grassroots with Awards, workshops, courses and open mic events to build confidence in female and non-binary performers, writers and creators. The Glitter Project has been created as an enduring legacy with Jo Fletcher-Cross, a non-executive director of Funny Women and comedian. Unticketed event, no booking required.

shows.title: Rhys Harris-Clarke: Racecar
shows.description: Rhys is always late. The only time he has ever been early was when he was born. Now a 24 year old man trapped in the body of the perfect lesbian, Rhys is trying to navigate a life filled with endless potential alongside doing his car insurance or making sure the bins are out on a Tuesday. Real life isn’t quite ready for Rhys… or maybe its the other way round. Join him in an hour of self discovery that might just send you round the bend. RACECAR is Rhys’ debut at LCF, having worked his way up the comedy circuits of Manchester and London with nothing but a degree in Comedy Writing (yes it’s real)

shows.title: Jade Gebbie: The People Pleaser
shows.description: Jade Gebbie (writer for The News Quiz, The Now Show and more) has always been a people pleaser, but now that she’s hit her mid-thirties she’s delving into how it’s held her back, annoyed her loved ones and why overthinking fictional scenarios isn’t a reasonable excuse for missing a work meeting. Come along to this debut from Jade for fun, laughter and a bit of anxiety… after all, she is a millennial.

shows.title: A Bellyful of Laughs in aid of Charity Link
shows.description: Our Leicester Comedy Festival award-winning show is back! Chutney Ivy Fine Dining Indian Restaurant will treat you to a delicious banquet with starters, mains and sundries served in luxurious surroundings whilst you enjoy a dollop of fun with a range of comedians. You’ll also have a nice warm feeling knowing you’re helping local people and children to be warm, safe and fed. Price includes a delicious Indian meal and an evening of top-notch comedy. Proceeds raised on the night will support Charity Link’s vital work. Tickets limited so do book in advance.

shows.title: Game Over, Geek
shows.description: What happens when your childhood was built on cheat codes, controller cables, and awkward LAN parties—and adulthood didn’t come with a walkthrough? In his new stand-up show Game Over Geek, comedian Louis King dives headfirst into the pixelated past and the painfully relatable story of growing up geeky in the 90s.

shows.title: Ben Macpherson Does Poems at Adults
shows.description: Adults generally have ears. Ben Macpherson has poems. It’s time to put those two together with you in the driving seat. As the show starts, pick from 30 sets of vibes for what you want the show to be. You’re in complete control of the show, be that silly, sordid, sad or sweet. With poems covering everything from the world’s best cheese to the intimate lives of cartoon characters, Ben Macpherson has the poem for you. Blending friendly chat with style and genre, Ben is a verbal tour de force, bound to leave you laughing, crying and so much more. “Absolutely Delightful” – Hollie McNish

shows.title: Funny Women – Open Mic
shows.description: Funny Women’s ‘Open Mic’ showcase is part of The Glitter Project – A Safe Place supported by funds raised by The Glitter Challenge. Offering female & non-binary performers vital stage time, whether it’s a first gig or trying out new material. Hosted by The Glitter Project mentoring team, these warm, supportive, HERlarious gigs are part of a movement to break down barriers & redefine the comedy landscape. The Glitter Project has been created as an enduring legacy with Jo Fletcher-Cross, a non-executive director of Funny Women & comedian. To book a spot please email info@funnywomen.com.

shows.title: Paul Richards: Restless Monkey Chops
shows.description: Paul Richards wants to do everything: perform a new play, record the most exciting drumming album ever, learn some magic, attempt to speak Polish, host a quiz show, and walk a thousand steps—because his smartwatch keeps patronising him. It’s all on his to-do list. We have one hour. Come and watch a multi-award-winning, but incredibly restless, man on total overdrive. Can it be done?

shows.title: Raj Poojara: Work in Progress
shows.description: As seen on BBC’s New Comedy Awards, Raj’s work in progress explores what it’s like being a fair skinned Indian boy growing up in Britain… where does he fit in? Raj has been on tour with ‘The Indian’s Are Coming’ nationwide, and tour support for Jamali Maddix, Milton Jones, Laura Smyth, Josh Pugh, Aurie Styla and Dylan Moran.

shows.title: Simon Brodkin
shows.description: With his “electrifying crowd work” (Bruce Dessau), Simon is one of the most exciting stand-up comedians to see live. His recent 170-date international ‘Screwed Up’ tour was extended four times due to incredible demand, including three nights at London’s prestigious Hammersmith Apollo, and a headline-grabbing appearance on the Royal Variety Performance. Join him at his favourite Leicester Comedy Club in a WIP in The BLack Horse Laughter Loft

shows.title: Joseph Parsons: Lingo (Work in Progress)
shows.description: In his latest helping of exuberant stand up, Joseph Parsons is taking extreme measures to find love. He’s learning a language from scratch in just 6 months to see if he can achieve his dream – to be bilingual and in a relationship with someone foreign. The twist? The language wasn’t his choice, the audience from his last special has picked it (“one to watch” – The Times, BBC New Comedy Award – shortlisted, tour support for Zoe Lyons).

shows.title: Harry Jenkins: Baby Faced Killa’ (WIP)
shows.description: Rising star of the UK comedy scene, including. Tour support for Matt Richardson and Luisa Omielan. “Destined for the big leagues.” I Choose Birmingham “A genuine super talent that everyone will know before long.” – Laffalot.

shows.title: Ian Stone is Looking For The Wow
shows.description: Life can’t just be the humdrum, the mundane and the routine before the inevitable slide to disease, decay and death. Why can’t we sneak in a bit of awesome, a tad of amazing and maybe a smidge of wonderful? Some get their fix from the spiritual but I’ve been harbouring a grudge against God since my mother stopped me going to Arsenal after my Barmitzvah. Forty nine years ago. ’God will be watching’ she said. Well, at least he got to see the game. The point is, life could be so much better so I’m on the lookout. Come and join me on the hunt.

shows.title: Zayne Fulat: The Finished Article (WIP)
shows.description: Witness the chaos of Zayne, a unique comedian who specialises in mixing intelligent satirical commentary with goofy one-liners and non-sequiturs. If you’re used to watching an incredible comedian deliver an impeccably polished and refined hour of continuous comedy with no flaws whatsoever, this show will be a nice change of pace. Strap in for the wild ride and witness the evolution of a comedian like no other.

shows.title: Hasan Al-Habib: This Charming Man (Is Spreading Islamist Propaganda)
shows.description: Hasan’s (“Al-Habib will be famous” – Rolling Stone) debut, “Death to the West (Midlands)”, sold out its entire Edinburgh run and six extra dates. He returns with a brand new hour of “Islamist propaganda”, based on his love-hate relationship with The Smiths lead (he loves Morrissey, but Morrissey hates Muslims). Hear how an Islamophobic version of The Smith’s would sound, the various problems with Australia and about the time Abba played Baghdad. “Deliciously funny” Guardian. “Edgy and silly in exactly the right balance” Sara Pascoe. “A man of a thousand voices” – Rob Beckett.

shows.title: Bard Boys for Life
shows.description: Two half learned scholars (Ethan Formstone and Dan Coldbeck) wend their way through an epic yarn years in the making. Recanting the tale of a stranger in a strange land, trapped in a culture unwilling to accept him, Dan and Ethan intersperse jokes and James Joyce in a show dubbed by Ethan’s mum “Othello if Shakespeare was a mouth breather”.

shows.title: George Coppen: Won’t be long!
shows.description: George has been treading the boards of acting for some time now but how exactly did he get there and what else has he done during his life? Join George as he takes you through his life from early beginnings at school to working in an office then to starring in Panto (oh yes he does!) and how he lives day to day meeting and interacting with different types of people. You won’t believe what he’s seen and heard, let’s just say he’s not short on stories.

shows.title: Jake Donaldson: The Fifth Weezer
shows.description: Jake was born in the 90s, a teenager in the 2000s, and never really fit in. Turns out being into X-Men and the band Weezer didn’t win you much respect growing up in a North East ex-mining village. He only ever had one real dream but never followed it. Maybe all of this is why he’s ended up the way he is. Brand new stand-up comedy from BBC New Comedy Award 2024 finalist Jake Donaldson, packed with nostalgia, punchy jokes and stories about finding your place in the world. ‘Phenomenal’ ***** (edfringecomedy). ‘Truly brilliant humour’ **** (NorthWestEnd) ‘Excellent’ (British Comedy Guide)

shows.title: Mark Row: First Loser
shows.description: Brand new show from Mark Row. How do you cope when every time you’re about to cross the winning line, somehow, someone nudges in front of you? Endlessly snatching defeat from the jaws of victory, with the words ringing in your ears, ‘there’s no prize for second place,’ Mark Row is starting to wonder if he’ll ever be anything more than First Loser! ‘ Razor-sharp, totally original, and had the whole room howling from start to finish.’ – Chuckl

shows.title: Michael McKenzie: Bed 32
shows.description: We filled QMC hospital with hidden cameras and patient actors in our biggest prank yet. Come see the chaos that unfolded and join Michael McKenzie as he also tells some of the craziest stories from working as a one-legged NHS trainee doctor and his wildest tales of growing up in hospital himself as Bed 32 with award winning stand-up and comedy songs. Profits from the show go towards Bristol Children’s hospital where Michael grew up.

shows.title: Sid Singh: Return of the Singh
shows.description: Award Winning Comic & Terrible Lawyer Sid Singh returns with his riskiest show yet. The Center for Gender and Refugee Studies is returning to the US Supreme Court to fight the Trump administration. Sid wants to make you laugh so hard, you believe the fight is worth having! **** “Very, very funny!” The Scotsman ***** “Non-stop laughs, the highest quality comedy I’ve ever seen” Theatre Weekly, ***** “Hysterical… A natural comedian” Broadway Baby ***** “A master at the craft of comedy” Distractify ***** “Will make your jaw drop” theQR.co.uk ***** “Jon Stewart for This Generation” Madrid Con

shows.title: Dru Cripps: Juicy Bits
shows.description: Multi award-winning ‘sensational’ ★★★★★ (Time Out), clown Dru Cripps brings ad hoc and critically acclaimed Loopstation-based shenanigans to the festival, fresh from a sellout run at the Edinburgh Fringe. Improvised songs, spontaneous musings, and chaotic comedic “genius”, Cripps really has to be seen to be misunderstood. Winner of a Malcolm Hardee Award, a British Comedy Guide award, an Offie Award, and comedy competitions up and down the UK ★★★★★ ‘Laughing at everything and anything he said, in hysterics rolling in the aisles mesmerised by his comedic mastery’ (Three Weeks)

shows.title: Queer Comedy Chaos
shows.description: Play stupid games, win stupid prizes! Queer Comedy Chaos is a gameshow that hurls LGBTQ+ comedians and audience members into a tornado of absurd challenges, impossible quizzes, and wild games. Rules crumble, chaos reigns, and anything can happen. It’s messy, unpredictable, and gloriously unhinged—where surviving the madness is the only prize that matters! Hosted by one silly boy named Kie Carson, this show presents three comedians doing whacky challenges and improvising before battling against audience members for crazy prizes.

shows.title: Spontadeity: Improvised Mythological Mayhem!
shows.description: IMpRovised MyThological MaDness! A handpicked line-up of guest improvisers perform scenes, compete in games and challenges from audience suggestions – creating tragedies and epics on the spot, all with a mythological twist! But who will win the laurels?

shows.title: Propertyface2face Curry Club Comedy Lunch
shows.description: Comedy is on the menu at the Propertyface2face Curry Club lunch Propertyface2face, a networking group for Leicester’s property, construction and finance professionals, will be adding laughs to the menu when a comedian takes to the stage between courses. A hand-picked, up-and-coming comic will be joining our Leicester Propertyface2face Curry Club lunch on Friday 6th February 2026. Our guests will enjoy live stand-up comedy, quality networking and a tasty three-course Indian fine dining lunch at the award-winning MemSaab Restaurant, Leicester.

shows.title: Shaun Guff: Enuff is Enuff
shows.description: My name is Shaun Guff and I’ve hit rock bottom so you don’t have to. My sensational, self-funded seminar promises* to give you the metaphorical hammer to start nailing your life. (*No promises.) FRESH OFF HER EDFRINGE 2025 RUN! Join The Times Critics’ Choice Edinburgh Fringe 2021 Clementine Bogg-Hargroves as she transforms into Shaun Guff with her ‘Yorkshire-based robustness and sunny charm’ ★★★★ (Scotsman), in this very serious seminar. ‘Winning humour and infectious irreverence’ ★★★★ (TheStage.co.uk) ‘Infectious wit’ ★★★★ (List) ‘Nothing is perfect’ ★★★★★ (BroadwayBaby.com)

shows.title: Adam Flood: The Drop (WIP)
shows.description: Introducing, a death defying genre mashup: comedy and rave. This brand new show blends a traditional stand-up show (you’re sat, Adam is stood, he does jokes, you laugh), cut with his cult hit show “Late Night Comedy Rave” (comics performing live over big beats). The latter was nominated for Best Comedy Show at Newcastle Fringe in 2025, and his debut standup hour was just released on BBC Sounds. A new standup show hour, set in a nightclub, about an attempt to stay young and stupid. This is a seated gig, you may dance in your mind. Broadway World ★★★★ Ed Fringe Review ★★★★

shows.title: Horatio Gould: Work In Progress
shows.description: Join acclaimed comedian and hit podcaster Horatio Gould as he cooks up a brand-new hour of standup. As seen on Comedy Central Live (Comedy Central). Tour support for Frankie Boyle, co-host of hit podcasts Fin VS History and Boys Gone Wild and co-creator Fin vs The Internet (70 million views on Instagram, 2 million on YouTube). ‘Horatio Gould is unequivocally excellent’ **** (Skinny). ‘Horatio is the funniest, freshest act out there’ (Frankie Boyle). ***** (Mervyn Stutters Pick of the Fringe). **** (EdFestMag.com)

performances.mark: Not available Please contact the venue

shows.title: Phil Ellis: Bath Mat
shows.description: Multi-award winning ‘comic genius’ (The Scotsman) and the new star of Taskmaster (Ch4), Phil Ellis is going on his first full national stand-up tour. Following his three big award wins at the 2025 Edinburgh Fringe, Phil, the very definition of funny bones, presents his brand-new show ‘Bath Mat’. Jam-packed with laugh-out-loud profound silliness, superbly crafted gags and constant surprises, Phil is bringing his ‘Bath Mat’ to Leicester Comedy Festival. “Every moment he is on stage something funny, and then funnier, is happening.” ★★★★★ The Scotsman

shows.title: Ram Comedy Club: Stand-Up Showcase
shows.description: The Ram Comedy Club comes to the Leicester Comedy Festival! Join us for a mixed bill showcase where we have comedians doing 10 minutes each to give a flavour of what they’re about before you go and see their full shows! Watch some of our favourite upcoming local comedians in a show that will have something that matches your particular flavour! Featuring Stephen Catling, Kate Robb, George Coppen, James Beckett & hosted by the wonderful Alex Leam!

shows.title: Rosie Nicholls: Work in Progress
shows.description: Rosie Nicholls (Grubby Little Mitts, No Rolls Barred, Amused Moose Award Winner for Best Debut Sketch Show) is writing her debut solo comedy show, so you can all stop going on about it.. Expect sketches, characters, maybe a song, maybe a backwards man, maybe a Tunnocks Tea Cake. It’s a ride or die situation.

shows.title: The John Smith Show
shows.description: John Smith – Comedy Without Barriers “Unapologetic. Hilarious. Unmissable.” Winner of the Outstanding Achievements in Comedy and Dramatic Arts Award 2024. John Smith isn’t just telling jokes—he’s pushing boundaries and redefining comedy with fearless wit and unstoppable energy. Don’t miss this one-of-a-kind comedic force live on stage. A night of laughter you’ll never forget! Voice over by interpreter for hearing audience.

shows.title: Thor Stenhaug: One Night Stand Baby
shows.description: This is a show about love, life (drawings), and being not just a son to your parents – but more like a mutual friend. Straight from a sold out run at the Edinburgh Fringe, Thor Stenhaug brings his critically acclaimed debut hour on tour across the UK. Thor is a Norwegian comedian based in the UK. In a short period of time, he has built a big online following, headlined comedy clubs across the country and been shortlisted for British Comedian of the Year – despite not being British (wonder what happened there). ‘Norwegian comedy god of thunder has a storming debut’ ★★★★ (Scotsman)

shows.title: Kent Cameron: Larger than life (WIP)
shows.description: ​Kent Cameron is a cheeky scotsman with a knack for finding the funny side of life. His stories about what he’s been up to will have you seeing humor where others might see peril as he traverses fatherhood , gigantism diagnosis and moreJust be warned: some people have fainted in his shows- from laughing too hard or because they were queezy? Come and find out ” terrific material” – chris sparkle, one you’ll “rave about after the gig”- the comedy crate

shows.title: Menopausal Werewolf in Wigston
shows.description: From the team of comedians, writers and people with mental health conditions behind festival hits ‘Robots Vs Zombies’ and ‘Death in Dunton Gusset’ comes a suburban horror story of great magnitude. Also, there’s a raffle.

shows.title: Tez Ilyas: Work In Progress
shows.description: ★★★★ The Guardian ★★★★ The Times ★★★★ The Telegraph One of the most most celebrated stars in British comedy is back with his brand new work in progress hour. As seen on: Live at The Apollo (BBC Two), The Last Leg (C4), Mock the Week (BBC Two), Comedians Giving Lectures (Dave), Alan Davies: As Yet Untitled (Dave), Comic Relief’s Big Night In (BBC One), Live from the BBC (BBC Two), The Chris Ramsey Show (Comedy Central), Live from the Comedy Store (Comedy Central) ‘Radiantly entertaining’ – The Times -Presented by UTC Live

shows.title: Total Cosmisch: Supermarketism
shows.description: ‘SUPERMARKETISM!’ A rude awakening in the aisles. A musical comedy with cult religious leaders at the helm and German DJs on a mission to bring house and techno to Aldi and Tesco. Following successful runs at Brighton and Camden Fringe 2025, ’SUPERMARKETISM!’ is back with a trolley full of laughs. A dance music-themed comedy that ventures deep into the absurdities of the British supermarket. Fill your basket with songs and sketches about the mind-altering effects of certain cheeses, spaghetti mindfulness, and the dark reality of meal deals. Come and shop in the musical comedy aisle.

shows.title: Ria Lina: Riabellion
shows.description: Following her killer debut tour, Riawakening (Top Ten Best Stand-up Shows of 2024 – Telegraph), the wickedly funny Ria Lina realised she wasn’t just awake, she was ready to rebel. Expect a relentless stream of hilarity as Ria explores the state of the world, the eternal battle of the sexes, and the delight of throwing life up in the air after years of following the rules. Credits include Live At The Apollo, Have I Got News For You?, Mock the Week, cohosting Pointless, The Last Leg and Celebrity Mastermind.

shows.title: Alex Mitchell: Tough
shows.description: Alex Mitchell is on a mission to find out what it really takes to be a tough guy in modern Britain. He’s had a strange couple of years – being thrust into the limelight on mainstream telly, getting into a less than healthy relationship, being abused daily online, becoming disabled, and his best friend gave birth to a now three-foot bully. But, has Alex toughened up? The easy answer is no… but he’s trying. Britain’s Got Talent Finalist. ‘Accomplished and intelligent’ (NeurodiverseReview.co.uk). ‘A natural’ (Chortle.co.uk). ‘Absolutely sensational’ (Alesha Dixon).

shows.title: Gareth Mutch: Maybe Tomorrow
shows.description: ‘BEST SHOW’ nominee (ISH) Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2024 & 2025 The scottish rising star returns with a brand new show following his Edinburgh festival nomination. With his trademark self-deprecating humour, sharp observations and easy storytelling style, join this hotly-tipped master of stand-up as he shares his latest highs, lows and general life mis-steps. Revel in his awkward encounters, financial irresponsibility and many questionable decisions… Sensible can always wait! “Bulldozering skill” British Comedy Guide “Fantastic. A man who’s earned his stripes” Chortle.

shows.title: Harun Musho’d: A History Of The Last Conservative Government, In Their Own Stupid Words
shows.description: Harun Musho’d reads from the memoirs of David Cameron, Theresa May, Liz Truss, Matt Hancock and Boris Johnson. He fact checks them. You laugh. That’s the show. It’s the worst idea Harun has ever had, because researching the show meant reading the memoirs of David Cameron, Theresa May, Liz Truss, Matt Hancock and Boris Johnson. “If you get a chance to see this and miss it then you are a fool!”★★★★★ (Faversham Radio) “Funny, but it’s also something of a public service” ★★★★ (Lancaster Guardian) ‘Excellent Show’ (Fringe Review) ‘Smart.’ (The Scotsman)

shows.title: James Trickey: Don’t Count On Me
shows.description: James Trickey is throwing it all away. A hotly anticipated debut hour from award-winning new act and chartered accountant (but in a cool way) which explores what it means to risk everything. Expect to laugh, learn and crucially, laugh again. Best New Show nominee (Leicester Comedy Festival 2024) and Chortle Student runner-up. ★★★★ “An impressive level of performance” Fest ★★★★ “A very funny comedian” Beyond The Joke ★★★★ “Trickey’s command of the stage is absolute, his timing flawless.” The List “Trickey has certainly got it” The Guardian

shows.title: Silver Stand Up
shows.description: This unique evening showcases acts with quite a bit of life experience who are often underrepresented in lineups around the UK. “Anything that provides an antidote to all the young upstarts taking over the comedy scene has to be a good thing” Alexei Sayle. Hosted by Silver Stand Up 2024 winner Kevin Daniel and featuring Mark Silcox (Channel 4, BBC), local comedian Sarah Johnson aka Crafty Carol, Jim Judges aka Cutlery Safety Expert Ian Crawford, and more acts to be announced!

shows.title: What’s in the Box?
shows.description: The cult panel show is back! A yearly sell-out show, Friz Frizzle hosts the comedy panel show where audience members put their personal items in a box and games are invented on the spot! Expect a panel of comedians and celebrities as they attempt to tackle… WHAT’S IN THE BOX?! Fans of Taskmaster and Game Changer will love this chaotic panel show. A staple of the Edinburgh Fringe and Leicester Comedy Festival for the past seven years, WHAT’S IN THE BOX merges improv, comedians, boxes and comedians desperately bullsh*tting their way through to earn precious points. You’ll love it.

shows.title: Ed Mulvey: Pregnant Gollum
shows.description: But what is Ed pregnant with? Congratulations, its an hour of irrelevant social commentary and dick jokes, shortlisted for Best Newcomer at The Edinburgh Fringe. Described as “an original thinker… bleakly funny” (Chortle) and a “first-rate joke writer” (The Scotsman), Ed will delight and upset with an evening of tummy-thumpingly good stand-up. Next wave feminist nerd comedy from the Elon Musk of emotions.

shows.title: Elliot Wengler: Jokémon
shows.description: Elliot Wengler presents his spectacular and personal history of the world’s biggest monster-fighting franchise. Finally, after years of failing to become a Pokémon Master, he has decided to become a Jokémon Master! With jokes for all 150 of them! In a show bristling with costumes and utter chaos, this is THE show. The one where Elliot Wengler will need go on the journey of a lifetime. Malcolm Hardee Comic Originality Award-Nominated 2024. ‘‘Nice ideas, likeable performer.’ – Broadway Baby ‘a real treat; truly funny stories’ – Concrete

shows.title: John Robertson’s The Dark Room
shows.description: Come play the legendary Fringe game show! You’re trapped in a retro video game with a sadistic boss. Escape and win £1000 or be brutally murdered by the audience! Will you: A) Find the light switch? B) Go north? C) Abandon hope? New deathtraps for 2026! ‘A Rocky Horror for nerds… I howled’ **** (Telegraph). Sold out: 2019 – 2024. Winner: Chortle Award. Viral on TikTok @RobbotronTwitch and Instagram @Mr_Dark_Room. As seen at Glastonbury, PAX, Download and MCM Comic Con. Nominated: Best Comedy (FringeWorld.com.au), Best International Act (New Zealand Comedy Festival).

shows.title: All-New Nik Coppin
shows.description: The globetrotting comedian brings a hilarious show consisting of jovial banter along with fun, interesting & inventive new material and invites the audience to judge how good or bad it is. “Fast and funny…The audience loved it…Sweetly, wildly hilarious” ★★★★ Rip It Up, Adelaide Fringe “Fun and amazing” ★★★★ Melbourne International Comedy Festival “He talks at 100mph and generates an irresistible atmosphere of good old-fashioned fun” – Chortle.co.uk, Edinburgh Fringe

shows.title: Dan Tiernan: All In
shows.description: Following a third consecutive sell-out, award-nominated run at the Edinburgh Fringe, Dan Tiernan is back on tour and he’s giving you everything he’s got. No bluffing. All In is a blistering hour of stand-up from one of the most exciting voices in comedy. Expect explosive energy, razor-sharp punchlines, and tightly-packed gags about a man on the brink. As seen on Live at the Apollo, 8 out of 10 Cats Does Countdown, The Last Leg, QI, Just for Laughs, New Faces and Mitchell and Webb Are Not Helping. “Comedy with a big payoff, his best show yet” ★★★★ The Guardian

shows.title: Jake Steers
shows.description: An unhinged hour of story telling with controlled chaotic energy. Come if you want to see a man lose their mind doing a work in progress.

shows.title: Hasan Al-Habib: Death to the West (Midlands)
shows.description: Nominee: 2025 Leicester Comedy Festival Awards Best Debut Show Sold Out Show: 2025 Edinburgh Fringe Festival ‘Deliciously funny’ (Guardian), Al-Habib’s parents left Baghdad for the land of opportunity (southern Birmingham). But when Britain invaded Iraq, many saw him as the enemy within. A show about why Saddam Hussein would have loved Drayton Manor and – amidst a search for those pesky weapons of mass destruction – finding self-acceptance. Funniest Jokes of Edinburgh Fringe 2025 (Times and Telegraph) “Material for Live at the Apollo” (Scotsman) Directed by Jet Vevers.

shows.title: Jon Pearson: NOW What have you been up to?
shows.description: Jon is back with a new improvised show, finding out what you have been up to again! Multiple award winning, master of crowd work, no two shows are the same! Jon has also been learning some new skills! Please note, this show is incorrectly listed as starting at 6pm in our physical brochure.

shows.title: Kate Robb: Doghouse
shows.description: Tales of dogs, marital relations, kids & competitive mums through the eyes of an exasperated survivor. “A superbly written show delivered masterfully by one of stand-ups most promising new talents” Ram Comedy Festival. “My face hurt from laughing by the end” “Proper belly laughing from start to finish!” “Awesome – one to watch in my opinion, clever writing with a naughty edge at times – great performer too.” “Such a clever performer and so, so funny” Funny Women Awards semi-finalist 2023. “Talented & going places” Notts Comedy Review. “A star in the making” Den of Laughs.

shows.title: Late Night Comedy Rave
shows.description: Big beats and stand-up comedy join forces for the ultimate festival experience. Adam Flood brings an experimental mix of electronic music and live comedy to Leicester Comedy Festival on the back of growing cult hype and sell out shows. Think Boiler Room does stand-up. Original beats to get you moving, cut with jokes and stand-up. “An underground smash at the Edinburgh Fringe” – The Skinny Best Comedy Show Nominee Newcastle Fringe 2025.

shows.title: Patrick Spicer: Work In Progress
shows.description: Fresh off a sold-out European tour across 13 countries, Patrick Spicer returns to where the last tour and walkers crisps started: Leicester. Expect half-formed ideas, crowd chaos and the first shimmering sparks of comedic immortality As seen on BBC One, Channel 4, and BBC iPlayer. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ “Comedy masterclass” – Mumble Comedy ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ “Natural… Not a flicker of hesitation” – The Skinny ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ “Well thought out and very funny” – Broadway Baby

shows.title: Trash Fic: Creating Fan Fiction For Fun & Profit & Fun
shows.description: Have you ever wondered what it takes to create the perfect fan fiction? No? Too bad! Trash Fic’s gonna show you how anyway! Let your hosts, LP Mills and Ellie James Sharpe guide you through the unlikely romances, terrible grammar, and powerful sensuality required to create the ultimate Trash Fic! Featuring – Musical interludes – Exciting new words for genitalia – Semi-colons in places they simply shouldn’t be ★★★★ – “a B… no, a Z tier movie come to life.” – LeftLion Magazine Warning! *may contain nude Sonic The Hedgehog*

shows.title: Burger and a Pint: WIP
shows.description: The 2024 Sketch-Off Winners, James Trickey (Leicester Comedy Festival Best New Show Nominee) and Ted Milligan (Leicester Comedy Festival Attendee) present a work-in-progress sketch show. “Old fashioned sketching… so quick and funny” CHORTLE “Fast-paced humour with a bit of youthful charm” BEYOND THE JOKE “Joyously Stupid” MORNING STAR “Genius sketches” LONGSTAFF REVIEWS

shows.title: Creative Chaos Comedy Club’s Big Festival Showcase
shows.description: Join us as we celebrate our opening weekend of the festival with a cavalcade of incredible talent! A lineup that celebrates the variety of comedians at the festival and is designed to give you a taste of the excitement to come throughout the rest of the festival. Let the fun begin!

shows.title: Jacob Hatton: You Can’t Quit Me! I fire.
shows.description: Now listen here sonny, I’ve walked away from everything you can get out of. I’ve quit, sacked off, abandoned. I’ve ghosted. I’ve vanished. But there’s one thing I’ll never abandon. You. A stand-up show about things that are worth sticking to. And that thing, is all of you. “Proper gags. Hatton’s a strong comedy technician.” Chortle “Brilliant British humour” Ed Fringe Review **** Nominated Best Newcomer, Hastings Fringe 2022

shows.title: Iain MacDonald: Around the World in 80 puns
shows.description: Glaswegian comedian and author Iain MacDonald embraces the international aspect of the festival as he takes you on a pun-venture around the world in which he has a joke for each and every country. You tell him the country – he’ll tell you the joke! And with the aid of his giant map and mini globes for the audience, there’ll be plenty of opportunities to try and catch him out! ‘Scotland’s Prince of Puns‘ (BBC Radio Scotland).

shows.title: Maddie HW: Gaylord
shows.description: GAYLORD is the electric UK debut from award-winning Australian comedian Maddie HW, fresh off sold-out tours across Australia and rapidly making her mark on the London comedy circuit. Known for her high-octane energy and inventive style, Maddie blends stand-up and physical comedy into a fast-paced hour about moving countries, navigating relationships, and making fun of those silly British accents (sorry). Described as “charming and vivacious” (Festmag) , Maddie takes the everyday and flips it into something surreal, bold, and hilarious.

shows.title: Naked Comedy
shows.description: Naked Comedy is back! One of the most talked-about Leicester Comedy Festival shows of all-time returns. It really is what it says on the tin…Watch a mixed-bill of stand-up comedians perform totally naked to raise money for charity in this no-holds-barred show. Advance tickets only – no door sales. Not for the faint hearted. Hosted by local nuisances Alex Hylton and Jay Neale.

shows.title: 199 Jokes Before Lunchtime: Danny Matinee
shows.description: An insect joke? Tick. A tartan joke? Check. Join Danny Matinee at his sold-out Edinburgh show for at least another 197 one-liners, props, pictures, facts & more. As seen in The Times & Telegraph’s Best Jokes of the Fringe 2024 & 2025. “***** Finely crafted…slick wordplay…near-faultless timing” Edinburgh Reporter. “***** A brilliant way to set up your day” UK Theatre Web. Suitable for all ages, especially fans of Olaf Falafel, Milton Jones & Tim Vine. Includes a farmer joke that’s corny & an optician joke that’s cornea. Please note this show is listed as High Whisk in our brochure.

shows.title: Steve Bugeja: Work In Progress
shows.description: Steve Bugeja (co-creator of ITV2’s Buffering, star of Comedy Central, writer for Love Island USA, tour support for Iain Stirling) brings a brand new work-in-progress show packed with sharp jokes, awkward stories, and trademark warmth. Expect embarrassing confessions, big laughs, and a glimpse into his next stand-up special before anyone else. “punchlines come thick and fast… he makes the art of stand-up comedy look effortless” Edinburgh Festivals Magazine ‘drum-tight, as if polished by a sitcom writers’ room to cram as many jokes in as humanly possible’- Chortle

shows.title: Andrew White: What a Life (WIP)
shows.description: An only-child with two siblings, Andrew White enjoyed a precocious childhood befriending retirees and penning selfindulgent poetry, until a literal circus clown warned him of imminent death on his 18th birthday. All the Jester foretold came to pass, and now Andrew must reflect on life without three close loved ones and do his best to honour their memories. Don’t miss this hilarious, honest and heartwarming new stand-up comedy show. **** “A plethora of memorable gags” (Chortle) “Very exciting & very funny” (Joe Lycett) Tour Support for Catherine Bohart, Kiri Pritchard-McLean & Jason Manford

shows.title: Comics vs Kids
shows.description: Comics vs Kids returns with a show full of jokes, silliness, interaction and special guests. Have a laugh with the jovial, affable host and a selection of comedians and maybe win some prizes in a quest to find out who is funnier and smarter, comedians or kids! An awesome time will be had by all. ‘An absolute joy of a show, enjoyed by the entire room’ ***** (LagoonFest, Brighton & Hove). ‘Fast and funny… the audience loved it… sweetly, wildly hilarious’ **** (Rip It Up).

shows.title: Josh Weller: Work In Progress
shows.description: Josh Weller is one the funniest, most inventive stand-up comedians in the country. His observational and self-deprecating humour has had hundreds of millions of views online. You might have seen him in The Witcher (where he dies) or A Gentleman in Moscow (where he also dies). Come watch him work on his new show. “A comic genius covered in 25 years of stupid” ALEX EDELMAN “Endlessly inventive. His combination of music and humor make it an absolute joy to watch him perform. It’s like hanging out with a brilliant, funny friend.” Broadway World ★★★★★ The List ★★★★ Chortle

shows.title: Extinct Objects
shows.description: Extinct Objects is an interactive performance for children that connects seemingly distant worlds: the extinction of dinosaurs, the emergence of plastic, and the disappearance of everyday objects we once loved. Through playful use of devices such as an overhead projector, slide projector, and cassette player, objects once common but now forgotten, the audience enters a space of memory, imagination, and new possibilities. These “extinct” objects become characters and accomplices in the game.

shows.title: Joke Spot @ Highfields Library
shows.description: Roll up! Roll up! Joke Spot makes you the star as we invite anyone under the age of 18 to take the mic and become a comedian. Our pop-up stage will be touring Leicester throughout the festival and it’s up to you to drop-in and tell us your best jokes. More venues may be announced throughout the festival, so keep an eye on our socials @kidscomedyfest or our website!

shows.title: Freya Parker: An Hour Of Decay! WIP
shows.description: Come and decay with Freya as she commits to the ageing process for x1 hour only! Lot’s of funny / sad / weirdish material about the unstoppable march of TIME from one of the shortest comics in the biz. You might know her from her total sell-out Fringe debut or the critically acclaimed double act Lazy Susan but maybe you just seen her in a Pret. As seen in Deep Cover (Amazon), The Mash Report (BBC Two), Jurassic World Dominion and Wonka. Edinburgh Comedy Award Nominee. “Outrageous and irreverent” ★★★★ The Guardian

shows.title: Jonny Awsum and his Award Winning Kids Show
shows.description: Get ready for big laughs and catchy tunes as “Jonny Awsum and His Award-Winning Kids Show” hits the Leicester Comedy Festival! As seen on Britain’s Got Talent, Jonny brings his feel-good musical comedy to the stage with songs like “This is a Musical” and “The Triangle Song”. Perfect for ages 5 to 105, this hilarious, high-energy show ends with a meet and greet and photo op with Jonny. A fun, interactive experience the whole family will love! Winner of Best Kids Show at Leicester Comedy Festival 2021.

shows.title: Juliette Burton: Sexy Nerdy Work In Progress
shows.description: As the sun sets, a new hero awakens. Calling all late-night legends, dungeon-crawling romantics, and big-hearted heroes! Juliette Burton is summoning YOU. This after-dark work in progress comedy confessional steps into the dark side. A brand new, adult comedy quest for grown-up geeks and justice-hungry joy seekers ready to battle the REAL dragons: sexism, queer inequality and bad sex lives. It’s time to iron out the kinks! Expect deep comic book lore, dark jokes and emotionally naked comedy. Live nerdgasms possible.

shows.title: Abi & Joseph’s Musical Mischief Show
shows.description: Join comedians Abi Carter-Simpson (Britain’s Got Talent Semi Finalist) and Joseph Emslie (Runner Up Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year) for a kids’ comedy show that’s fun for all the family! A 60 minute musical bonanza of songs, silliness and lots of laughs! “True star quality” – Simon Cowell | “Definitely a name to keep tabs on.” Bruce Dessau, The Evening Standard.

shows.title: Catherine Bohart: Work In Progress
shows.description: Catherine Bohart – as seen on Live at the Apollo, QI and LOL Ireland is back with a new show. Well, the beginnings of a new show. Well, she’s certainly thinking about beginning a new show. Certainly she’s certain she should be. Come watch this Edinburgh Comedy Award Nominee humble herself before you while she tries new jokes as you give her real time feedback.

shows.title: Four Monarchs and a Mic: The BBC’s Royal Engineer
shows.description: BBC comedy writer (Miranda, Not Going Out) + radio historian Paul Kerensa’s new show about old broadcasts: a fun, fascinating sequel to An Evening of Very Old Radio. Be informed, educated and entertained about the man who brought the mic to four monarchs: from George V to Elizabeth II via D-Day speeches, drunken broadcasts and a surprise abdication. Plus how the Palace lost the first BBC recording… and what Paul’s doing to find it. Recorded for The British Broadcasting Century Podcast – bring questions and curiosity! “So fascinating, entertaining and amusing, loved every minute” – Audient

shows.title: Micky Overman: Work In Progress
shows.description: A brand-new work-in-progress show from Dutch stand-up and sketch comedian Micky Overman. With 50M+ views online, she burst onto the UK scene in 2016 as a Funny Women and Leicester Square finalist, later receiving a Chortle Best Newcomer nomination. Her acclaimed Edinburgh Fringe shows include Role Model, Small Deaths, The Precipice, and Hold On, which toured to sold-out shows across the UK and Europe, including Amsterdam’s Royal Theatre Carré. She’s also written and performed for ITV2, Channel 4, BBC Three, and co-hosts the podcast Thank F** For That.

shows.title: Pauline Eyre: Anyone For Tennis
shows.description: A Wimbledon line judge for 20 years, comedian Pauline Eyre is ready to spill the Pimms on tennis gossip from the fragrant royal box to the musty locker room, and why line judges are OUT! Expect smashing stories, ace anecdotes and a 40 -love letter to the game. And there’s nobody to say ‘quiet please’. She cannot be serious … can she? Fresh from sold – out run at Edinburgh Fringe 2025.

shows.title: Sisters Karazmatik and Friends: Improv Show
shows.description: If you like your improv sassy and sharp, and just a little outré, then join the Sisters Karazmatik and friends for an hour of fresh and exciting improv. The show will be a series of totally improvised sketches, inspired entirely from audience suggestions. A perfect introduction for newcomers to improv, as well as a fabulous show for those with more… discerning tastes. Performing for the fifth year running at the festival; audiences have loved this fabulously fresh, funny & genuinely heart warming show.

shows.title: The Laurel & Hardy Cabaret
shows.description: Lucky Dog Theatre Productions are generally regarded as being the best Laurel and Hardy re-enactors in the world, winning awards and playing to full houses and standing ovations in the UK and America, Ireland, Germany and the Czech Republic since 2013. ‘The Laurel & Hardy Cabaret’ is a family-friendly package of routines, songs and dances from The Boys’ 30-year career. Featuring some classic sequences, along with much rarer material (some of it new and updated for 2026) – you will be transported back to a more innocent time, yet still be amazed at how current their comedy remains.

shows.title: Jake Patrick Work in Progress
shows.description: Jake Patrick is trying hard, having multivitamins and doing a work in progress. Jake is a stand-up comedian and writer from Liverpool, now based in London. Instantly recognisable for his distinct voice, off-beat storytelling, and intuitive crowd work. Jake is establishing himself as a regular act and MC at comedy clubs like The Bill Murray, Top Secret Comedy Club and the Comedy Store. His sketches and online videos have been viewed over a million times. Jake was recently shortlisted for the BBC New Comedy Awards and named ‘one to watch’ by The Guardian.

shows.title: Canny Funny Improv Comedy
shows.description: Canny Funny return for a 3rd Year . Expect fast paced sketches, scenes and songs from this talented bunch of improvisers who will quickly turn your suggestions into comedy gold . Jen Kenny and Dave Gotheridge, along with their many talented friends, will create a joyful experience that is certain to be a highlight of your festival. Don’t miss out on the team dubbed “Better than mushrooms!” on the first viewing. A brilliant, intelligent improv team with unique talents and genuine warmth.” “ Incredible skill . I don’t know how they do it. ”

shows.title: Andy Gilbert Makes Poetry Great Again
shows.description: The UK’s #1 Poetry Teacher, and the poetry haters favourite poet, sets out on a mission to restore poetry to its glory days. The days of the ‘Great Romantics’ when the air was filled with love and rhyme. These lectures are a popular way to start a day at the LCF, so book your place early. Contains strong language and contextual vulgarity.

shows.title: Daniel McKeon: Wife Guy Reloaded (WIP)
shows.description: Daniel McKeon is the last living wife guy. Despite rumours and hearsay, he’s returned for one last job: proving that not every man hates their wife. But the modern world is no picnic. Fighting through spousal visa applications, haunted by Nicolas Cage, all while eating too much cake at 30th birthday parties, it’s going to take everything Daniel has to be the husband that he needs to be. The first follow-up hour since his “charming and confident debut” (A Young-Ish Perspective), Daniel McKeon brings all new jokes, observations and stories to see if he can make them work-in-progress.

shows.title: Max Fulham: Work in Progress
shows.description: Following his sold out debut Edinburgh Fringe show, Max Fulham is putting together some fresh nonsense. Described as “exceptionally talented” by Rowan Atkinson, and with millions of views online, join Max as he tries out brand new ideas. Expect sketches, standup-up and silliness from “the most skilful ventriloquist of his time” (North West End). “A show so good it honestly turned me from an unbeliever into a ventriloquist fan.” – ThreeWeeks “Fulham is a breath of fresh air. He’s original, charming, genuinely funny, clever and knows a good gag from 100 yards.” – The Wee Review

shows.title: Ryan Mold: Resistant
shows.description: A new work-in-progress show diving into the chaos of modern life. Ryan explores why he resists change even when the world won’t stop spinning. ‘Absolutely brilliant’ – Nick Helm ‘full of very funny and original jokes, a laugh-a-minute’ – London Theatre ‘Keeps a room onside being laugh-out-loud funny. He’s a classic British comedian’ – theQR.co.uk

shows.title: Angst & Angstability (WIP)
shows.description: Award-winning musical comedian JoJo Maberly (BBC Three, BBC Radio 4) grew up in the sticks. So she became obsessed with sticks, and then, naturally, she became obsessed with Ewan McGregor. In this innocently unhinged show, JoJo takes us through the multiple obsessions she has conquered and surrendered to during her ignominiously angsty years in rural England. With ‘witty and unexpected’ (Chortle) songs on her guitar, and what can only be described as tortured wails through her loop pedal, JoJo crafts crude jokes ‘while somehow maintaining an endearing innocence’ (FunnyWomen).

shows.title: Jordan Brookes: Until The Wheels Come Off (WIP)
shows.description: The longest reigning comedy award winner is back with a show in development, inspired by a shocking incident on a train. Early praise for the show: ‘A special show’ ★★★★★ Bruce Dessau ‘Delivered with a freshness and forensic wit’ ★★★★★ RGM ‘His WIP could very easily be another comedian’s finished show’ LMAOnaise

shows.title: Pirates, Pharaohs and Pterosaurs: Time Travel tales with Iszi Lawrence
shows.description: Join BBC broadcaster, comedian, and Bloomsbury author Iszi Lawrence for a hilarious journey through history! From where pirates poo to how ancient Egyptians thought, Iszi will prepare you to time travel anywhere in history. From how to crash a spitfire, to how to stop yourself being swallowed by a pterosaur. Iszi has worked for the British Museum, The BBC and even has a popular dinosaur podcast Terrible Lizards! Fun for everyone, not just fans of The Time Machine Next Door series… we may even meet Richard III!

shows.title: Hats Off To Laurel and Hardy
shows.description: Stan Laurel and Oliver Hardy were the pioneers of modern comedy and their movies have delighted generation after generation for a century. ‘Hats Off To Laurel And Hardy’ is the award-winning true story that has toured extensively since 2013. It will guide you through their early lives, their rise to international stardom and their revival on the stages of Europe. It details their commitment to their work, the appreciation of their fans, the love of their wives and – most enduringly – their unerring devotion to each other. Prepare to laugh your socks off before finally having your heart broken.

shows.title: Mary O’Connell: Breadwinner
shows.description: Mary’s life is falling apart, she’s just found out that her boyfriend (THAT SHE LIVES WITH AND FINANCIALLY SUPPORTS) has cheated on her. This catastrophic event happens just a couple weeks before Christmas, New Years and HER 30TH BIRTHDAY. After kicking the scumbag to the curb, she’s faced with her biggest challenge, how to become hotter than ever. A show about revenge, forgiveness, love and what you do when you hit rock bottom Third stand up hour from award winning comedian Mary O’Connell Astonishingly polished – Fest Magazine One of the most relatable shows of the fringe – The Telegraph

shows.title: Punchline Bingo
shows.description: Four top comedians try to beat the punchlines in this comedy gameshow. But, you can win prizes too by playing the comedy bingo! All you need to do is cross the words off your card as the comics say them to win prizes! It’s Bingo – but comical. WINNER BEST PANEL SHOW- Late Stage Comedy at Leicester Comedy Festival 2024 Sold out Leicester shows 2025 Sold out shows Edinburgh Fringe 2024 & 2025

shows.title: Olga Koch: Work In Progress
shows.description: Comedian Olga Koch is going to tell you a scary story over the course of an hour. The story is a work in progress. Proceed with caution. ★★★★ – The Guardian ★★★★ – The Observer ★★★★★ – The Telegraph ★★★★ – Chortle ★★★★ – The Scotsman

shows.title: Alex Camp: Six Addictions
shows.description: The Best Variety Show 2024 nominee returns with a searingly honest yet offbeat look at addictions, both big and small. Stampede through booze, sex, mental health and a whole lot more while strapped to the vessel of Alex’s trademark songs; learn why biscuits and drugs are basically the same and what it all has to do with rats. This show has it all; great stand up, catchy songs and a guide to open relationships. No parody songs and no ukuleles, guaranteed.

shows.title: Katie and Ben Travel Through Time and Try Not to Destroy the Universe
shows.description: Join Katie and Ben as they travel through time to retrieve missing artifacts that have mysteriously disappeared from their historical lost property office. Who has been stealing them, what do they want them for and can our heroes find out before time runs out? These stalwart Comedy Club 4 Kids performers are coming together for the first time to create a unique, daft and original historical rumpus for kids. Come be part of the fun! “‘Perfect… the audience were hysterical.” (Huffington Post) “Will have you shaking with laughter.” (BroadwayWorld)

shows.title: Loremen Live
shows.description: Alasdair Beckett-King and James Shakeshaft return to the Leicester Comedy Festival with locally-sourced legends, historical oddities and nuggets of obscure folklore. Join us for a live podcast recording and none of that mainstream Richard III stuff. Rated 4.9/5 on Apple Podcasts.

shows.title: Sign My Yearbook: a stand-up show
shows.description: Get voted ‘most likely to laugh’ in a split-bill stand-up show featuring two of the London circuit’s most promising rising stars. Cheryl Hurst and Callum Mackenzie, the prom queen and the class clown, present an hour of sharp-witted, non-stop, feel-good comedy that answers all of life’s most important questions, from ‘What’s the perfect slogan for a pair of pants?’ to ‘Can you learn open heart surgery from a book?’

shows.title: Absolute Bus Stops of Northern Europe and Beyond
shows.description: You’ve been there. We’ve all been there. Waiting. At last, the wait is over. Climb aboard for a multimedia-info-travelogue-laugh-a-long show celebrating the previously uncelebrated beauty of bus stops and the colourful characters we meet along the way. From the bleak chic of a layby on the A47 at Bushby to the sun-drenched beauty of a chrome and glass Swedish super-shelter at Getgubben Båstad. WARNING: Jokes may take ages to arrive, and there could be some bumps in the road. Performed by comedian Jimmy Judges (aka Cutlery Safety Expert Ian Crawford) **** ‘Forkin’ Good’ (The Wee Review)

shows.title: CSI: Crime Scene Improvisation
shows.description: Mirth meets murder in the world’s daftest comedy whodunnit! CSI returns to Leicester with the rip-roaring comedy murder mystery made up entirely on the spot. Winners of the 2023 Leicester Comedy Award for Best Improv Show. When CSI: Crime Scene Improvisation takes to the stage, no one knows who the killer is – not even the cast! ★★★★★ “Quick thinking & fast paced. A spectacular must see.” – Bunbury Magazine

shows.title: MJ Hibbett: Data and Doctor Doom
shows.description: Indie legend MJ Hibbett – the world’s leading (and only) academic expert on Doctor Doom – presents a musical adaptation of his PhD thesis on Marvel’s next big baddie (yes, that makes him a Doctor of Doctor Doom). He’ll use songs, slides, jokes and a unified catalogue of transmedia character components to explain how all fictional characters can be understood with stats, why on earth you’d want to do that, and, most importantly of all, why Doctor Doom is better than Batman.

shows.title: The Hypnotist Live: Comedy Hypnosis Show
shows.description: Join one of the UK’s top stage hypnotists and mind readers – direct from London’s West End… Prepare for an evening of amazement & laughter as Daniel Sinclair unlocks volunteers’ imaginations and alters their realities – all through the power of hypnosis. Buckle up tight. SEE the show or BE in the show! Blending truly jaw-dropping moments, comedy and music, Daniel takes you on a rollercoaster ride of your minds – leaving you questioning your own realities while laughing out. “The next Derren Brown” (Phoenix Arts) Age guidance: 12+ | volunteers 18+ (can stop participating at any time)

shows.title: Comedy in the Dark for Kids
shows.description: A family-friendly version of this unique comedy experience . At Comedy in the Dark, the audience’s senses are heightened and the performers are forced to utilise entirely new skills as the gig is performed in the pitch black. Things look and sound very different in the dark. Joining us on stage this year: Edy Hurst (“Bursts with comedy joy” The Skinny ; “Absolutely non-stop bonkers” British Comedy Guide) Jonny Awsum (Britain Got Talent, LCF Best Kids’ Show) Rachel Baker & Danny Roberts (Sketch Off & Funny Women finalist) Katie Pritchard (Stand Up 2 Cancer, Harry Hill’s Clubnite, Channel 4)

shows.title: Finlay & Joe: Pretend It’s Fine
shows.description: Finlay & Joe are fine. Society isn’t collapsing, sketch comedy is more financially lucrative than ever, and you *definitely* cannot smell burning. Hot off the heels of a successful run at the 2025 Edinburgh Fringe, Finlay & Joe present their brand new hour of sketch comedy – Pretend It’s Fine. Expect wildly imaginative comedy sketches from these two future national treasures who will not stop until they are knighted for services to live entertainment. Although not Finlay. He probably wouldn’t accept a knighthood. He’s afraid of swords. Maybe a Blue Peter badge?

shows.title: John & Christian: Teenage Heartthrobs
shows.description: “Give me a time, give me a venue, I know what I’m having when Love’s On The Menu” Move over Oasis: It’s the reunion gig of your favourite 00s boyband that definitely existed – The Teenage Heartthrobs. Hear the scandalous, moving, and at times erotic story of the band’s rollercoaster journey from rags to riches and back to rags. Featuring the hits ‘Ooo Girl’, ‘Monday Morning’, and many more. Hilarious musical comedy from John and Christian, the BBC-featured, Leicester Square Sketch-Off 2025 semi-finalists. “Hilarious” **** – VoiceMag “Flight of the Conchords meets Busted” – Jake Baker

shows.title: Joseph Emslie: Splish Splash (Work-In-Progress)
shows.description: Joseph Emslie – ‘definitely a name to keep tabs on’ (Evening Standard) – answers the question: what do you do when you find out things you didn’t know about a parent after they’ve died? You write an hour-long stand-up comedy show, of course. Heads up, the stuff I found isn’t bleak, which is as good for you as it is for me! It’ll be a lovely old time. | Runner-up, Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year & Musical Comedian of the Year finalist 2021.

shows.title: Scottish Falsetto Sock Puppet Theatre: The New Show
shows.description: They’re back for their 20th year! Earth’s funniest footwear debuting their new show in Leicester. ★★★★ “A distracting tonic for the times” – The Scotsman ★★★★★ “Had every single audience member… laughing until they cried” – Edinburgh Evening News ★★★★ “The finest, funniest fringe comedy you will see in Edinburgh” – Everything Theatre

shows.title: Mark Row: A Class Act
shows.description: Teacher turned comedian Mark Row has had enough of the endless carousel of uninspiring lessons, inane questions and kids with attitudes that stink worse than their PE kits. But will a new life in the limelight prove to be any better? Bringing together the best bits from his two previous shows ‘A* in the Making’ and ‘Don’t You Know Who I Am?’ this show demonstrates why Mark Row doesn’t need to stay in the classroom to prove that he’s a class act! You really need to give up teaching and focus on the comedy – Joe Pasquale You really need to give up comedy and focus on the teaching – OFSTED

shows.title: Alex Mason: How to Lose a Guy in 60 Minutes
shows.description: Join Alex Mason (Komedia Best New Comedian Finalist 2024, Chortle Student Comedy Finalist 2022), in a work-in-progress of her highly anticipated debut show about trying to live out her own personal romcom. An interactive multimedia show all about navigating neurodiversity, awkward meet-cutes and the chaos of trying to become the main character in her own story. ‘Thoroughly engaging… enjoyably loose’ (Chortle.co.uk). ‘Interesting’ (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk).

shows.title: Dave Bibby: Hasta La Vista… BIBBY!
shows.description: Amused Moose Edinburgh Comedy Award winner, Dave Bibby, is heading Back To The Future! A one-man Hollywood blockbuster. A journey in a Delorean through some of the greatest movies ever made. Award-winning stand-up that isn’t a WIP! Unbelievable scenes. PWYW in advance or turn up and pay per joke. (There will be jokes! One of them was nominated for joke of the fringe thankyouverymuch) When this Bibby hits 88mph you’re gonna see some serious sh*t. “truly sums up the fun that a Fringe show should be” ***** BroadwayWorld “a fantastic blend of silliness and heartfelt joy” **** ThreeWeeks

shows.title: Sam Adamson: Shake My Hand Goodnight
shows.description: Hilariously honest, unpredictable and refreshingly vulnerable, Sam Adamson is bringing his stand up show to the Leicester Comedy Festival with ‘Shake my Hand Goodnight’ Having performed across the country for over 3 years, and completing a full run of the Edinburgh Fringe with a split bill show in 2024, Sam is bringing you his particular style of ‘Cheeky Chappy’ Comedy with a dollop of philosophy to introduce to you. From family, to war, to the animal kingdom, Sam will find something to poke a little fun at. Finalist of the West End New Act of the Year 2024 “Thought provoking” -Mark Watson

shows.title: The Comedie Of Macbeth
shows.description: This show is a retelling of the traditional Shakespeare play “Macbeth”. A blend of original Shakespeare, new content, and modern elements, this is a show not to miss! Follow the story as Macbeth finds out the witches’ prophecy, proposing to his best friend, and other characters plot his demise. Join us to watch this comedic reimagined romcom! From English students to Shakespeare newbies, this play has a little bit of something for everyone to enjoy.

shows.title: Meisters of the Loony Verse: Herr Strack and Hair Pulsford
shows.description: The show where comedy styles clash. Jürgen Strack (as seen at Altitude Comedy Festival) delivers German-flavoured antics, playful absurdity, and visual gags galore. Richard Pulsford, UK Pun Champion and as seen on Channel 4, fires in razor-sharp wit, clever wordplay, and precision timing. In this two-hander, both comics bring their best for an hour of sharp contrasts, big laughs, and unforgettable moments.

shows.title: Glue Factory Podcast – LIVE!
shows.description: Glue Factory is a comedy podcast from Milo Edwards, Olga Koch and Riley Quinn, covering ground that other shows refuse to touch such as Ancient Mesopotamia, Elvis’ involvement in the Nixon administration and office related mishaps. Come see it live at the Leicester Comedy Festival and find out what emerges from their addled minds.

shows.title: Alex Prescot: Cosy
shows.description: Fresh from Edinburgh Fringe 2025, join “comedy equivalent of sunshine” Alex Prescot for a delightful debut hour that’s tailor-made for each audience. Expect a warm and fuzzy blend of joyful musical comedy and quick-witted improvisation. Don’t expect his notably absent double-act partner. Best-Reviewed Edinburgh Fringe Shows 2025 (British Comedy Guide) ***** “Extremely impressive” WW Reviews ***** “Irresistible” London Theatre Doc ****.5 “A shot of serotonin” Fringesider **** Musical Theatre Review **** Phoenix Remix **** ThreeWeeks **** The Quinntessential Review **** InstaFest Reviews

shows.title: Comedy on the Wolds
shows.description: As part of the 2026 Leicester Comedy Festival we welcome comedy delights of Wendy Wason, Mad Ron, James Ellis and MC Dave Twentyman to another cracking evening of stand up on Waltham on The Wolds! Do note that line-up is subject to change.

shows.title: Juliette Burton: Best of Burton
shows.description: Join the joy! Ten years of a comedy career, five total sold out Edinburgh Fringe seasons, one passionate comedian… and YOU! Join award-winning comedian Juliette Burton for the best bits from her multiple award-winning comedy shows. Needing a top up of hope, kindness and empowerment? Juliette’s ready to share all that and more! Cram a decade of laughter into one jubilant hour of life-affirming hilarity with heart. As seen on BBC One/ITV. Edinburgh Fringe Sold Out Run 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018 & 2023. “A comedy queen. Relatable as f**k” Edinburgh Reviews “Hilarious and educational.” Edfestmag

shows.title: Just the Tonic’s Saturday Night Special with Scott Bennett
shows.description: Scott Bennett headlines, with Oliver Bowler, Dan Tiernan and Darrell Martin MC ‘Just the Tonic consistently boast some of the most interesting line ups in the country’ The Times. A Special night of Comedy at our Fabulous Hansom Hall venue

shows.title: Paul Kerensa: Good Clean Fun
shows.description: Paul Kerensa is a British Comedy Award-winning comedy writer (BBC’s Miranda, Not Going Out, Top Gear, TFI Friday and CBBC’s Andy and the Band). He won ITV’s Take the Mike Award and was a BBC New Comedy Awards finalist. This newish (well he’s got the same face) stand-up show is Good Clean Fun. Or at least 2 out of 3 ain’t bad. You decide which. Expect jokes (some old, some new, none borrowed, none blue), a gameshow (if the shiny jacket’s delivered on time) and tribute act Cher and Cher Alike (TBC), plus everyone’s favourite household name, Dave Household. “Ingenious” Evening Standard

shows.title: Matt Hollins: Greatest Hits Remastered
shows.description: Following on from the success of his Greatest Hits Show in 2025, the former Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year Matt Hollins, returns to perform at his 22nd Leicester Comedy Festival with a Refined and Remastered version. As well as his best material expect anecdotes from his two decades in the game, including problematic incidents in the north east of England. Some routines will be updated, some replaced and some will remain the same, but the dry, deadpan delivery will endure. “A Genuine Original” Leicester Mercury. “Wonderful and Unique” Joe Lycett. “Strikingly Original” Chortle.co.uk

shows.title: Comedy in the Dark
shows.description: This unique comedy experience returns to the Leicester Comedy Festival off the back of sell-outs at Edinburgh Fringe 2023. At Comedy in the Dark, the audience’s senses are heightened – things look and sound different. Joining us on stage this year: Lara Ricote (Edinburgh Comedy Award Best Newcomer Winner, QI, Live at the Apollo) Plastic Jeezus (‘Don’t let the ukulele put you off, these guys are genuinely hilarious’ Ed Byrne) Lawrence Dodd (part of Bridging the Gap 2026) Olga Koch (Mock the Week, QI, Live at the Apollo)

shows.title: Darren Harriott: Work In Progress
shows.description: New house, new life, new outlook?…dunno about that, Double Edinburgh award nominee Darren Harriott’s had a brand new show. It’s all about coming to terms with certain things in life… death, dads, and…. dancing? Yeah.

shows.title: Gavin Lilley
shows.description: Drawing on his experiences as a sign language user, a traveller and a weary father of three – his cringing moments of embarrassment and experiences during his encounters throughout his eventful life will make you chortle. He has performed all over the UK and Europe, bringing laughter to deaf and hearing alike. He has performed at hundreds of venues, namely the London Palladium, the Edinburgh Fringe and at the Helsinki Apollo. He also supported John Bishop on tour. Grab this opportunity for a unique perspective of our diverse cultures (and these habits we’d rather keep to ourselves!)

shows.title: Harun Musho’d: Why I Don’t Talk To People About Terrorism
shows.description: Return of the 2023 hit show. Harun Musho’d is an Arabic name. Good news is I can’t fly a plane. Bad news is I have a rucksack. If you don’t like that joke, don’t come to this show. ‘Excellent show. Sharp and witty comedy from a rising star’ (Fringe Review). ‘A great comedian’ **** (Lancaster Guardian) **** (ViewsFromTheGods.co.uk) ‘Smart’ (Scotsman).

shows.title: Irish American Girls On Tour
shows.description: An Irish woman (Caroline McEvoy) and an American woman (Madeleine Munford) go on tour (i.e. take the train to Leicester) to perform 30 minutes of stand-up each, with new jokes about everything from immigration to dating to life overseas! About Caroline: 3x Funny Women Nominee & host at award-winning Comedy Bandits. ‘She is a fantastic storyteller’ (Entertainment Now). About Madeleine: Tour support for David McSavage and Bobcat Goldtwait. Producer and regular host at Icarus Comedy Club and Friday Night Live. Please note, this show has replaced Stand-Up with Alfie Packham and Caroline McEvoy.

shows.title: Katie Pritchard: I Kiss The Music
shows.description: Join “one-woman comedy music powerhouse” (★★★★★ Voicemag), and body roll enthusiast – Katie Pritchard – as she dresses head to toe in the finest unitard she could make for the final night of her Best Variety Show nominated arena tour (to the most brightly lit room in Leicester). This “Absolutely electric” (★★★★★ Pepper&Salt) show features pumping pop anthems and dance moves you never thought the human body capable of. Think Lady Gaga… on acid! WINNER Musical Comedy Awards

shows.title: Chloe Reynolds: Ticking Boxes WIP
shows.description: Chloe Reynolds (Midlands best new act runner-up). A sincere biographical show with hints of absurdity, acute observations & the odd crass joke for good measure. Starting stand-up whilst everything was starting to change personally, some may call it inspiring, brave, some even artistic integrity at its finest. They call a burden… Chloe talks through her Trans identity and all the changes to her life. Through her wry brand of self-deprecation. Always prudent to speak with meaning and to show all facets of herself rather than reducing themselves to just they’re identity.

shows.title: Ania Magliano: Peach Fuzz
shows.description: Fresh from starring in the latest series of Taskmaster, Ania Magliano (Live At The Apollo, Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Show Nominee) brings a brand-new show full of jokes, confessions, and occasionally unhinged observations to venues nationwide. From the quirks of her own body to the legend that is Eve (yes, from Adam and), to her newly discovered boundaries, Peach Fuzz is Ania at her most relatable – and most funny. ★★★★★ “A GIFT FOR OBSERVATIONAL COMEDY AND WEAVING BEAUTIFULLY CRAFTED ROUTINES” The Telegraph

shows.title: Musical Mockingbirds: Musical Comedy Showcase with The Boys from the All Night Chemist
shows.description: 2.5 hours of funny songs Headliners The Boys from the All Night Chemist sing songs about Tom Jones, Phillip Schofield & the night they took viagra “they had an enthralled audience literally crying with laughter” Nik Hill. Opener Friz Frizzle performs parodies & puns on the piano “A master of musical comedy” Comedy Central. Best Musical Show Leicester Comedy Fest 2020. Plus Kitty Messalina, lewd lyrics and raunchy rhymes from this salaciously smutty songstress. “The filthiest song I’ve ever heard onstage – I love it!” ~Paul Sinha Hosted by local legend Al Grant, guitar wielding conjurer.

shows.title: Tadiwa Mahlunge: Hakuna Ma Tad Tad
shows.description: “I’m back with a new show about self-belief, and trying to make something of life as a refugee. Don’t worry, I keep it light.” – Tadiwa Tadiwa Mahlunge is one of comedy’s fastest-rising stars. The Times ★★★★ hailed him as one of the “Top 3 Stars of Tomorrow”. The Scotsman ★★★★ praised him as “already looking like the complete, fully rounded package”. The Skinny ★★★★ called him “impressively accomplished and infectiously funny.” Tipped as “one of the must-see comics” (Rolling Stone), Tadiwa has appeared on ITV2’s Stand Up Sketch Show, Comedy Central, Dave, and BBC Radio 4’s The News Quiz.

shows.title: Jessie Nixon: Don’t Make Me Regret This
shows.description: Are you a lapsed catholic? Queer? Occasionally distraught? Or too smart for your own good? Have you cried in a changing room? Committed a crime? Eaten a whole cake in one sitting? You’ll like this. Bring your boyfriend but only if he’s gonna be cool. Ok? In her debut hour of Standup, Jessie Nixon is putting her life on the line for you. Top 10 Essential Edinburgh Fringe Comedy Shows – Evening Standard Highlights of the Fringe 2025 – The Observer The Comedians Choice Awards Nominee 2025 ***** Chortle, *****Binge Fringe, ****One4Review, ****The Standard, **** North West End.

shows.title: Sapphire McIntosh: Squeaky Bum Time
shows.description: Sapphire McIntosh grew up with chaos at home and calm on the pitch. Football gave her order, belonging, and the occasional concussion — but mostly, it gave her hope. In this debut hour, she laces up and finally tells her story: the truth about growing up with a narcissist, the power of chosen family, and how she learned to find joy in the mess. With sharp storytelling, honest humour, and a knack for seeing people exactly as they are, Sapphire McIntosh turns pain into play and survival into punchlines.

shows.title: Ben Van der Velde: Van der Laugh Generator
shows.description: One of the best improvisers on the stand-up circuit tries to make sense of the chaos of the world. Join Ben as he squeezes the comedy juice out of everything under the sun, from genetics to tattoos, XL bullies to board games and beyond. It’ll be a bit like watching Wikipedia having a nervous breakdown. For fans of Ross Noble, Jason Byrne and heroic nonsense. “Displays a crackling, spontaneous energy in which we’re swept up.” (Fest) “An accomplished comic.” (Time Out) “Perfect… the audience were hysterical.” (Huffington Post)

shows.title: Beatlesjuice
shows.description: Cult comedy horror movie, Beetlejuice retold through the songs of not even remotely cult band, The Beatles. A multimedia mashup tribute to the Fab Four and the Ghost with the Most by the award-winning creator of The Elvis Dead. So clap your hands or rattle your jewellery, cos It’s Showtime!

shows.title: James Beckett: Stutter Island
shows.description: Stutter Island by James Beckett (Beat the Frog and Mr Bens Winner) explores navigating life as somebody with a stutter, his 12-year break from the comedy scene and how to work with voice that doesn’t quite do what it’s told. “Brimming with wit and invention” ★★★★ One4Review “Imperfectly perfect, unpredictably punchy” edinburghmagazine.com “Fast, scattergun and very funny” Buxton Festival Fringe “An engaging and memorable performance” Rockcentral Promotions

shows.title: Sam Hickman: First Woman
shows.description: A comedy harp concert, what an original premise. Maybe just come for that? ‘The Sensational Sam Hickman’ – the British Comedy Guide unapologetically queer, gorgeous and filthy; join Hickman on a mad romp through love, romance, sex, friendship, motherhood, trauma, the 2002 television series Monk, and Jesus.
