A spellbinding comedy, not to be missed! ‘Michelle Visage mixed with the musical and comedic ability of Victoria Wood’ – Broadwaybaby This show is mostly about religious trauma and medical transition. FUN! ‘Tom Lehrer of the comedy harp.’ -FringeReview

shows.title: Tom Lawrinson: Work In Progress
shows.description: Work in Progress comedy show from stand up and sketch comedian Tom Lawrinson. In this hour I will prove two things: magic is real and also, that I have been shagged. ★★★★★ “Immediately dragging us under with his menacing charm” – Ed Fringe Review ★★★★★ “Tom Lawrinson is in a class of his own” Edinburgh Festivals ★★★★“Lawrinson has turned playful menace into an art form” – The Scotsman ★★★★ Broadway World

shows.title: Henry Michael Will See You Now
shows.description: The debut hour from award-winning medical comedian Henry Michael. A wholesome hour of light-hearted silliness, medical stories, and free tramadol for the first 50 customers (not true). Leicester Mercury Prize Nominee, Winner of Southport New Comedian 2024 and Comedy Hotspots New Act 2023. All proceeds go to Medical Charities, so if you don’t buy a ticket shame on you.

shows.title: Joseph Johnson (and friends)
shows.description: Joseph has gathered some of his absolute favourite comedians — each bringing their comedy gold. From razor-sharp one-liners to wild stories and off-the-cuff hilarity, no two sets are alike. After the showcase, Joseph takes the stage to headline the night, delivering a full set of his trademark wit and energy. It’s a comedy night built on good vibes, great friends, and guaranteed laughs.

shows.title: Lucas Jefcoate: If I’m Not Somebody, I’m Nobody
shows.description: Lucas Jefcoate has been calling himself a comedian for about 12 years, and only recently have people began to agree. His stand up (Hastings New Comedian of the Year) and online sketches (75 million views) have finally started connecting with an audience. But since the age of 13 he’s been posting videos online, writing jokes and definitely not carrying a chip on his shoulder. His mildly anticipated debut comedy show tells the story of how found his voice, himself and his go to meal deal. We’ve all got an embarrassing digital footprint, but Lucas’ is sure to make you feel better about your own

shows.title: Atmossy
shows.description: Experimental comedy with a neuro-spicy twist. Join Stags T Woodward for an hour of Oddness as he explores what “atmosphere” means to him. A magical hour from a seasoned festival act. Review: ‘Few things more charming…With nothing but a microphone and a rain sound machine, Stags brings his audience into his memories… Audience doubled up in laughter’ (Margaret Hall, Playbill).

shows.title: Garrie Grubb: Filthy boy
shows.description: Garrie Grubb wants nothing more than to be a “family friendly” comedian, but every joke he writes ends with a filthy punchline that has no place on a cruise ship or ITV. Join him, for one night only, as he tells all of his rudest and crudest jokes that no decent audience should ever have to hear. “One of the smartest comedy minds” BBC Essex. Best in Class 2024. Not so new comedian of the year 2023 Finalist

shows.title: Paul Currie : Remove Your Skin Please
shows.description: This will be award winning absurdist comedian Paul Currie’s brand new show. A welded fusion of stand up, clown, mime, art, noise rock and utter nonsense that shall be squeezed into 60min of the most utterly bonkers comedy ever brought to a live stage. Strap in and let go for a rusted rollercoaster ride into the south hemisphere of reality. Imagine David Lynch & Iggy Pop meets Spike Milligan on Buckfast & Haribo. “ INCREDIBLE! A treasure trove of imaginative physical comedy.” ★★★★★ THE SCOTSMAN ★★★★★ STEWART LEE

shows.title: A wizard answers a ringing phone, describes what is happening for fifty-two minutes, and then leaves.
shows.description: A wizard will answer a ringing phone, describe events for fifty-two minutes and then leave. Return of the Golden Palantir Award-winning show. Opinions from previous co-conspirators: “It was exactly what the title said!”; “People just wouldn’t leave the miniature keyboard alone”; “A calculated and cynical revival”; “Oh! I get it now, can we go again?”; “The way he gabbled it all out at speed was SO good!”; “Too many gorillas!” [attire subject to change]

shows.title: Rachel Fairburn: Vexy Beasts (WIP)
shows.description: Join Rachel (Live At The Apollo, All Killa No Filla) as she tries brand new characters for her 2026 tour. ‘Very much the rock ‘n’ roll star of British comedy’ ★★★★★ Broadway World ★★★★★Opening Night ★★★★Chortle ★★★★The Skinny

shows.title: Joke Spot @ The Festival Hub
shows.description: Roll up! Roll up! Joke Spot makes you the star as we invite anyone under the age of 18 to take the mic and become a comedian. Our pop-up stage will be touring Leicester throughout the festival and it’s up to you to drop-in and tell us your best jokes. More venues may be announced throughout the festival, so keep an eye on our socials @kidscomedyfest or our website!

shows.title: Plastic Jeezus: Second Debut Show (Work in Progress)
shows.description: After selling out their previous performances in Leicester, multiple award-winning deadpan musical comedy duo, Aaron & Simon – AKA ‘Plastic Jeezus’ – are back, with a show consisting of a mixture of brand new material and old fan favourites. Expect hilarious and often surreal original songs, all delivered in their own unique, straight-faced way. Ed Byrne – “These guys are genuinely hilarious” Chris McCausland – “I can’t recommend these guys enough. They are dark, daft & bloody hilarious!” Angela Barnes – “Really funny lads & songs that had me howling. Go see them, they deserve full houses”

shows.title: The FAT (Film and TV) Gameshow
shows.description: Calling all film buffs and Netflix bingers! The FAT gameshow is a semi-improvisational panel show where comedians have to use their wit in combination with their pop culture knowledge to win! Which of the contestants will come out on top and be officially crowned The Winning Buff?!

shows.title: An interview with Stephen Fry
shows.description: Join comedian, writer and broadcaster Stephen Fry in conversation with festival founder Geoff Rowe as they discuss Stephen’s comedy career. Topics will include Cambridge Footlights, A Bit of Fry & Laurie, Blackadder and much more. This event is in memory of Tony Slattery and in aid of Big Difference Company.

shows.title: Bad Clowns: Long Live The King! (Kids Show)
shows.description: The King is dead! 3 candidates can only ascend the throne with the support of the audience! Join the Bad Clowns and shape the future of the kingdom! ‘A wonderfully anarchic production’ ★★★★★ – LondonTheatre1 ‘Brilliantly put together, witty, entertaining’ ★★★★★ – West End Best Friend ‘More of this thing please!’ ★★★★★ – Threeweeks ‘Fast paced hour of idiotic nonsense’ ★★★★ – Daily Express

shows.title: Jonny Pelham: New Jokes (WIP)
shows.description: Award-winning comedian Jonny Pelham returns to Leicester with some new jokes. He hasn’t written them yet, so he isn’t sure how good they will, but he is optimistic that if you buy a ticket you will have a nice time. As seen on Live at the Apollo, Mock The Week, Alan Davies As Yet Untitled. As heard on Off Menu. ***** The Herald **** The Guardian **** The Times **** The Telegraph. “The laughs are explosive” Chortle.

shows.title: Julia Knight: Songs of Joy & Justice
shows.description: An hour of quirky, original comedy songs highlighting life’s joys, absurdities and injustices in equal measure from an award-winning singer and multi-instrumentalist. Find out why Julia loves avocados but avoids extreme sports. Expect songs about gin, billionaires and of course, Richard III! Including songs from Julia’s solo show ‘I Am Not Victoria Wood” which had sellout runs at Brighton and Edinburgh Fringe Festivals, and a brand-new song improvised from audience suggestions on the day. “A one-woman Fascinating Aïda” “Easy-going fun” [Buxton Fringe review 2025]

shows.title: Milo Edwards: Greatest Hits
shows.description: Milo Edwards has been a professional comedian for ten years. Ten years, four international tours, hundreds of motorway service stations. This show is an hour of Milo’s best material from an entire decade, an anthem for a misspent youth. Expect life, death, Russia, politics, 9-11 and space. ‘Edwards has quietly become one of the UK’s smartest, most vital stand-ups.’ Chortle ‘Near perfect.’ ★★★★★ The Wee Review ‘Milo Edwards’ comedy is a little like marmalade.’ ★★★★★ Broadway Baby ‘He must surely go onwards and upwards.’ ★★★★ The Daily Telegraph

shows.title: Rachel Fairburn: Work In Progress
shows.description: Join Rachel (Live At The Apollo, All Killa No Filla) as she tries brand new stand up for 2026. ‘Very much the rock ‘n’ roll star of British comedy’ ★★★★★ Broadway World ★★★★★Opening Night ★★★★Chortle ★★★★The Skinny

shows.title: Richard Herring: RHLSTP
shows.description: Richard Herring returns to Leicester Comedy Festival for his famous podcast, RHLSTP! Richard Herring has enjoyed phenomenal success as a writer and performer and is an innovator in the world of podcasts. Join the “Podfather” (Guardian), “King of the Internet” (Time Out) and “The UK’s online comedy pioneer” (The Times) as he chats with Fatiha El-Ghorri and Rob Auton. RHLSTP sees him interview top comedians in front of a live audience for his podcast but includes all the chat that is too controversial for broadcast.

shows.title: Stuart Thomas: Bad Fatty (Work In Progress)
shows.description: Stuart Thomas’s “Bad Fatty” is a sharp, unapologetic standup that dives into life as a fat Welshman. Growing up on a Welsh sheep farm, Stuart fuses his working-class roots with a modern take on body positivity, grabbing diet culture by the scruff of the neck and calling out society’s absurd expectations. Proudly embracing his body, bisexuality, and mental health, he explores sexuality, body image, and depression. With humour and boldness, Stuart flips fat-shaming on its head—turning everyday moments into hilarious defiance. He’s taking no prisoners.

shows.title: Brian Boley: Made in Felixstowe
shows.description: Brian was born and brought up in Felixstowe, he says it is the best place in the world. Felixstowe shaped and made Brian into the kind of man he is today. How can this be funny? Come along and see!

shows.title: Danny Clives: Bits & Pieces (WIP)
shows.description: It has been a whirlwind few years for Danny Clives, selling out his debut show at the Edinburgh Fringe, supporting internet sensation Uncle Roger at The Hammersmith Apollo and appearing in Joe Lycett’s short film Mark. Now, Danny returns to the Leicester Comedy Festival with his new work-in-progress show Bits & Pieces. Danny is an alumnus of Soho Theatre’s Comedy Labs, has been nominated for the BBC Comedy Award, and was once on the same lineup as Kevin Bridges. ‘Charmingly chaotic, low-key self-deprecation’ – Chortle

shows.title: Matt Winning: Solastalgia
shows.description: Expansive comedy storytelling about fatherhood, climate change, finance and responsibility by an expert making work at the cutting edge of environmental topics Dr Matt Winning. Host of Net Zero: A Very British Problem (BBC Radio 4). It’s ‘The Big Short’ about the climate crisis told through an authentically personal story . Directed by Ben Target. Solastalgia: noun (sol-a-stal-gi-a) the emotional, physical or existential distress caused by environmental change to your home. A portmanteau of the words solace and nostalgia. ‘gently funny, deeply human and profoundly poignant’ **** (Scotsman)

shows.title: Sunil Patel: Work In Progress
shows.description: I have always liked Leicester. It is a nice town with nice people. Mad what happened to King Richard III though isn’t it? And you just left him in a car park like that. As seen on BBC, C4, Comedy Central.

shows.title: Auditory Awakenings With Mr Tingles in the House of ASMR
shows.description: Step boldly into Yogie Belle’s sonic realm: winkle tinkles, water waffles and absurdist apples whisper into the ears of aloof loofahs! Echolocate your true porpoise and rid yourself of any residual anger stored within. A live ASMR extravaganza like nothing you’ve seen or heard before. NOTICE FROM DEPARTMENT OF ABSURD ADJUSTMENTS Tickets are now £5 a seat or £10 for 2. Availability limited to first 100 takers only. Seats may be sat upon but not taken. Disclaimer: Echolibration not guaranteed.

shows.title: Laura Quinn Goh: You, Me, and Your Prison Officer
shows.description: Laura fell in love with a man on death row and built a life around a prison romance that defied borders, logic, and ultimately, fate. In her darkly funny and sharply honest debut comedy-storytelling hour, she shares the wild journey from writing erotic prison letters to accidentally becoming a full-time comedian — all for the sake of love. A cathartic comedy hour on heartbreak, healing, and the absurdity of it all, it has won over audiences with sold-out runs in Manchester, Glasgow, and Singapore. As seen on STV. West End New Act Finalist. Funny Women Stage Award (long-list).

shows.title: Madame Chandelier’s Decide Your Own Destiny Opera Show
shows.description: When Madame Chandelier’s daughter gets sucked into her video game and is kidnapped by the evil Queen of the Night, there’s only one thing to do – gather opera’s fiercest characters for an epic boss battle. Will Carmen, Tosca, and Madame Butterfly help defeat the ultimate boss, or will all arias lead to death? Fun for the whole family! **** “Expert Timing” The Guardian **** “A true diva… phenomenal. Madame Chandelier could be the ticket that opens up opera to new audiences” Broadway Baby

shows.title: UK Pun Off
shows.description: The hit online show The UK Pun Off is coming back to Leicester! Four top comics will have three jokes on five different topics and it is up to the audience to decide the winner of each round to crown the winner. We also look for the audience’s best puns and prizes are up for grabs for the audience member with the best pun. Be sure to check out our past episodes on YouTube @ukpunoff to get you prepared for the hottest pun show on the planet! WINNER BEST PANEL SHOW- Late Stage Comedy at Notts Comedy Festival 2024 Sold out shows Leicester Comedy Festival 2025

shows.title: Uncle CCTV
shows.description: Uncle CCTV viral Tik Tok persona, built on sneaky Art of Listening where he eavesdrops on strangers’ conversations in pubs and cafes, his whispered narrations of awkward dates and the bar banter provide observational humour and chaotic energy. Boots on the grounds journalism Uncle CCTV’s charm comes from real unfiltered moments captured in public. A mix of stand up and improv. Please note, this show is listed as Benjamin Bankole Bello: Missed Opportunities in our physical brochure.

shows.title: Richard Pulsford: Yorkshire Dad, Immigrant Mum
shows.description: Multi-award-winning stand-up comedian Richard Pulsford takes a nostalgic no holds barred tour into his parents’ past to try to understand how it made them who they were, and therefore the person who he is. With a dad from Yorkshire and a ‘foreign’ mum maybe it shouldn’t be a surprise that Richard ended up being, well, ‘funny’. Richard won Leicester Comedy Festival’s UK Pun Championships in 2022, has had Top Ten Jokes of the Edinburgh Fringe three times, was interviewed on Channel 4’s ‘Steph’s Packed Lunch’ in 2022 and his one-liner show was nominated for ‘Best stand-up’ at Buxton Fringe 2023.

shows.title: Cecily Hitchcock: Work In Progress
shows.description: Cecily Hitchcock is a comedy siren and crowd enchantress. In her debut hour she revisits childhood in early-2000s Britain – when the financial crash hummed in the background and life was noisy and confusing. Seen through a child’s lens trying to make sense and silliness out of it all, everyday figures became unlikely idols, familiar scenes twisted into epic dramas, and the ordinary warped into something absurd. A surreal, funny ride through the strangest years of growing up. “Outstanding” – The Independent “Hot” – Katherine Ryan “Weirdly original and originally weird” – Mitch Benn

shows.title: Sarah Roberts: Scary Movie 7 (WIP)
shows.description: Sarah Roberts (BBC New Comedy Awards, The Guardian’s Funniest Comedians of the Fringe, Rolling Stone’s Rising Stars of 2024 and 2025 Chortle Award Nominated Shitposter) is conceiving a new show. And you’re the dad. ‘Mischievous, playful and very loveable’ ★★★★★ (EdFringeReview.com). ‘Razor-sharp’ ★★★★★ (TheReviewsHub.com). ‘Riotously funny’ ★★★★ (The Student). ‘Remarkable’ ★★★★ (thecomicscomic.com). ‘Seamless’ ★★★★ (TheSpyInTheStalls.com).. ‘Irresistibly fun’ (Rolling Stone). ‘Phenomenal new talent, destined for stardom’ (Catherine Bohart).

shows.title: Simon Evans is Staring at the Sun
shows.description: Simon Evans is Staring at the Sun Simon Evans is Back! Waaaay back… With growing evidence that we are living in a Computer Simulation – and a pretty glitchy, off-brand simulation at that – and the approaching watershed of the AI Singularity looming like a weirdly pixelated cumulo-nimbus on the horizon, BBC Radio 4 stalwart and veteran of a quarter century of highly acclaimed stand-up comedy Simon Evans is squinting at an uncertain future, and revisiting the blue remembered hills of his youth. The analogue world of hitch-hiking, pub bets and hedge porn. Of being able to get properly lost. An

shows.title: 1290.5 Steps to Autistic Success: Kittenageddon (Sidequests and Buffering)
shows.description: After last year’s hit show, Stags returns with hilarious new neuro-spicy adventures in his innovative (but similarly named) 1290.5-step mission for success. Questioning what it means to be AuDHD in a neurotypical world. Reviews: ‘Few things more charming…With nothing but a microphone and a rain sound machine,Stags brings his audience into his memories… Audience doubled up in laughter’ (Margaret Hall, Playbill). ‘An immensely likeable and charismatic performer’ (NeurodiverseReview.com). ‘Highly recommended!!’ “Absolutely hilarious, — I left with a warm fuzzy glow that lasted for hours…”

shows.title: Geoff Alderman: Dirty Alderman
shows.description: Lots of jokes. Mostly one liners, but some longer bits. Some dark material. “… a very welcome masterclass of one liner comedy from @geoffa_words who absolutely smashed his spot.” Ian Whitcombe – Promoter, Nottingham

shows.title: Brennan Reece: Live
shows.description: Star of Live At The Apollo, Roast Battle and Celeb Coach Trip. With over 100 Million Views online. Brennan is back with a brand new hour of funny thoughts, daft stories and the occasional swear word. Soz.

shows.title: It Just So Happened: An Alternative History Show
shows.description: Stand-up comedian Richard Pulsford (Scottish Comedian of the Year runner-up 2021, UK Pun Championships winner 2022) hosts this show for history fans, back for a seventh year. 3 guest comedians / history buffs (Kevin Hudson, Julia Knight & Ben Ennis) perform short stand-up sets based ‘on this day’ in history before exploring some of the real and imagined history of Leicester people and events. Recorded for podcast. Website itjustsohappened.co.uk

shows.title: Jules O’Brian: Avoid Excessive Cleavage (and Other Advice to Ignore)
shows.description: Jules O’Brian is in her 50s now, and the “helpful” advice about what she should and shouldn’t be doing just keeps on coming. Don’t wear that. Don’t leave it too late. Have you tried sticky tape for droopy jowls? Armed with a cardboard cut-out of Liz Hurley and a glass of Pinot, Jules is on a Middle-Age Crusade to silence unsolicited advice. Warm, sharp stand-up about ageing, expectations and refusing to quietly fade into the background.

shows.title: Jin Hao-Li: Addicted To Time Travel (WIP)
shows.description: I just can’t stop. Going into the past feels good. I never go into the future, I don’t wanna know. I want to know again what I knew. I don’t want to know the new. Ew. ★★★★★ Telegraph ★★★★★ The Skinny ★★★★★ The Age Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2024 | Best Newcomer Nominee

shows.title: Paul Campbell: The Lost Tapes of Somerfield
shows.description: Following a successful run at the Edinburgh festival, where it won the Malcom Hardee Award Winner for Comic Originality at the Edinburgh Fringe 2025, this show looks at how, as a socially isolated sixth former, Paul Campbell found solace in the aisles of 00’s supermarket Somerfield. Fast becoming a supermarket fanboy, Paul spent up to two hours a day relaxing in his beloved Stretford branch but when the store closed in 2006. Paul experienced the five stages of Supermarket Grief. ‘A show to fall in with’ The Scotsman ***** ‘The best new act I’ve seen in years ‘ Lucy Beaumont

shows.title: Aaagony Aunts
shows.description: Pauline Eyre and Louise Leigh are Aardvark Mums (because mothering is Aard-verk). They’ve got spare mothering left over now their pups have left the burrow, so they’re using their natural gifts to solve life’s most important problems. Guest comics bring their dilemmas and the Aardvark mums find solutions together with you, the audience, some ancient aardvark wisdom and a selection of kitchen utensils. Award-bothering comedians, Louise and Pauline have considerable comic chops alongside keen ears, the ability to dig fast and a sparse covering of coarse hair. No ants will be harmed in this show.

shows.title: Jon Hipkiss: The Wild One
shows.description: Two-Time Award Nominee, Audience Choice and Best New Show, Jon Hipkiss returns to Leicester after sell-out shows at last year’s Edinburgh Fringe. Rising to become one of the UK’s most hyperkinetic and crowd-pleasing performers, this show saw an electrifying, TV-making, sold-out performance at this year’s inaugural Rik Mayall Comedy Festival. Support for Jack Whitehall. ‘Hilarious’ -Larry Dean. ‘Laugh-out-loud funny’ -Jon Richardson. ‘His set was on fire’ – The National. ‘One of the best comedy shows I’ve seen’ – Edinbrugh-Review.co.uk. Alumnus of Chicago’s The Second City Improv Theatre.

shows.title: Tony Slattery’s Rambling Club
shows.description: Embark on whimsical adventures with your hosts Paul Carmichael and Allan Lear, carrying on the legacy of their friend, the magnificent Tony Slattery! Join them and a secret special guest live as they dive into delightful discussions, often accompanied by a special guest, as they navigate the quirky wonders of the Dewey Decimal System—guided by their magical (and rather tatty) bingo machine, voiced by the legendary Stephen Fry!

shows.title: Paul McCaffrey
shows.description: Star of BBC Three’s Impractical Jokers & Russell Howard’s Good News, Comedy Central’s Stand Up Central, Channel 4’s 50 Funniest & CBBC’s The Dog Ate My Homework. In 2019 Paul also made his debut on BBC flagship stand-up show Live at the Apollo. An accomplished radio presenter & guest, Paul has recently been heard on: talkSPORT, Absolute’s The Alternative Vote, Rob Beckett’s Rock ‘n’ Roll Football and Russell Kane’s Whistle-Stop Tour on BBC Radio 2. He also presents The Paul McCaffrey Show every Saturday morning on Jack FM. THIS IS A TOUR SHOW PREVIEW, JUST 4 DAYS BEFORE THE TOUR STARTS

shows.title: Extraordinary Alien
shows.description: Extraordinary Alien is Debra Tammer’s razor-sharp, hilarious take on being a proud Jewish woman in a world that often wishes she wasn’t. From rabbis in Leeds to therapists in New York, she tackles family trauma, botched haircuts, and a Kafkaesque immigration process that demanded she prove herself an ‘Alien of Extraordinary Ability.’ With characters, chutzpah, and unapologetic Jewish humour, Debra turns antisemitism and alienation into a punchline — and a celebration of standing out. Please note, this show has reduced its ticket price from £25 since our physical brochure went to print.

shows.title: Milo Edwards: Work In Progress
shows.description: Critically acclaimed comedian Milo Edwards is trying out some new jokes. Sell-Out show at the Edinburgh Fringe 2025 “Edwards has quietly become one of the UK’s smartest, most vital stand-ups” – Chortle ‘Near perfect.’ ★★★★★ The Wee Review ‘Milo Edwards’ comedy is a little like marmalade.’ ★★★★★ Broadway Baby Leicester Comedy Festival Best Show (Nominee)

shows.title: Rohan Sharma: Mad Dog
shows.description: Rohan Sharma, the reigning Leicester Square New Comedian champion, presents his hotly-anticipated debut, a fast-paced, multimedia odyssey. Come see truth become lies, lies become truth and the dog become mad. ‘At the very forefront of an exciting new generation of British comedy’ – Rolling Stone ***** – Edfringereview *****- A Youngish Perspective **** – Broadway World **** – FringeReview **** – Mervyn Stutter

shows.title: Sam Nicoresti: Baby Doomer
shows.description: Winner of Best Show at the Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2025 A glistening diamond hour of stand-up from delusional queer icon Sam Nicoresti about love, insanity, and the hunt for the perfect skirt suit. Following a critical maelstrom of success at the Edinburgh Fringe, and three weeks of sold-out performances at London’s Soho Theatre, Sam finally takes her breakout hit show Baby Doomer on tour. From a sartorial emergency in a TK Maxx to the standing stones of Cornwall, through the seas of change, clothes and cats, Sam Nicoresti asks the vital question: does the perfect skirt suit exist?

shows.title: Bad Clowns: Long Live The King!
shows.description: 14:00: KIDS SHOW (SILLY) 20:30 ADULTS SHOW (SWEARY) The king is dead! There are 3 viable candidates to be his successor – however, they can only ascend the throne with the support of the local lords and ladies (the audience)! Join the Bad Clowns and shape the future of the entire kingdom! ‘A wonderfully anarchic production’ ★★★★★ – LondonTheatre1 ‘Brilliantly put together, witty and entertaining’ ★★★★★ – West End Best Friend ‘More of this thing please!’ ★★★★★ – Threeweeks ‘Surprising and genius’ ★★★★★ – Get the Chance ‘Fast paced hour of idiotic nonsense’ ★★★★ – Daily Express

shows.title: Bennet Kavanagh: Crank Up the Volume!! (To a Reasonable Volume)
shows.description: Multi award-winning musical comedian Bennet Kavanagh presents an hour of musical comedy all about the 2006 Jason Statham film ‘Crank’. But don’t worry it’s not just about ‘Crank’. It’s also about the sequel ‘Crank 2: High Voltage’. Expect songs, stand-up and a few musical surprises. And the occasional reference to ‘Crank’. ‘An uncannily odd, inexplicable delight’ -The Scotsman. ‘Unique and charmingly chaotic’ **** -TheReviewsHub. Winner: Bath Comedy Festival New Act of the Year. As seen/heard on ITV, BBC Radio5Live and BBC Radio 4Xtra. Directed by Edinburgh Comedy Award Nominee Huge Davies

shows.title: Dan Tiernan: Quartz and All (Work in Progress)
shows.description: Work in progress show from 2023 Edinburgh Comedy Award Best Newcomer Nominee Dan Tiernan. In 2022, Dan won the BBC New Comedian of the Year and British Comedian of the Year. He’s achieved two sold-out Edinburgh runs in 2023 (debut) and 2024, during which he received 4 & 5* star reviews from The Scotsman, Daily Telegraph, The List, Chortle, and The Skinny (to name a few!). TV includes: Live at the Apollo (BBC Two), The Stand Up Sketch Show (ITV 2), QI (BBC Two) and Mel Giedroyc: Unforgivable (Dave), The Last Leg (Channel 4), 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown (Channel 4).

shows.title: Hannah Braggins & Stevie Yardy are in The HRT Locker
shows.description: Hannah Braggins & Stevie Yardy have been on the same bill on many occasions (with Queer Comedy Sheffield, finalists of the Sheffield steel city comedy competition, & jointly winning an EdFringe QCC gag race, to name a few) but despite being friends for 3 years, they have never collaborated directly… Till now! Strap in/on for an hour of stand-up that some are calling “the most hotly anticipated team up since Robbie Williams & that chimp!” Described as “Among the best trans-fem comedians in Sheff!” Granted there are only 6 Trans women on the Sheff circuit but pointing that out is a hate crime.

shows.title: Jack Kelly & Jimmy Shirley: Shirley, You Kelly Be Serious?
shows.description: A split hour of new jokes from two lovely blokes. The last show they did together was reviewed as ‘perfect comedy gold’, so this one is bound to be alright as well. Described as ‘a sensational stand-up’, Jack Kelly is a Manchester-based comedian, writer, and host, as heard on BBC Radio 2. Known for his sharp wit and what the British Comedy Guide calls ‘hilarious anecdotes’. Jimmy Shirley ponders the absurdity of being a Scouser in Greece and growing up in 90’s Kirkby. A So You Think You’re Funny semi-finalist, Clinton Baptiste tour support, and named by Lancaster Guardian as ‘one to watch’.

shows.title: The UK Pun Championships
shows.description: What do you get when you cross comedians and a boxing ring? The UK Pun Championships! A social media phenomenon and sell-out success, join us as top comedians from across the country compete for the crown of UK Pun Champion, voted for by you – the audience. Competing this

shows.title: Balthazar Dark: Dark Thymes
shows.description: Alternative/Character/Sketch/Improv/stand-up madness from former professional wrestler & current all round silly billy Balthazar Dark. Balthazar Dark is the greatest ex-wrestler you’ve never heard of but injury had put payed to his once promising career. Will stand-up Comedy prove to be his salvation?

shows.title: Ray Fordyce: Quincunx
shows.description: Quincunx is Ray Fordyce’s favourite word. It means a pattern of five and there are five areas of his life he want’s to talk about and how they all connect.

shows.title: The Big Chilli: Featuring Ian Stone
shows.description: Enjoy an evening of curry and comedy with Mock the Week headline act Ian Stone (top ten stand-ups in Britain by The Independent). All in honour of the wonderful Tracey Miller and to raise funds for Soft Touch Arts. Tickets £75 each or £700 for 10 and a table. Book via the website or email danny@soft-touch.org.uk.

shows.title: Ye Gods!
shows.description: Difficult personalities in charge? An impossible set of rules to follow? Some frankly unbelievable back stories? Religions can be hard to fathom and even harder to follow. But thankfully that lends itself perfectly to creating some improvisation games! Hallelujah! In this fun, light-hearted show, the Ye Gods improv troupe will create improvised scenes based on audience suggestions based loosely around religious themes, all of which will go to form a new (silly) bespoke religion, one which we can all sign up to. Contains improvisation and clowning.

shows.title: Desiree Burch: The Golden Wrath
shows.description: Authentic, curious, and gleefully irascible, storyteller and comedian Desiree Burch leads a madcap voyage through the Middle Ages – AKA the mid-life crisis, and its mandatory metamorphosis – in her new standup hour. Desiree brings both childlike wonder and crone-like wit to the experiences of losing sleep, relevance, knee cartilage, oestrogen, youth, and illusions in a laugh-packed hour that celebrates the fury and freedom found when you’ve accepted that time has ruined your plans, but roll up your sleeves to fight it anyway.

shows.title: Rachel Creeger: “Queen Of The Jews” (WIP – Leicester)
shows.description: When hate mail arrived including the comment “Who do you think you are, Queen of the Jews?” I thought to myself “I’m not sure that’s the flex you think it is!” Sometimes people hate you because of them, sometimes they hate you because of you. A work-in-progress of a brand new stand up show exploring the difference between racism and “Rachism”. Rachel Creeger is a multi-award-winning comedian and the only orthodox Jew on the UK comedy circuit. She’s taken 4 critically acclaimed shows to the Edinburgh Fringe and can regularly be seen on BBC1 and heard across the BBC Radio network.

shows.title: Jokes on Us: New Act Showcase
shows.description: Want to see some fresh new comedy talent? Nothing to do on a Tuesday? Enjoy rhetorical questions in bios? Boy, have we got the show for you! Here at Jokes on Us we’re always on the look out for rising stars and we’ve invited some of our favourite new comedians to perform short spots in one of our favourite venues, Real Ale Classroom. Join host Alex Hylton in this Pay What You Want treat.

shows.title: Richard Pulsford: The Short Joke Teller Returns
shows.description: This is the tenth different one-liner solo show Richard has taken to Leicester! This show toured all round the UK last year and showcases a hilarious mix of quality one-liners, wordplay and puns. Leicester Comedy Festival’s UK Pun Championships Winner 2022. Scottish Comedian of the Year runner-up 2021. You Must Be Joke King winner, Southport 2024. Nominated Best stand-up Buxton Fringe 2023. Top Ten Edinburgh Fringe jokes 2019, 2021 and 2022. As seen on Channel 4’s Steph’s Packed Lunch. “Exudes confidence and charm.” ***** Lancaster Guardian “Quick, original and funny” **** Broadway Baby

shows.title: Christof Epaminondas: Too Much Encouragement
shows.description: Christof’s overly-supportive, Greek-Cypriot family has made him think anybody cares about his jokes and, even worse, this show. Through talent alone he has done very well at stand-up competitions (or the fact that 50% of the audience were blood relatives). 3rd out of 300: Get-Up Stand-Up; Finalist: Rising Star New Act Competition; Semi-finalist: Leicester Square New Comedian of the Year and Max Turner Prize. Name butchered on: BBC Radio 4.

shows.title: Are we the problem?
shows.description: They’re hopeless at romance, come from chaotic families, and trouble seems magnetically drawn to them. In this triple-headliner split bill, rising comics Ciaran Shea, David Martin, and Lauren Buck ask the ultimate question: “Are We the Problem?” Expect tales of dating witches, cursed school nicknames, and the launch of a very unnecessary Crying Olympics. A stand-up show packed with charm, sass, and an unhealthy amount of glitter.

shows.title: Jacob Hawley: Work In Progress
shows.description: The beginnings of a new tour show from Jacob Hawley. Host of The Screen Rot Podcast. As heard on most of the other ‘Horrible Men Talking Rubbish’ podcasts, as well as some Arsenal ones.

shows.title: Sunny Skies Comedy Showcase
shows.description: After an award-winning year in 2025, the Sunny Skies crew is back for 2026! Join us for a evening of laughter and community at Sunny Skies Café, where comedy shines brightest when it’s inclusive! Enjoy performances by our team of hilarious Welly’s Workers, showcasing the talents and skills of disabled and neurodiverse performers. There’ll be silly sketches, cheesy jokes, awesome dancing, and lots of surprises! Once again we’ll be joined by our friends at Bright Spark Arts. Rob Gee and his talented crew of Humour Hub graduates will be returning with their unique poetry and shenanigans.

shows.title: Unpack-a-Mole & NeurodiVirgin: A Split Bill
shows.description: Watch rising stars Lewis Coupe & Katie Johnson make their show debuts with a fantastic split bill! Lewis Coupe: Unpack-a-Mole Watch Lewis whack his past on its head in this witty and energetic performance! Like a 2p machine, stand here for 30 minutes and lose £5! “Lewis Coupe is a talented and funny man.” Craig Shaw. Katie Johnson: NeurodiVirgin Join Katie as she shamelessly explores her relationship with autism, sex & her self-worth, through hilarious one-liners and observations! “The start up stand-up to watch” Mark Wareham, Mail on Sunday

shows.title: Will Duggan: The Girl with the Duggan Tattoo
shows.description: After a year of not writing a new stand up show (very relaxing) Will Duggan has in fact written a new stand up show (less relaxing). But fear not the show he has written is definitely the best show that he has ever written and possibly the best show ANYONE has ever written. Wow. Pretty confident. You may have seen Will on Sky1, or BBC3, or heard him on Radio 4. You may have seen him in a swimming pool or a cafe. He’s always somewhere, and one of those places may at some point have coincided with a place you were. Maybe you’ll see him at this show

shows.title: Jake Baker: My Jakey Bakey Heart
shows.description: Masculinity is in crisis! Alpha-Dogs and Macho-Maniacs dominate the conversation. But there is another way. Join this award-winning comedian as he presents a more gentle approach to being a chap. ‘Thoughtful and very funny!’ (List) ‘Quietly impressive; a talent that shouldn’t be overlooked’ (Chortle) ‘Endearingly offbeat’ ★★★★ (Ed-Reporter)

shows.title: Rob Auton: CAN
shows.description: Multi award-winning writer, performer and actor Rob Auton presents his debut narrative show. Having written 11 critically acclaimed shows on specific themes, Rob is now keen on telling you a story he has written about a man he made up called CAN. At one point in his life CAN was the world’s number one motivational speaker… and then something happened. “A GENUINE ORIGINAL” The Guardian

shows.title: Fifty Eight Comedy Club
shows.description: Join us at Fifty Eight for a fantastic night of comedy and cocktails, as Leicester Comedy Festival ‘Best Show’ winner Alex Hylton introduces three top comedians from the UK comedy scene in this intimate venue at the heart of Market Harborough.

shows.title: Comedy at Louisas’ Cafe
shows.description: Laughs at Louisas Café Comedy Club 8pm Age 18+ As part of the 2025 Leicester Comedy Festival we welcome some of the finest stand up comedians on the scene to the Louisas Cafe for your laughing pleasure! This evening fun will feature the most excellent and downright funny comedy delights of Dave Twentyman, Hannah Platt and all held together by your host and MC Chris Brooker! Do note that line-up is subject to change.

shows.title: Fleckney Comedy Club
shows.description: Fleckney Comedy Club Fleckney Village Hall 8pm Age 18+ Come and joins us in the snug and welcoming surroundings of Fleckney Village Hall for a riotous night of comedy featuring the stand-up comedy delights of Cerys Nelmes, Samantha Day and topped off by your headliner Matt Price! Do note that line-up is subject to change.

shows.title: Jarred Christmas: Captain Comedy – Featuring Special Guest Hobbit
shows.description: Direct from panto, Jarred Christmas is back with another awesome night of stand-up comedy, and this time he’s joined by the electrifying talent of Beatboxer Hobbit (Dick Whittington’s Cat). What happens when an award-winning comedian and world-champion beatboxer combine their powers? You get a high energy, exceptional night of hilarious messing around and laughs galore! Brace yourself for a joyous night of entertainment from two masters of their craft. A thrilling comedy, beatbox collaboration like no other!

shows.title: Rob Rouse & Tom Wrigglesworth: The Unlikely Weightlifters
shows.description: Award-winning comedians Rob Rouse (‘Genuinely funny bones’ Sunday Times) and Tom Wrigglesworth (‘A rare talent’ Time Out) premiere a live version of their cult podcast. Glorious nonsense from these two absolute clowns whose weightlifting podcast isn’t really about weightlifting at all, it’s about pure silliness and friendship. Best Show Nominee Buxton Fringe 2025 + Total sell out 2024/2025

shows.title: Matt Rouse: Joy Thief (Work in Progress)
shows.description: Matt Rouse brings a work in progress stand up show to the Leicester Comedy Festival, trying to figure out identity, renting and whether he’s being left behind. Matt has performed stand-up on the BAFTA-winning The Lateish Show with Mo Gilligan (C4) and supported prominent comedians Paul Chowdhry and Babatunde Aléshé on tour.

shows.title: Ralf Wetzel: Absolutely Reliable! Solo-Mask-Show
shows.description: “Absolutely Reliable!” is a dark comedy that explores the vulnerability of a man in love from his skewball perspective in a delightfully comic monologue. George negotiates the tangled web of his increasingly darker side and confronts the struggles of surrender and commitment when he meets his true love. A surrealistic, rollicking, slightly creepy look into his world sheds tender light on the condition of contemporary intimacy.

shows.title: Comedians Play Video Games
shows.description: From Smash Bros to Tomb Raider, Goose Game to Mario Kart, a brief detour via Tetris and a pitstop at Pikmin: join Jake Baker, Steffan Alun and Cerys Bradley as they present a revolving line-up of comedians doing battle for Gamer Glory. A late-night anarchic gameshow with big laughs, big prizes and a little bit of nerdy chaos. ‘Like GamesMaster but without the sexism’ (Audience Review)

shows.title: Nerine Skinner: Decisions, Decisions (Work In Progress)
shows.description: BGT Semi-Finalist, Nerine Skinner, has always been indecisive and needs your help. Ever since she was little making the smallest decision has been tricky. In 2023 Nerine came runner up in the Funny Women Awards and in 2024 took her debut show to Edinburgh, “Nerine Skinner: The Exorcism of Liz Truss” receiving 5-star reviews and a sold out run. Join Nerine in her second work in progress hour as she asks for your help to decide what should be in her show. Stand up, songs and character comedy. This could change! You decide! “A Comedy Extravaganza” Funny Women

shows.title: 2 Muslim 2 Furious 2: Go Halal or Go Home
shows.description: After a sold out run at the Edinburgh Fringe, and having raised over £4000 for Medical Aid for Palestinians, Aisha Amanduri (Runner-up Bath Comedy Fest. New Act Award) and Hasan Al-Habib (winner B’ham Comedy Fest. Breaking Talent Award 2023) ARE BACK! Tired of being called terrorists, Hasan and Aisha became something much worse: comedians! See the double act people are already calling “Anwar and Dec-ina” 25% of artist’s proceeds go to the charity Medical Aid for Palestinians. “slick delivery with stereotype-crushing material” – Rolling Stone “Deliciously funny” – The Guardian

shows.title: Ignacio Lopez: Nada
shows.description: Ignacio Lopez (Live at the Apollo, Have I Got News For You) creates an hour of blisteringly funny stand-up right in front of your very eyes! Mining his unique and hilarious upbringing, as well as suggestions from the audience, Ignacio crafts an intricate story of mystery and suspense from nothing. Expect sarcasm and silliness in this captivating comedic experiment from the Spanish/Welsh humourist. ‘Charming, charismatic, hilarious. Will have you leaving with a smile on your face’ Deadline News. ‘A comedic genius at work. Sharp wit mixed with a dose of the ridiculous. A must see’ One4Review

shows.title: Jim Smallman: Comedy Will Never Die (But You Will)
shows.description: 20 years ago, Jim Smallman performed at the Leicester Comedy Festival for the first time. Award nominated multiple times, this is his first comedy performance since 2018 when he walked away to be a dad, write a book, work in TV and eventually, get more tattoos, have his life fall to pieces, move to the USA and nearly die. So there’s a bit to catch up on, back in his home town, trying to prove that you never truly leave comedy behind. This isn’t a comeback, it’s a love letter to an industry. “Beautiful comedy from the stand up who wears his life on his skin” – The Sunday Times

shows.title: Marise Gaughan: Work In Progress
shows.description: Critically acclaimed comedian and Irish bestseller Marise Gaughan debuts a story about addiction (but not the serious TED-Talk kind, swear.) Expect sex (with old dudes for money), rehab (with a lad addicted to Rolexes), and dating a surf instructor (tale as old as time). A sharp, darkly hilarious take on self-destruction, life lessons, and potatoes, based on her ‘outstanding’ (Business Post) debut memoir Trouble. Some good, clean fun, depending on your definition of words.

shows.title: Stephanie Laing: Rudder
shows.description: ***** “Heartfelt, powerful and very very funny. This is a show you will be thinking about for years to come.” Neurodiverse Review **** “Stephanie could probably read the shipping forecast and make an amazing show, she’s got such warmth, confidence and presence.” One4Review A comedy dance show about balance. Stephanie has a history of falling over a lot, accidentally kneeing herself in the face, and falling in love with kn*bheads. In Rudder she uses a mix of stand-up and dance to talk about bodies, sex, dancing, liking yourself, consent and healing. Also, there are cartoon bears and burlesque.

shows.title: Aaron Simmonds: Death
shows.description: A stand up comedy show from a comedian that cannot stand up. A show all about death that is truly life affirming. And a third thing. Aaron Simmonds, as seen on QI (BBC2), Russell Howard Hour (Sky), The Stand Up Sketch Show (ITV) and more has been an award-winning comedian for over a decade, entertaining audiences across the UK and the world, and yet, he maintains the funniest thing he’s ever done is at a funeral. *Content warning* Swearing, Sex and Suicidal ideation (not at the same time).

shows.title: Dave Chawner: Mental
shows.description: Stand-up about mental health (NOT mental illness). Celebrating good mental health by having a laugh. For people sick of all the sob stories and pity porn. As seen on BBC, ITV and Channel 5. As heard on BBC Radio 1, BBC Radio 2 and BBC Radio 4. Warning – this show doesn’t mention ADHD ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ – Arts Award Voice ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ – Bunbury Magazine ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ – Voice Mag ★ ★ ★ ★ – The List ★ ★ ★ ★ – Edinburgh Festival Magazine ★ ★ ★ ★ – Three Weeks ★ ★ ★ ★ – Broadway Baby ★ ★ ★ ★ – Broadway World ★ ★ ★ ★ – Wee Review ★ ★ ★ ★ – On The Mic ★ ★ ★ ★ – Entertainment Now ★ ★ ★ ★ – Ed Fringe Review ★ ★ ★ ★ –

shows.title: Kitty Cassis: Hiya!
shows.description: Dive into the wonderful world of Kitty’s salon, where you’re not just a spectator, but an active participant. Get ready to be entertained by the vivacious and totally trustworthy beautician, listening to her quirky tales while getting your imaginary hair done. Expect a mix of scripted and spontaneous comedy, soulful tunes, and, of course, heaps of clowning around. It’s an hour of pure fun and laughter, where every seat is the best in the house because you’re right in the thick of the action!

shows.title: The Comedy Store Players
shows.description: An improvised show from the stars of ‘Whose Line Is It Anyway’. The resident Impro troupe from the most famous comedy club in the world, The Comedy Store Players have been delighting audiences for over 30 years. Don’t miss this rare opportunity to see the original stars of ‘Whose Line is it Anyway?’ strutting their stuff on tour. Expect lightning-quick reactions and world-class silliness! There’ll be improvised songs and games and, of course, the audience is always at the helm, leading the show with its suggestions.

shows.title: Tom Mayhew: Destroy Capitalism or Die Tryin’
shows.description: Tom Mayhew brings a WIP of a new show to Leicester Comedy Festival! As heard on BBC Radio 4 (Tom Mayhew is Benefit Scum) and nominated for the Leicester Mercury Comedian of the year, this show is about capitalism, rap music and Bob the Builder.

shows.title: Word! Comedy Special
shows.description: WORD! – a spoken word and poetry organisation presenting one of the longest running spoken word nights in the UK – presents an evening of high jinx and hilarity. Featuring – Guardian, Kew Gardens and Royal Albert Hall commissioned, Lydia Towsey ‘- and Tim Bombdog, Leicester’s only post-punk poet + magician, musician and comedian… ’You name it, he can do it’ (Lydia). With special guests, an open mic of the region’s finest, and the infamous WORD! Raffle. For more info head to @wordlesta on Instagram.

shows.title: Proper Funny Comedy at The Wheatsheaf Inn (Thurcaston)
shows.description: Comedy At The Alley returns for this year’s Leicester Comedy Festival with an unmissable mixed bill comedy showcase. The event features some of the UK’s finest comedic talent, promising an evening full of laughter and unforgettable moments. Last year’s show, held at the award-nominated Wheatsheaf Inn, was a phenomenal success. Tickets sold out in days, highlighting the immense popularity and anticipation surrounding the event. The night will be expertly MC’d by Jason Neale, a celebrated Leicester comedian and a veteran of the Leicester Comedy Festival. This is a comedy night you won’t want

shows.title: Sara Louise Aston wants to be famous
shows.description: “When will I, will I be famous?” asked Bros. And that’s what Sara Louise Aston asks herself all the time. When will she be famous? In the show, Sara tells us stories of the bonkers measures she has taken to try and become famous. It’s not happened yet but she is trying and God loves a tryer. So sit back in your seat and take this charming and colourful ride with Sara as she describes the tales of the good, the bad and the quirky ways of how she has attempted to find fame. And who knows: maybe this show will make her famous? (Spoiler – probably not, but it will be fun!)

shows.title: Celine Kuklowsky: Bed Boy (WIP)
shows.description: Bed Boy is the debut comedy hour of Celine Kuklowsky, an American existential comedian who spends a lot of time in bed. As the proud host of global phenomenon Multiple Sclerosis, Celine is sick and tired and also tired and sick. Join Celine as they investigate the planned obsolescence of their body, yours and the planet at large.

shows.title: Kat Higgins: In Memory Of Me WIP
shows.description: Kat wants to be remembered- in truth, she’s hard to forget. But in looking back on her life, she has come to the realisation that she’s a bit of a prick? And actually she’s okay with that cause so is everyone else she knows. . . Bringing her highly anticipated debut show, Kat is a powerhouse combination of Irish charm and cutting wit. An anecdotal, bold but friendly comic she made her T.V. debut on both BBC One & BBC Three as part of the BBC New Comedy Awards. Having supported Rosie Jones, Janine Harouni & Tatty Macleod on sold out tours she is ready to bring audiences her first solo show

shows.title: Diane Spencer Coming Together
shows.description: With her adult humour and posh voice, Diane has been described as “Mary Poppins on crack”. Charming and warm, Diane interweaves stories with a unique perspective, packing her shows full of punchlines. Expect jokes on sexual mishaps, bonkers parents and pushy psychics. “Not for the faint-hearted but also not to be missed” ***** ThreeWeeks. Diane Spencer has written 10 stand-up specials which are all available to watch on YouTube. Self-deprecating not political, saucy not crude; a club comic for 15 years, Diane has garnered multiple 4/5 star reviews and has a growing online fan base.

shows.title: Pauline Eyre: Anyone For Tennis?
shows.description: ANYONE FOR TENNIS? A Wimbledon line judge for 20 years, comedian Pauline Eyre is ready to spill the Pimms on tennis gossip from the fragrant royal box to the musty locker room, and why line judges are OUT! Expect smashing stories, ace anecdotes and a 40 – love letter to the game. And there’s nobody to say ‘quiet please’. She cannot be serious… can she? Fresh from sold-out run at Edinburgh Fringe 2025. As featured in/on The Guardian, Sunday Post, The Times, The Guardian, Daily Mail, BBC 5 Live, Radio Wimbledon, Der Spiegel, TVNZ, ABC Australia..

shows.title: Alastair Clark: On The Record
shows.description: High fidelity stand-up comedy. After almost a decade of shifting vinyl in an independent record shop, Alastair brings you an hour about the stark reality of living the dream. A show that waxes lyrical about crate digging, needle dropping and arguing with children about Fred Durst. “Playful, smart, and quietly ambitious” – ★★★★ One4Review. “Thoroughly engaging… Genuinely moving” – Clash Magazine. “Revealing insight into life at a record store” – British Comedy Guide. Insiders Pick of Free Fringe Shows – The QR. 10×10 Musical Genre Shows – Chortle.

shows.title: Eric Lampaert: Zero Minus One
shows.description: After a brush with total amnesia, a mind wiped clean, comedian Eric Lampaert (“Lamb Pear”) returns from the void with questions only madness can answer, fractured memories, multiple personalities, and a darkly funny perspective on what it means to be human. “Provides a constant frisson of energy with his loose, animated style” (Chortle) “A galaxy of brilliant silliness. Lampaert is able to contort his body and voice in the most sinister of ways” (The Fest) “This is a man with very funny bones.” (Daily Express)

shows.title: Kit Sullivan: Gherkin Toe Press
shows.description: Gherkin Toe Press is the latest not-thought-out show from untrained nincompoop Kit Sullivan. A surreal hour of random ideas, dead ends, and friendship, once described as a modern-day Work in Progress (hey, that rhymes with the title!). Expect nonsense, oddness, and big feelings, possibly a sandwich, a debate with a chair leg, and something duck related. Come on home, strap in, and ride the lightning. It might be set on a desert island, depends how much sand I can afford. Y’know what that’s gonna be heavy af, scratch that, as you were. Dessert Island Maybe? Wheelbarrow of Angel Delight? GET IN!

shows.title: Roger O’Sullivan: Only Messing Gear Solid (Work in progress)
shows.description: Roger O’Sullivan is a comedian on a mission to generate new material for his next show. After a sold out run at the Edinburgh Fringe festival with his debut show Fekken, the stakes are high and hopefully the laughs are higher. Your mission should you choose to accept it is to come and find out if he’s done it again Winner of the Comedians Choice Best Newcomer 2025 and Nominated for Best Newcomer at The Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2025 Find him on the internet @rogerocomedy. “Talents like O’Sullivan don’t come around very often” – Rolling Stone “Absolutely hilarious”- Fern Brady

shows.title: Susan Harrison: Should I Still Be Doing This?
shows.description: Award winning character comedian Susan Harrison presents her latest fun-filled, unpredictable and interactive solo show. Featuring a host of joyfully bizarre characters including an unconfident Sindy doll, a woman who’s swallowed a girl in a well, and a 90’s panda. Is it ok to still be dressing up as weird characters as you get older? Join Susan as she tries to find out, whilst dressing up as weird characters. Directed by Ben Target. “Deliriously funny” **** The List. “Unadulterated fun” **** Broadway Baby. Seen/heard in: Showstopper! The Improvised Musical, Mischief Movie Night, BBC Radio 4.

shows.title: The Universe Speaks
shows.description: The universe speaks, whether we choose to listen or not. Just Improv’s ‘spectacular’ long-form improvised comedy finds the humour in our fascination with superstition, belief and fate. You are the Universe. You will guide our characters through sliding doors moments that could change their lives forever. How would your life be different if you listened to the signs around you? Just Improv have been showcasing their ‘wild wit’ since 2022, performing sell-out shows at Brighton, Camden and Edinburgh Fringe Festivals. Based in London, this is their debut Leicester Comedy Festival.

shows.title: The3WiseMen (The First Coming)
shows.description: The 3WiseMen come bearing musical gifts: their songs are a mix of social commentary, surreal observations and witty wordplay. The success of the ironic duo comes from the clever crafting of their songs, the character chemistry and the tension between upbeat optimism and downtrodden cynicism, bringing laughs as they take the audience on a musical journey. The show has minimal religious content but you may find out why Jesus was a chippy carpenter.

shows.title: Alex Bertulis-Fernandes: May Find Distressing (Work-In-Progress)
shows.description: Alex Bertulis-Fernandes (British Comedy Guide Pro Award Winner, Channel 4 Sean Lock Finalist, BBC New Comedy Awards Nominee) presents an hour about the worst year of her life (so far). Longlisted for the ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Newcomer and shortlisted for the ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Joke of the Fringe. Warning: This show contains content you may find distressing. If you don’t, you have a cold, cold heart. Previous subjects discussed include (in order of popularity): dating, dogs, death, body image, sexual harassment and suicide. It’s gonna be a riot.

shows.title: Cat Scully: Sticks & Rhinestones (WIP)
shows.description: After a difficult couple of years, Cat has dusted herself off, ready to laugh again. Hailing from Canada but now stuck in England, you’ll hear how Cat flexes her stoicism to take on life’s hurdles. Park yourselves and listen while Cat wrangles through some erroneous life decisions. You never know, you might even make a friend.

shows.title: Kemah Bob: Love Child (WIP)
shows.description: Kemah’s been thinking about her inheritance. Not about money passed down, because there’s none of that, but everything else her genes are riddled with. Her last show was chosen as one of the Guardian’s Top 10 Comedy Shows of 2024. Come watch her try to make another one. Kemah Bob is a London based Texas native seen on Richard Osman’s House of Games, Jonathan Ross’ Comedy Club, PLS Like, Fully Blown and Guessable. ‘Bob is a is a great storyteller’ ★★★★ Arts Desk ‘Chest-achingly funny… an exciting glimpse into the future of stand-up, with Kemah Bob at the helm’ ★★★★ Skinny

shows.title: Stuart McPherson: Crisps and a Lie Down
shows.description: Join Scottish comedy powerhouse Stu for the Leicester Comedy Festival debut of his critically-acclaimed new show about settling down, growing up and how he’s being controlled by his step-dog. In this sensational hour, the host of smash-hit podcast Some Laugh and star of BBC Scotland’s Scot Squad pokes fun at 30-something relationships, generational divides and why he doesn’t want to die surrounded by loved ones. “Hilarious” Comedy.co.uk. “Remarkable hit-rate” Rolling Stone. ***** EdFringeReview. **** The Scotsman. **** The List. **** The Skinny. **** ThreeWeeks.

shows.title: 100% authentic secret to achieving complete existential fulfilment (includes free biscuits)
shows.description: Death, biscuits and bad decisions – it all makes sense in the end. An hour of stand-up about everything that matters (and plenty that doesn’t). Expect sharp gags, strange stories, and more than one wrong turn, all tied together in a way that shouldn’t work but somehow does. Mischievous, darkly funny and occasionally daft, it’s an hour of comedy, questionable wisdom, and free biscuits. You might leave with a few answers, a lot of laughs, and a new appreciation for the absurd. “Draper knows how to mine the dark corners of Life for comedy value” – Fringe Review.

shows.title: Circuit Breakers
shows.description: THE chance within the festival to see the stars of the future from the best of emerging UK comedians & hosted by Sian Davies. We have carefully selected those acts who have been gigging for a while but have yet to break into the big time. Trust us; you’ll be seeing these acts in arenas soon so come and see them so you can tell your friends you saw them before they were famous… 2026 Line Up: Kathy Rivett Ben Treloar Louis Beer Phoebe Taylor Ibs Sesay Mia Lewis

shows.title: Gay Comedy Night
shows.description: The longest running gay comedy night in the UK is back, platforming hilarious LGBTQ+ comedians for over 28 years. This year, as always, we’ll bring you some of the best LGBTQ+ comics on the scene, nationally and from the Midlands – previous acts have included Rosie Jones, Jess Fostekew, Olga Koch, Zoe Lyons, Graham Norton, Susan Calman, Jen Brister and Stephen K Amos. This year we’ve put together our biggest line-up yet to celebrate our 125th anniversary year; featuring Sophie Duker, Sikisa, Andrew White, Jodie Mitchell and newcomer Ciaran Shea, with compere Jonathan Mayor.

shows.title: Ian Murphy: £1Million to None
shows.description: What happens when you lose £1 Million on a live TV gameshow. You write a comedy set about it of course. It is cheaper than therapy afterall. Find out about all the backstage goings on, the real reasons why I lost and what Ant and Dec are really like! Oh and how I played my part in Harry Styles superstardom. Some or all of that may or may not be true, however come and relive the moment my life changed in front of 9M people, right there in their living room.

shows.title: Ian Smith: Foot Spa Half Empty
shows.description: Nominated for Best Show at the Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2025 Two-time Edinburgh Comedy Award nominee Ian Smith (co-host of the Northern News podcast) heads back out on tour with his critically acclaimed new show about stress, love and buying a magic spell off Amazon. As seen on Live at the Apollo, Have I Got News For You and The Stand Up Sketch Show – and heard on The News Quiz, The Unbelievable Truth, Just A Minute and his own Radio 4 series, Ian Smith is Stressed. Ian is also a former runner-up in Next Up’s “Biggest Award in Comedy” and former nominee for a Chortle Award for Best Show.

shows.title: Joz Norris Is Hugh Jackman Is The Phantom Of The Opera
shows.description: 20 years ago Hugh Jackman was offered the role of the Phantom of the Opera, a role Joz Norris has dreamed about his entire life. He turned it down. Now, an artist known for taking himself too seriously despite his creative output consisting of utter nonsense will play another one in this musical extravaganza that will reset the course of history. “Captures the spirit of creative Fringe comedy” – Guardian “Laughs upon ridiculous laughs” – Chortle Winner of the Comedians’ Choice Award for Best Show Creator and star of BBC Radio 4’s The Dream Factory and A Small Talk On Small Talk

shows.title: Luke McQueen: Comedian’s Comedian
shows.description: After years of being overlooked by The Comedian’s Comedian Podcast, Luke McQueen has stopped waiting for the invite — using artificial intelligence, he’s recording the episode himself. Live. Part stand-up, part psychological breakdown, Comedian’s Comedian was one of the best reviewed shows at the Edinburgh Fringe. Directed by Jordan Brookes. ★★★★★ Skinny – “very, very funny.” ★★★★ The Guardian – “relentless fun.” ★★★★ The Times – “fascinating, funny & toe-curlingly personal.” NB: Customers wishing to book a wheelchair space should contact our Box Office on 0116 261 6812 (10am-4pm, Mon-Fri)

shows.title: Michael Akadiri: Don’t Call Me Uncle! (Tour Preview)
shows.description: Multi-award-winning comedian Michael is proud to wear many hats: doctor, husband & father. Evidently, that list does not include uncle. Yet, despite only being in his early 30s, “the supremely talented” (Metro) doctor was recently called uncle in public (a term usually reserved for elders!). This has sent him spiralling! Join the ”‘hugely entertaining” (Chortle) Akadiri as he fights this lurid allegation, contemplates the difference between perception and reality all whilst keeping the laughs flowing with his trademark “sharp-wit” (Chortle) & “politically punchy” (Guardian) anecdotes.

shows.title: Phil Green: A Broken Man’s Guide to Fixing Others
shows.description: Having definitely, totally 100% recovered from a breakdown, Phil now presents a show to save us all from a mental health crisis (well, maybe not everyone). Following his third sold-out Edinburgh Fringe run, multiple award nominations, over 20 million views on TikTok and selling out London’s Soho Theatre, Phil brings us a life-changing new show. As heard on Radio 4. Top 13 Shows of the Edinburgh Fringe. British Comedy Guide recommended show. **** The List **** North West End “Phil Green is the real deal….he wows the room into gushes of laughter” British Comedy Guide.

shows.title: Ross Noble: Cranium of Curiosities
shows.description: Roll up, roll up! Or use a more conventional form of transport to get to the show. Unless you accidentally become trapped in a barrel*. Should that happen, then just find an incline and start rolling to see the one and only Ross Noble! He is the Wizard of Waffle, The Rambler Royale, The Noodlers’ Noodler, and he’s back live on stage to tour a tornado of tangents. What the show will be about is anybody’s guess, but that’s all part of the fun when you look inside his Cranium of Curiosities. *We strongly advise trying not to get trapped in a barrel before or during the performance.

shows.title: Some-Antics Comedy Slam
shows.description: A one-off comedy competition open to any comedian, with a cash prize of £100! The audience will choose the winner by means of voting so come and see some amazing comedy and decide who’s best!

shows.title: The Bazaar Presents: Arabian Nights Live!
shows.description: A comedy cabaret of Middle Eastern delights! A bold, high-energy interactive variety show unlike anything else at the festival—where ancient epics collide with the beautifully chaotic reality of diaspora life. Brought to you by Europe’s first all-SWANA comedy improv troupe. Part improv show, part music gig, part unruly family gathering. Blending hilarious scenes, original songs, and live instrumentation—with no shortage of satire—it reimagines the rebellious spirit of the 1001 Nights tales through a modern lens. Caution: There may be camels. ★★★★★ “Sheer comedy genius” Fringe Review

shows.title: Adele Cliff Tries Out Her New Jokes (WIP)
shows.description: Multi award winning comedian Adele Cliff has a whole bunch of new jokes she’d love to say at you, and ideally enjoy with you. Bring friends or acquaintances you hope to befriend. Praise for Adele’s previous shows: ***** “Master of comedy” – Theatre Matters ***** “Truly Funny” – TLA Adelaide ***** “Guaranteed Laughs” – The Student Newspaper **** “A-list Jokes – The Comic’s Comic **** “Heartfelt storytelling and incredibly astute observations” – Hugging comedians **** “takes her job to be silly very seriously and it certainly pays off” – Edfringe Review **** “funny well written” One 4 Review

shows.title: Fancy a Laugh?
shows.description: As part of the 2026 Leicester Comedy Festival we welcome some of the finest stand ups on the scene to The Harborough Octagonal Theatre for your laughing pleasure! Adam Beardsmore “One of our favourite new acts of the festival” – Leicester Comedy Festival Joey Page “A stylish comedian with a sonic imagination and a twinkle in his eye” – Noel Fielding Jack Campbell “Funny and refreshingly inventive” – House of Stand Up Louise Leigh, Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year Finalist 2022 “Like the kind of Radio 2 DJ who’d be caught in the gossip columns… Brilliant” – The Wee Review

shows.title: Flying Fox Comedy Club
shows.description: Join us at Leicestershire Aero Club for a fantastic night of comedy, headlined by comedy legend Arthur Smith! You may have seen Arthur on Qi, Have I Got News For You, Red Dwarf, Grumpy Old Men, Are You Being Served?, Never Mind The Buzzcocks and many more. He’ll be joined by English Comedian of the Year Winner, Jack Campbell and top compere Jay Neale. Don’t miss a chance to catch a comedy legend at this breath-taking venue.

shows.title: Foxton Comedy Club
shows.description: 8pm Age 18+ As part of the 2026 Leicester Comedy Festival we welcome the return of our always sold out, and always epic comedy to Funny Foxton for your laughing pleasure! Featuring some of the best acts from the UK comedy circuit of James Cook, Louise Leigh, Sarah Johnson and headlined by Joey Page! Do note that line-up is subject to change.

shows.title: The Crowd Work Competition
shows.description: The comedy showdown where the audience is the material! No rehearsed jokes. No safety nets. Each comedian gets a handful of audience members to work with — and only crowd work is allowed. Quick wit, sharp banter, and spontaneous laughs are the only tools they’ve got. At the end of the night, you decide who ruled the room. The comic with the most votes takes home the prize — and bragging rights as the champion!

shows.title: Aideen McQueen: Waiting for Texto
shows.description: Part Stand-up comedy, part play, Waiting for Texto is a hilarious, painfully accurate depiction of the angst of unrequited love. Described as “Bridget Jones meets Baby Reindeer”, This play is for anyone who’s agonised over sending a text. jokes, poingnant moments and a twist! Terrifically impressive, warm and funny – 4 Stars, The Scotsman – I loved this play and can’t wait to see what Aideen writes next. She’s a keeper! One4review 4.5 Stars -An hour of beautiful solo writing, brashly, boldly and skilfully delivered, with deeper roots into some important questions about life, – Funny Women

shows.title: Caitlin Powell is Buffering (WIP)
shows.description: The world is loud, slow and often wrong. Join Caitlin Powell (BBC New Comedy Award Nominee, Funny Women, and LGBTQ+ New Comedian finalist), as she smashes every button on the keyboard and tries to work out what the hell is going on. A work in progress that will resonate with the girls, gays and theys (or anyone with the pattern recognition of a bloodhound). ‘Brilliant’ – Jen Brister

shows.title: Mrs Smith: 123 Eyes on Me!
shows.description: Ever wondered what your teacher was thinking, let Facebook’s Mrs Smith enlighten you! Mrs Smith was an ordinary teacher in an ordinary school until she went viral on Facebook and accidentally became a stand up comedian…. 1,2,3, Eyes on Me! is the follow up to her sell-out show of 2023 that debuted at the Edinburgh Fringe. ‘Mrs Smith transforms the stage into a classroom of laughter and nostalgia’ ‘Hilarious – a very big gold star for Mrs Smith!

shows.title: Opinion War with Rob Manuel from Anon_Opin
shows.description: “Dr Who is just a f****** LibDem who enjoys disaster tourism. Can stick his sonic screwdriver up his a**e.” We live in a divisive world of horrible opinions, but what if instead, we rowed over really trivial ones? That’s the question your host Rob Manuel is asking, and with over 300,000 opinions submitted so far, he’s got a few opinions himself. Join this interactive show where you should bring your own hot takes too and see if “nobody wants to see your cat walking across camera in your work video call” is acceptable or not (it’s not).

shows.title: Working Through it
shows.description: Working Through It a split bill of rising comedy stars you need to watch. Expect sharp material, clever storytelling & plenty of laughs. Mackenzie Pike is a girls’ girl in a man’s world… literally. Working with her dad in the trades while navigating a quarter-life crisis, she serves up sass, chaos, and honest takes on life and work. Sonny Savage is a dynamic & fast-paced South East London stand-up comedian known for his silly and observational style. His quick-witted persona frequently delves into dark humour, social anxieties, historical curiosities & the absurdities of everyday modern life.

shows.title: David Ferguson: Trivial Hirsute (WIP)
shows.description: David Ferguson is trying to figure things out. Join him to discover together what works and what doesn’t on stage and in life. After a series of setbacks( from homelessness, nearly dying and losing out on a eBay auction) David Ferguson is trying to make his dreams come true. Life is a hairy situation. Can David fix his hair? David Ferguson co- host of @believecobspiracypod is a popular comic on the London circuit. He has had sold out shows at the Vault Festival and Brighton Fringe. With a likeable stage presence David moves between impactful one liners and raw unpredictability.

shows.title: Jack McLean: Yours Insincerely (WIP)
shows.description: BBC New Comedy Awards 2023 Semi-Finalist Jack McLean brings his debut hour to the Leicester Comedy Festival. A hilarious stand-up show all about insincerity, lies and authenticity. After his appearance on BBC Three, Jack has gone on to support various acts on their national tours including Josh Jones, Fiona Allen, Morgan Rees and more! The Hull Comedian of the Year 2022 and Yorkshire Comedy Awards Best Breakthrough Act 2023 is a rising star on the UK Comedy Circuit. One of the best new acts on the circuit – Josh Jones An absolute star. Very, very funny & likeable – The Stand

shows.title: Joe Kent-Walters is Frankie Monroe: DEAD!!! (Good Fun Times)
shows.description: Yorkshire’s biggest bastard and Edinburgh Comedy Award Best Newcomer 2024 is back, after yet another sold-out run at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival! This time he’s dead… dead good! And also, dead. He’s a dead man. Join the nation’s favourite demonic entertainer, owner of a Working Mens Club in Rotherham what is also a portal to hell, as he dazzles you from beyond the grave. See him now before he is well and truly gone.

shows.title: Joshua Bethania: Untitled Document
shows.description: Winner of So You Think You’re Funny 2022, Joshua Bethania presents an early version of his second hour, exploring how he can be an optimist while being an unapologetic cynic. Teetering on the edge of madness, he asks: shouldn’t we all be a little mad? He hasn’t figured out the conclusion yet – come see if he can figure it out. As seen on Comedy Central, BBC and Channel 4.

shows.title: Siblings: Dreamweavers
shows.description: After a sell out run at The Edinburgh Fringe 2025, Award-winning character comedians and IRL Sisters, Maddy and Marina Bye (Byes), are back. Finally, their research is complete and you get the first glimpse into their incredibly innovative invented invention. Set your alarms and see Siblings swoop into the surreal world of your sleeping minds as they crack open your brains and backflip in. Gird your loins for a knock(ed) out hour of absurd, raucous and down right delirious comedy. So Savagely Funny’ ★★★★★ EdFringeReview, ‘Bone Achingly Funny’ ★★★★★ Three Weeks, ★★★★ The Scotsman, ★★★★ The List

shows.title: Jacob Nussey: Table For One
shows.description: Jacob Nussey unassumingly draws in audiences with his deadpan style, sharp jokes, and ill-fated anecdotes with clever punchlines. Jacob quickly established himself on the comedy circuit, being named by Chortle as one to watch in 2023. After winning Bury Met Comedian of the Year, and West Didsbury Comedy Festival New Act of the Year. He’s seriously funny! “Hilariously Nonchalant… Impeccable Deadpan Delivery” – Broadway World ★★★★★ “Insanely funny, he’ll be a household name before you know it” – Skiddle “Brilliant and bloody hilarious” – On The Mic

shows.title: The Ritual
shows.description: Uh oh… This Leicester Comedy Festival, The Master and his loyal servant Gregor shall be summoned to conduct The Ritual. Blood will be collected. Woe betide you if it is not to the Master’s taste. The spookiest vampire spectacle awaits. Do you dare to accept this invitation? Winner: Best Comedy – The Spookies 2024 Best Variety Show nominee – Leicester Comedy Festival 2025 ‘A growing “”cult”” following’ ☆☆☆☆☆-(NorthWestEnd.co.uk). ‘Unhinged vampiric comedy ☆☆☆☆☆-(Edinburgh Reviews)

shows.title: Alex Leam: Two Turntables and a Microphone
shows.description: Alex Leam used to be a DJ but quit as he had enough of doing weddings. Then he became a comedian. Now he’s combining the two. Expect to have your favourite songs ruined. ‘A winning line in self-deprecation’ (Chortle.co.uk) ‘He’s a funny man, and great company’ -Buxton Fringe ‘Excellent, a natural entertainer!’, ‘This is what you want, a comedian making your face ache and tears roll from your eyes. Alex is brilliant!’ (Ed Fringe Audience reviews).

shows.title: FOC IT UP! COMEDY CLUB
shows.description: Since 2018, Femmes of Colo(u)r Comedy Club has presented the fiercest mixed bills celebrating the perspectives of comedians of colour who aren’t cis-men. Curated by founder Kemah Bob, disrupting the status quo and fighting tokenism with a 100% no-white-dudes-onstage guarantee. FOC IT UP has hit London, Edinburgh, Latitude with electric, sell-out shows and big energy. ‘A new generation of comics retaliating against the old template of comedy.’ Guardian ‘A riot of positivity and inclusivity.’ Evening Standard Starring: Kemah Bob Sikisa Sajeela Kershi Aisha Amanduri Alex Bertulis Fernandes

shows.title: Alexandra’s Dark Comedy Extravaganza
shows.description: Alexandra Krekan, queen of the borderline, has assembled a lineup that will leave you feeling like you need an exorcism. The comedy is dark but the energy is vibrant, so leave your sensibilities at home and come join in on the sadistic fun. A Friday the 13th that none of us will ever forget!

shows.title: Giddy Aunt Improv: Late Night Laughs
shows.description: “The best improv I’ve ever seen!” – The Telegraph. Join Giddy Aunt Improv after dark for their late-night dose of fast and daft comedy. Expect a storm of sketches, songs, and games, all invented from audience suggestions in the moment. With four years running at Leicester Comedy Festival, sold-out stints at the Edinburgh Fringe, and guest spots on Radio 4, they know how to keep the laughter flowing. This late-night show is rowdy, cheeky, and gleefully unhinged – think your aunties out way past bedtime, beer in hand, and absolutely loving it.

shows.title: Will BF: Bonq… License to Die
shows.description: James Bonq has been the UK’s favourite movie spy for 100 years. In 2026 the franchise has been bought by a shady multinational, and they’re bringing back every past Bonq actor for one more film before they hypercommercialise it. Little do they know, the beloved franchise isn’t the only thing that will be gutted tonight. It’s a brand new side-splitting horror mockumentary (that will both shake and stir you) from award winning comedian Will BF. *Leicester Comedy Festival Award Nominee 2024* *Buxton Fringe Best Comedy Show Winner 2025* *Brighton Fringe Award Nominee 2025* *UK Pun Champion 2025*

shows.title: 14/48 Takeover: Workshops
shows.description: Young people write the plays, and we stage them. 14/48 Takeover gives young writers aged 8-12 the chance to work with professional playwrights and theatre makers to produce four new plays, brought to life for family audiences. Each writer attends four sessions (morning/afternoon) at Attenborough Arts Centre.

shows.title: Box of Frogs Comedy Improv for Kids
shows.description: Join us for a family-friendly show of fast-paced, completely improvised comedy full of jokes and surprises. The Frogs will spontaneously create games, stories, scenes and musical numbers – all based entirely on audience suggestions

shows.title: The Little Ritual
shows.description: Welcome to The Little Ritual, where you will meet two ‘real’ vampires, Spooky and Gregor. No one is spookier than Spooky… Gregor, his loyal assistant, will ensure everything goes according to plan. If you’ve ever dreamed of transforming into a bat, becoming invisible or wondered how to live forever, join us for this thrilling interactive comedy. Produced by NIGHTBULB alongside The Ritual. Praise for The Ritual: Winner: Best Comedy – The Spookies 2024 Best Variety Show nominee – Leicester Comedy Festival 2025 ‘A growing “cult” following’ ☆☆☆☆☆-(NorthWestEnd.co.uk).

shows.title: Joey Page: Knucklehead (WIP)
shows.description: Joey Page stares down the idea that he about half way through his life and doesn’t have a dog or a kid or an air fryer. He barely has a job. His job is to write this blurb then turn it into a funny show. Wow what a life. Good job he’s funny and strangely handsome dead eyed kind of way. Come see this higgledy Piggledy new work from one of Britain’s coolest comedians (self proclaimed) No idea who Joey is? Well its time to wake up and get ticket. “A funny man, makes me laugh whenever he speaks” Rob Beckett. 4 stars chortle 5 stars 3 weeks

shows.title: Lil Wenker: BOYKING
shows.description: ALL HAIL BOYKING! 37 pounds and 3 feet tall, 8 year-old Joffrey (no relation) seeks power at all costs including but not limited to: death, destruction & mayhem.
