His crown is mighty, his word is law, his favourite snack… Mummy’s Milk. Bow down—this coronation’s a killer. Created by the award-winning performer-director duo Lil Wenker and Cecily Nash. Praise for past work — BANGTAIL — Leicester Comedy Fest Nominee for Best Variety Show 2024 ★★★★★ Three Weeks ★★★★★ Voice Mag ​★★★★ Fest ​★★★★ The Age ​★★★★ Broadway Baby

shows.title: Sarah Johnson: Crafternoon With Carol
shows.description: Self-acclaimed Craftaholic, Carol, has been influencing the creative minds of multiple people for weeks now. Her work has been featured on all her own social media platforms. Carol’s mission -‘Inspire many humans to feel joy and confidence through cutting and sticking’. So why not join this phenomenal multi-crafter, in her Crafternoon Masterclass and take-home skills you never wanted. “Johnson is an excellent performer” 4.5**** (One4Review) https://sarahljohnson.co.uk/

shows.title: Joke Spot @ Brite Centre (Braunstone)
shows.description: Roll up! Roll up! Joke Spot makes you the star as we invite anyone under the age of 18 to take the mic and become a comedian. Our pop-up stage will be touring Leicester throughout the festival and it’s up to you to drop-in and tell us your best jokes. More venues may be announced throughout the festival, so keep an eye on our socials @kidscomedyfest or our website!

shows.title: Aidan Jones: Chopin’s Nocturne
shows.description: I grew up playing classical piano, but failed my conservatory audition at 18. After some time focusing on MDMA, I came back to the piano and now I’ve combined it with comedy. It’s my favourite piece, Chopin’s Nocturne in Eb Major, presented with jokes by a bald, Australian dickhead with a beard. Best Comedy Adelaide Fringe Weekly “Sidesplittingly funny.” The Guardian “Punchlines that will leave you laughing for days on end… This is what a well-crafted comedy set looks like!” ★★★★★ – Advertiser, Adelaide “A masterclass… this should not work, but it does. ★★★★★ – The List

shows.title: Box of Frogs Improv Comedy
shows.description: Box of Frogs is Birmingham’s premier improvised comedy group, making up sketches, scenes and songs based entirely on suggestions from the audience and bringing lots of fun, friviolity and silly nonsense for your entertainment. Nominated at last year’s Leicester Comedy Festival for Best Variety Show and winners of The Derek Award for Best Improv at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival 2025, you are guaranteed a laugh at one of our shows. Our children’s show is interactive, full of fun and suitable for 8+. Come along and see us at this years Leicester Comedy Festival!

shows.title: Olaf Falafel’s Stupidest Super Stupid Show – This Time It’s Stupider!
shows.description: Winner of the Best Kids’ Show at the 2024 Leicester Comedy Festival After a selling out at the Edinburgh Fringe for two years running, comedian and children’s author Olaf Falafel is dishing up another bubbling vat of family-friendly comedy. The comedy show that comedian take their kids to is back and even funnier! Join Olaf Falafel (if that is his real name) for an hour of kid’s comedy which will be the stupidest he has ever let ooze out of his brain. Expect jokes, futuristic dung beetles, truth-telling cheese and we might also all draw a Spewnicorn!

shows.title: Bilal Zafar: Salt Of The Earth – Work In Progress
shows.description: Bilal (Leicester Comedy Fest Best New Show nominee 2025 and other stuff) is back with a brand new show about his time working with Special Education needs children, his own school life, his ego, class and race but in a way that’s actually funny and interesting haha. As seen/heard on BBC 1, BBC 2, Channel 4, BBC Radio 4 and loads of other stuff that you might not find as interesting etc.

shows.title: I Think I’m Turning Japanese (I really think so, not!)
shows.description: Everything you ever wanted to know about Japan but were too otaku to ask! Join Sam Joseph on an exploration of his experiences in Japan (and Hawaii) over the last quarter century! “Superb” – Pete Dickenson (Scriptwriter and Movie Maker) “Very creative” – George Tothill (Chortle Student Comedy Award Finalist 2021) “Strangely watchable” – Gordana Mićić (Groovie Comedy) “Like a geek, grown up” – Markus Birdman (Britain’s Got Talent Finalist) “A breath of fresh air” – Travis Booth-Millard (New Forest New Comedian Finalist) “Hilarious” – Beth Fox (Full Time Yorkshire Pudding and Very Funny Perso

shows.title: Sami Abu-Wardeh: WIP
shows.description: An hour of comedy from Sami Abu Wardeh, a very silly man and trained clown, trying to shirk his newfound reputation as a serious, political theatremaker. “Defiantly goofy.” Guardian★★★★

shows.title: SHELF: The Kids Show 2 – The Power of Two
shows.description: Fresh from their first award winning family friendly sketch show, Rachel and Ruby are back. It’s double the funny, double the silly, double the sketch and it’s fun for children, their adults, and any ghosts or pigeons that wander in. Winners of Best Kids’ Show, 2023 Leicester Comedy Festival ★★★★ ‘Impossible not to have fun in their company’ Chortle ★★★★ ‘an absolutely storming show’ Scotsman

shows.title: Zoe Wohlfeld: Dog Funeral
shows.description: Take the “fun” out of “funeral” and throw the rest away! Zoe Wohlfeld (Ecole Philippe Gaulier trained clown) mourns the death of her childhood pet, Twinkles. In this absurd ode to loss, dogs, and the loss of dogs, she will demonstrate how to properly perform grief. Sadness is Zoe’s passion, and Twinkles was Zoe’s best friend, so join this solemn ceremony and let her teach you how to pay respects with the big boys (may they rest in peace). “A hilariously unconventional take on grief… . Masterfully orchestrated” -Cog Journal “Prima Donna of the Absurd” -Gutter Comedy

shows.title: Molly McGuinness: Slob
shows.description: Join Salford-born powerhouse Molly for her Edinburgh Comedy Award nominated debut show about what it means to be a slob. To Molly, life didn’t get any better than a good buffet and belting out Meatloaf down the pub karaoke. But when the Salford-born libertine was unexpectedly laid out by a life-threatening illness, Molly was forced to slob out whether she liked it or not… As seen on Comedy Central Live and heard on BBC Radio 4. BBC New Comedy Awards finalist. Tour support for Joe Lycett, Sophie Duker and Rachel Fairburn.

shows.title: Giddy Aunt Improv
shows.description: “The best improv I’ve ever seen!” – The Telegraph. Spend your afternoon in joyful chaos with Giddy Aunt Improv – your favourite comedy relatives. Their fast, fearless shows are packed with sketches, songs, and games, all invented on the spot from audience suggestions. With four years at Leicester Comedy Festival, sold-out Edinburgh Fringe runs, and Radio 4 appearances, they know how to deliver. Picture your aunties at lunch, having one too many beers, slowly losing it… and now everyone in the room gets to join the party.

shows.title: Fran Jenking: A Work in Progress (Something to do with Stuff)
shows.description: A work in progress comedy show… lots of ideas… loads of giggles! “Fabulous flights of fancy from an amenable onstage presence” – BBC “One to watch” – Manford’s Comedy Club

shows.title: Terry Pathic’s Multi Coloured Swap or no Swap
shows.description: Terry Pathic is Wakefield Metropolitan District Council’s and surronding postcode area premier, razamatz mind reader. After his soul was swapped for some magic beans from the Dark Lord of light entertainment Terry is on a quest to escape their shadow. Can Terry get on the Telly? Will he regain his soul? Will he discover who his real father is? What is the meaning of life? Most of these questions are answered in Terry’s first solo show! Stuart Vincent Moore is an award winning magician and was an honourable mention for Best New Act in 2024 Notts Comedy Review Awards.

shows.title: WiFi Wars – Interactive Comedy Game Show
shows.description: WiFi Wars returns with the live comedy game show where you all play along! Log in with your smartphone or tablet and compete in a range of games, puzzles and quizzes to win the show, and prizes! Hosted by comedian Steve McNeil (team captain on UK TV’s hit comedy/gaming show “Dara O’Briain’s Go 8 Bit”) and aided by Guinness World-Record-Breaking tech whizz, the award-winning Rob Sedgebeer! The Guardian – “Not To Be Missed” Time Out – Critic’s Choice The Times – Hot List Metro – Top Ten London Geek Nights Out Recommended for ages 6+

shows.title: Beyond a Joke: Being a professional comedian, and getting paid for the work you do
shows.description: In this session organised by Equity we will outline the key stages you need to move through in becoming a professional comedian. In particular, although free gigs and profit share are what you need to get to become established, ensuring you are being properly contracted, and able to be paid for the work you do, is essential to being a professional in the industry. This session will ensure you have the right knowledge and resources to understand good practice when being booked for gigs.

shows.title: Jonathan Oldfield: Work in Progress
shows.description: Jonathan Oldfield is making his first ever comedy hour, come and help him! Expect characters, jokes, songs, tricks and treats. If you come to the show wearing a suit, Jonathan will give you a mini bottle of wine to take home. Like the ones you get on airplanes. This is not a joke. – BBC New Comedy Award Finalist – Musical Comedy Award Finalist – Creator of award-winning BBC Radio 4’s “Time of the Week” T’s & C’s: the suit has to be something that you would wear in a formal setting and it has to make you feel good when you wear it. Jonathan reserves the right to refuse the suit.

shows.title: Kevin Precious: The Reluctant Teacher
shows.description: Kevin Precious used to be a teacher. He enjoyed the teaching part. He just didn’t enjoy all of the other stuff that went with it. So he decided to leave and get his life back. Join him as he explores the foibles of his former profession including the odd pedagogical swipe (phew!) in the process ‘ ‘If you’ve ever worked as a teacher, it feels like a show that would be satisfying in the extreme’ – Chortle ‘Kevin takes us through the highs and lows of his profession and makes those of us who are not teachers very grateful for our career choices’ – TheRealChrisSparkle **** (4 Stars)

shows.title: Louise O’Toole: Auntie-Hero
shows.description: ‘It’s me, hi, I’m the problem drinker at your child’s communion, it’s me.’ Louise is a single pringle in the Tinder world who is starting to worry that she has more in common with her friends’ 10-year-olds, than their parents. While they struggle to juggle careers with childcare on no sleep, she is struggling to get Olivia Rodrigo tickets after sleeping in. Is she the problem? Join her for some “side-splitting relatable humour” as she tries to figure out if she can become the Auntie-Hero of her own life.

shows.title: Charlie Vero-Martin: Poltergeist (WIP)
shows.description: Scottish comedian Charlie Vero-Martin presents Poltergeist, a brand new work-in-progress stand-up show packed with surreal laughs, sharp observations, and a few surprises. Expect ghosts, past lives, and horror stories about being a woman in her 30s. All delivered with Charlie’s trademark wit, energy, and delightfully strange twists. A finalist in the Funny Women Stage Award and Leicester Square Theatre’s Sketch Off, and seen on BBC Scotland and Next Up Comedy, Charlie is one of alternative comedy’s most exciting rising stars.

shows.title: Cheekykita: Tittitutar Town Two (WIP)
shows.description: Brace yourselves as we enter another world, another universe, just outside Manchester, yes were going back to Tittitutar Town Two! The town full of oddballs ,some old, some new, singing Toast, The wild one, Skally Cat and the others…we may go back to space – heard the space lizards are back. Let’s take a daft trip to Tittitutar Town! “I haven’t laughed this hard at any show all year” ★★★★★(one4 review) ‘The Show I laughed at The most, pure surrealist lunacy like Vic and Bob in their prime’ “a talented, tirelessly inventive performer with a defiant sense of self” ★★★★★ (Lou Fox)

shows.title: Lenny Sherman: One of the Good Guys
shows.description: Charming Cockney geezer Lenny Sherman THINKS he’s one of the good guys. But the reality is the big, scary, inappropriate, thug is blind to his flaws and thinks his crazy behaviour is normal… And that’s where the comedy lies. The lovable rogue has a good heart and is doing his best to grow, but cor blimey! He ain’t half got a long way to go! Big Sherm tackles, identity politics, football culture and family life sharing personal anecdotes and observations with a provocative style. Expect unexpected twists and a punchline to remember. As seen on BBC1, ITV, Channel 4, Dave and Apple TV.

shows.title: Rohan Sharma: The Dog Meat Diaries (WIP)
shows.description: Rohan Sharma, a comedian ‘at the very forefront of an exciting new generation of British comedy’ (Rolling Stone), brings a brand new work in progress to his hometown. Expect surreal multimedia nonsense, silly rambling and stories, and a real beautiful message behind it all (TBC). ***** – Edfringereview *****- A Youngish Perspective **** – Broadway World **** – FringeReview **** – Mervyn Stutter

shows.title: Daniel Nicholas: Haunting in the Arcade
shows.description: An interactive one man ghost story show! In the seaside town of Scargill there is an abandoned amusement arcade, which the locals say has been haunted for years. Amateur ghost buster Daniel Nicholas has assembled a team of other like minded ghost busters (you the audience) to rid this town of ghouls forever. Resident Evil meets Tasks master in this brand new show by award winning comedian Daniel Nicholas whose ‘talent for engaging with the audience is unparalleled’ (Stage Side Reviews) “a lot of fun by a very accomplished performer….like a grown-up version of Scooby Doo” (Buxton Fringe)

shows.title: The Saboteur
shows.description: A brand new show that mixes stupid games with deception and lies. Five comedians work together to build up a prize pot BUT one of them is ‘The Saboteur’. Can you work out who’s lying and who’s just a bit rubbish? Hosted and devised by Board Game Smackdown’s James Cook.

shows.title: Alex Prescot: Game Boy (WIP)
shows.description: After his critically acclaimed debut hour, all Alex Prescot wants to do is play some games and have some fun. Inspired by everything from Bingo to D&D, from The Traitors to The Sims™, expect musical comedy, improv, crowd work and interactive games – a perfect Valentine’s Day treat! Clap Back To Reality Winner 2024, Musical Comedy Awards Finalist 2025, Chichester New Act & Kingston New Act Finalist 2024. ***** ‘Incredibly talented’ – BroadwayWorld

shows.title: Alexander Bennett: All It Takes (Work in Progress)
shows.description: Wondering when you’ll catch a break? Wondering when the hard work will pay off? This is a show for you. “Take a risk. See this show” ★★★★★ Broadway Baby “I am speechless” ★★★★★ Three Weeks “Surprisingly powerful” ★★★★★ Broadway World “A testament to the power of comedy to illuminate the human experience” ★★★★ The Reviews Hub “Brilliantly moving, hilarious and singular” ★★★★ Entertainment Now “A very unique comedy experience” ★★★★ Edinburgh Fetsivals Magazine. Chortle and Leicester Comedy Fest award nominee. Co-host of Born Yesterday. Look me up online!

shows.title: Les Keen: The Man Who Invented a Catchphrase
shows.description: Les Keen, a comedian, writer and tv producer with more than 680 hours of primetime TV in his locker, came up with the catchphrase “NO LIKEY, NO LIGHTY”. But that was 10 seconds out of a stellar 35 year career in comedy. Now Les wants to redress the balance. He doesn’t want his tombstone to read “Here lies Les Keen, NO BREATHY, NO LIVEY” “His best gags are faultless” Chortle “Easily the funniest comedian you’ve never heard of” Omid Djalili

shows.title: The Edi Johnston Bit: What Comes Next?
shows.description: Having been in a band for the last 30 years, Edi Johnston is fed up of set lists. So now? – there isn’t one. Just the free choice of a spinny wheel! Having written countless songs over the years, he’s letting the audience take control. Come and be in the audience and lend your weight to the decisions that will shape this glorious, triumphant hour of Edi’s life – or of course, you could instead just sit back and laugh at all the songs that get played! The EJB is an award winning songwriter from Nottingham who drinks too much tea & cake, and loves his dog, wife & sons not always in that order.

shows.title: Slightly Psychic Cynthia
shows.description: A character comedy puppet show for adults with a dark sence of humour. Dark, sweary and very silly. Puppets will take over the stage and take over your mind! Slightly Psychic Cynthia is a mind reading, fortune telling puppet that loves playing with a fun audience. Live puppetry and Psychic silliness for adults. This show is not for children.

shows.title: Jackula
shows.description: Being a vampire sucks but being Dracula’s younger brother is driving Jackula batty. Join Jackula on a spooktacular quest to step out of his older brother’s shadow and become the world’s first fun vampire. Laugh at Jackula’s pet ghost. Gasp at daring juggling. Smile as children perform spellbinding tricks. An inspirational tale about following your dreams. Magic & juggling fun for the whole family. Performed by Jeff Keough who entertained at The White House, toured with Ringling Bros. & Barnum & Bailey’s Greatest Show on Earth. Dick Van Dyke said — “Funniest clown I’ve met”. Come be inspired.

shows.title: Jessica Barton: Dirty Work
shows.description: Mary Floppins has cracked the sh*ts. Wipe the wee from the toilet seat and pick up your dirty undies, because The Perfect Nanny is back to teach all you little boys – and girls – a thing or two about running a prim and proper household. Hailed “a rising star and quadruple threat” (Spy In The Stalls) and returning from a completely sold-out Edinburgh Fringe run in 2025, Jessica Barton combines a spoonful of song, dance, clowning and deep-cleaning to present a skanky and empowering comedy debut. Newly directed by Dan Wye.

shows.title: Joe Kent-Walters: Frankie Monroe’s Pub Quiz
shows.description: Join Edinburgh Comedy Award Best Newcomer and BBC New Comedy Award winner Joe Kent-Walters as his alter ego Frankie Monroe for Frankie Monroe’s Pub Quiz. He’s come to the shining lights of Leicester to raise a bit of money for his crumbling northern social club by hosting one of his infamous QUIZZES. Voted the worst pub quiz in Rotherham 15 years running, expect ill researched questions, disgusting prizes, special guests and lots and lots of padding. “MESMERISING AND UNPREDICTABLE PRESENCE” Chortle “SHADES OF REEVES AND MORTIMER” The Scotsman

shows.title: Alex Stringer: Happy Hour
shows.description: Alex got sober in 2017 when she was 23. This is a show about what it’s like once you get sober, discovering who you really are without substances, and what if who you really are is actually also a dickhead? Come and spend a happy hour. The debut fringe hour from Chortle Hotshot 2025, Alex Stringer.

shows.title: Comedy Couples Court
shows.description: Join comedy couple Masai Graham and Kirsty Munro-Graham to celebrate Valentine’s Day – by watching them taking the piss out of each other! Watch as they put each other on trial for petty relationship squabbles, and vote for who’s guilty and who wins the spat. Kirsty Munro-Graham as seen on BBC Scotland’s Situationships, Masai Graham Joke of the Fringe Winner 2016, 2021 and 2022.

shows.title: Daniel Nicholas: Millions Per Hour
shows.description: What would you do if you won the lottery? What would you spend it on? And what if there were certain conditions? Join award winning comedian Daniel Nicholas who alongside yourselves (the audience) has just won the lottery. But there’s a catch, it has to be spent within the hour or we don’t get anything at all! (Inspired by & definitely not ripping off Brewsters Millions). Through a series of interactive games & conversations, we’ll explore wealth inequality, generational divide & holidays, as we imagine a better world for ourselves.

shows.title: Louise Leigh: Octopus (Work In Progress)
shows.description: The correct plural of octopus is octopuses. Perhaps if I had tentacles, I’d be better at multitasking. Is my brain inhabited by octopuses? The dream of the fisherman’s wife. These are all thoughts that I’ve had that relate to octopuses. This show may be a repository for these thoughts, or it may be something completely different. Recommended by British Comedy Guide. “A naturally funny woman” Chortle **** “Big belly laughs” Entertainment Focus **** “Louise’s crazy hair-brained [sic] way of looking at life is uplifting and positive” Funny Women **** **** The Wee Review

shows.title: Musical Chairs: Musical Stand-Up Comedy with Friz Frizzle and Friends
shows.description: Musical Chairs is a rebellion against the unwritten rule that has kept musical comedians apart on comedy club bills for years. This remarkable trio, comprising Friz Frizzle, Edi Johnston, and Ashley Frieze, is set to captivate audiences with their unique blend of melodic jokes and lyrical gags. With this powerhouse lineup, Musical Chairs promises an exhilarating hour of entertainment defying norms of comedy. A sell out at last year’s Leicester Comedy Festival, this musical threesome enjoys combining their distinctive mix of personalities and material. You’ll laugh, they’ll sing.

shows.title: Crudi Dench: Someone Help Her!
shows.description: *RING RING* who is it? It’s award-winning drag queen Crudi Dench with her debut show! Cheeky Northern piglet Crudi is taping “Someone Help Her!” her new telly show in the vein of Cilla Black’s “Surprise Surprise”. She ready to help the callers on the line with their problems aided by special guests in her studio audience (you). An hour of stand-up, audience interaction and picking up a camp telephone. Star of sell-out Leicester Comedy Festival show ‘Drag Queens vs Zombies’ “A tightrope walk between disaster and diva-dom that’s riotously funny and surprisingly poignant.” ★★★★★ – Sussex News

shows.title: Maia Tassalini: I Was 22 and Stunning (WIP)
shows.description: In her debut hour, BBC New Comedian of the Year finalist 2024 and Pleasance Reserve 2025 alum Maia Tassalini guides the audience through an odyssey of power, shame, gossip, sex, public humiliation and being the world’s number one Monica Lewinsky stan. “Maia is a natural. Born to do it. Unreal!” Shaparak Khorsandi

shows.title: Sikisa: Serving Justice
shows.description: Join the hilarious diva Sikisa for her Edinburgh ISH Award nominated show, Serving Justice – a bold, thought-provoking hour exploring truth, identity, and what justice looks like in love and life. She dives into her love of wrestling, the pressure to have kids, and the realities of the immigration system – with a twist. As seen on Live at the Apollo and Off Menu. Host of WrestleClub UK podcast. ***** – Top Ten Shows of the Edinburgh Fringe by Rolling Stones. ***** (FestMag). **** (Scotsman). **** ‘An irresistible force of nature’ (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk). Listed as 21/02 in our physical brochure

shows.title: Sajeela Kershi: Rebel Without Applause! (WIP)
shows.description: Multi-award winning comedian/writer/broadcaster (Winner AWA, Argus Angel & Star of Edinburgh Award for best show) returns to Leicester with her PWYW, hilarious new show about our inner Rebel! Whether you’re a Rebel with/without a cause, pause or menopause. It’s time for ALL the Rebels from Gen X,Y and Z to unite! Are you ready? Then lets get this new party started! Coz we gotta lotta work to do! (Seen/heard/written for various TV/Radio (BBC, C4, ITV, Comedy Central TalkTV & more) ‘Smart, funny with a mischievous glint’ (Times) ‘Should be made available on prescription’ (Skinny)

shows.title: Matthew Baylis
shows.description: Matthew has travelled the globe with his own unique brand of unashamedly middle class comedy; from the leafy suburbs of Surrey to the outstanding beauty of the Leicestershire countryside – well, Syston. As a father of six he draws on tales of parenthood which ring true with all audiences. “Matthew Baylis’s mixture of ticklingly dry wit and razor-sharp crowd-work kept the audience feeling as if they were indulging in their favourite guilty pleasure.” The Gazette

shows.title: Andrew Frost: The Greatest Card Magician In The World
shows.description: Andrew Frost has recently been described as the “Greatest Card Magician in the World”. Can he live up to the hype? Come and find out if it’s true. Following an acclaimed Edinburgh Festival Fringe run – and working with some of the world’s top magicians – Andrew Frost brings his innovative and contemporary blend of comedy, theatre and magic on tour. . ‘A brilliant magician’ Derren Brown ‘A phenomenon’ David Blaine ‘One of the most phenomenal card magicians in the world’ Nick Mohammed

shows.title: Bella Humphries: Big Sister Energy
shows.description: After the success of her three times award nominated debut hour, Square Peg, Bella is back with a brand new show. Named as one of Rolling Stone’s Top 12 Rising Stars and featured in The Times Best Jokes of the Fringe list. “Charming with one of the smiliest voices in Edinburgh” – Chortle “Oozes charm” – Blizzard Comedy Tour support for Harriet Kemsley, Carl Hutchinson and Kiri Pritchard-McLean, as heard on BBC Radio Wales and featured in The Guardian.

shows.title: Just the Tonic Comedy Club Special 4 Headliners for a Tenner
shows.description: Just the Tonic Comedy Club Special 4 Headliners for a Tenner We have pulled together 4 of the strongest club comics on the circuit to give a full quality night for only a tenner. Possibly the best value night around this weekend. For info www.justthetonic.com Line up: Alun Cocharane Lou Conran Julian Deane Darren Harriott

shows.title: Luke Rollason: The Poolboy (WIP)
shows.description: This is a true story. The events depicted took place at the Leicester Comedy Festival in 2025. At the request of the survivors, the names have been changed. Out of respect for the dead, try not to laugh at them. BAFTA Award winner and star of Extraordinary (Disney+) Luke Rollason returns to the scene of the crime. “Utterly delightful” ★★★★ Telegraph “Gut-bustingly funny” ★★★★ The List “Delightfully daft” ★★★★ Daily Mail NOMINEE Best New Show Leicester Comedy Festival 2024

shows.title: Ray O’Leary: Laughter? I Hardly Know Her!
shows.description: Ray O’ Leary recently pulled a man from a wrecked car and as the man lay dying, he used his last ounce of strength asking Ray – ‘Taskmaster New Zealand’ star and Leicester Best Show Nominee – to tell his children that he loved them. Ray promised the man he would. But first, he has his new tour to think about. Laughter? I Hardly Know Her played to huge audiences at the 2025 Melbourne and Edinburgh Comedy Festivals, and this burgeoning comedy legend is excited to bring his iconic two-piece suit back to Leicester And when that’s out of the way, he can get back to passing on the message.

shows.title: Adele Cliff: Adele, Adele, Adele… Cliff It Isn’t The Consequences Of My Own Actions
shows.description: This show is about lying…or is it? Leicester Comedy Award nominee Adele Cliff brings her critically acclaimed 2025 show back to Leicester, with rave reviews at the Edinburgh Fringe, Adelaide Fringe and Melbourne International Comedy Festival. ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ “This is how a superb comedian structures and delivers comedy. Whimsical, witty and oh-so-funny” – Theatre Matters ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ – TLA Adelaide

shows.title: Alexandra Krekan and Hussein Ali: Red Flags
shows.description: From the hottest couple in comedy: Red Flags is a show about the trials and tribulations of being in a relationship with another comedian. This show will deal with having Boundaries, crossing Borders, and dealing with Borderline Personality Disorder whilst being in an inter-(racial/cultural/religious) relationship. What better way to spend your Valentines Day?

shows.title: Fesshole: Valentine Special
shows.description: “I’m a bus driver. If I’m having a bad day at work, I’ll look in the mirror while driving, and mutter to myself ‘you’re all c**** aren’t you?’ and then tap the brakes twice so they all nod.” Fesshole is an out of control social media project started by your host Rob Manuel which has a combined 1.5m followers across the web. Join Rob as he tells you the secrets of what he’s learned from filtering 350,000 horrible secrets by hand, and stay for the audience’s confessions where we lift the veil of anonymity and find out what really makes people tick. Fun, horror & genuine insight are promised.

shows.title: Sara Pascoe: I Am A Strange Gloop
shows.description: Have you ever been awake in the middle of the night and thought something so smart and astute that you couldn’t wait for the world to wake up so you could tell them? This show is that thought. In that it doesn’t make much sense and is a bit weird on reflection. Sara Pascoe is a comedian and her children don’t sleep and her kitchen won’t clean itself and her husband doesn’t want to be in it. As seen and heard on Taskmaster, Live at the Apollo, The Great British Sewing Bee, QI, 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown, Mock the Week and co-host of Sara and Cariad’s Weirdos Book Club podcast.

shows.title: The Bite (Love Bites): 2 Hour Mixed Standup, Valentine’s Special
shows.description: A marvellous, mixed selection of several stunning acts come together on one night only, to create a raucous, wild & slightly unusual 2hr stand-up show. Raucous, wild and an incy bit different – mixed lineup with anything from improv, stand-up, to poetry or musical comedy. What better way to celebrate Valentine’s Day than this weird & inclusive, delicious cross-section of comedy madness in one crazy bite-sized chunk served to your baffled comedy faces by the mischievous and gorgeous Stags and Ettrick-Hogg. You’ll be talking about this for years to come! Big laughs & a bit of Valentine’s cheek!

shows.title: Aisha Amanduri: God Save the Khan WIP
shows.description: Too Kazakh for Britain, too Western for Kazakhstan and just exotic enough for old men in pubs. In this new work-in-progress, A Bath Comedy Festival’s New Act Award Runner-up (2024) and Funny Women One to Watch (2023), Aisha Amanduri explores being “openly immigrant” and the absurdity of growing up between cultures never quite fitting in. Expect ADHD tangents, dark twists and historical hot takes in a debut that’s as chaotic as it is heartfelt. 50% of the show proceeds going to MAP. “combines slick delivery with stereotype-crushing material” – Rolling Stone “It’s nice!” – Borat (probably)

shows.title: Live at the Market Hall 1
shows.description: Kicking off the first of two outstanding evenings of the finest comedy talent for your laughing pleasure. Headlined by the comedy genius that is Britains’ Got Talent winner Lost Voice Guy and supported by stand-up comedy greatness in the forms of Tal Davies, Eric Rushton, David Arnold and all held together by MC Jason Neale!

shows.title: Rosco Mcclelland: How Could Hell Be Any Worse?
shows.description: What happens when you’ve almost reached the top of a mountain you’ve been climbing for years and you realise that maybe you should have been concentrating your efforts on another mountain entirely? The winner of the 2025 Sir Billy Connolly Spirit of Glasgow Award, Rosco McClelland makes his debut at Leicester Comedy Festival with one of the best-reviewed shows at Edinburgh Fringe (British Comedy Guide). Twice nominated for Best Newcomer at the Scottish Comedy Awards, McClelland is rapidly becoming one of comedy’s brightest stars. ★★★★★ (Broadway World). ★★★★★ (Skinny). ★★★★ (Scotsman).

shows.title: Wycliffe Rooms Comedy Club at Leicester Comedy Festival
shows.description: Previous finalists in last years “Best Large Venue” we’re back again this year bigger and better than ever! Headliner for the evening will be the Award-winning, stand-up comedian and Hull local, Jack Gleadow; one of the most unique performers on the UK comedy circuit today. Supported by Samantha Day, Patrick Draper and the fabulous Howard Read bringing the whole evening together!

shows.title: Patrick Monahan: The Good, The Pat and the Ugly
shows.description: Patrick’s new stand up show covered topics from life, love & mishaps with flat pack furniture, marathons & almost being scammed! Irish Iranian Teesside observational stand up comedian. Tours annually with a brand new stand up show, nationally & internationally, playing countries across Europe, The Middle East, America & Australia. Performed at many major festivals across the Uk, including 16 years at the Edinburgh International Festival.

shows.title: Got A Problem Mate: GAPM Podcast Live
shows.description: Bilal likes Bao buns Joey likes dumplings, Bilal is a chocolate guy Joey likes crispies, These two just can’t get it together in a dietary sense but IRL they are very nice friends. Join Joey Page ( tour support for Rob Beckett and Laura Smyth) and Bilal Zafar ( Ed fringe best newcomer Nominee & Leicester comedy fest best show nominee 2025) for a live episode of their highly hilarious podcast. Have you got a problem, mate? Then bring it along to the show in exchange for a lot of laughs. Special guest to be announced. No flag shaggers.

shows.title: Rob Duncan: Printer of the Year 2024
shows.description: In 2024, Rob Duncan was named Printer of the Year. This show is an hour of printing, celebrating his award, the industry and debuting a new category of dramatic arts – Performance Printing. “Brilliantly, hilariously stupid.’’ Frankie Boyle. ‘Incredible…” ThreeWeeks. “Something extraordinary” The Scotsman. Nominee: Malcolm Hardee Awards 2025 – Edinburgh Fringe

shows.title: Toussaint Douglass: Purple Drizzle
shows.description: ***EDINBURGH BEST NEWCOMER NOMINEE 2025*** Tired of being seen as ‘odd’ by his peers, family, close friends, agent, fellow beekeepers and long-term partner, award-winning comedian Toussaint Douglass is out to prove he can be just as mainstream as all the big successful comedians. Join him with his new work in progress show: Purple Drizzle PART 2. Star Of: Late Night Mash (DAVE) Outsiders (DAVE) Alan Davies: As Yet Untitled (DAVE), Stand Up Sketch Show (ITV) “.. There’s something of a Richard Ayoade vibe to Toussaint Douglass.. One of the best and most distinctive acts” – Chortle

shows.title: Tom Towelling Teaches You to Knit
shows.description: This show will surpass the poor expectations set by a shoddily written blurb. The title? Nothing to do with the show. The content? A bit wild, anything can happen kind of vibes. The credentials? Decent – I won the Musical Comedy Awards in 2024 as well as the Birmingham Breaking Talent Award in the same year. Some people have said some nice things about me like: ‘He’s a welcome addition to the circuit’s collection of weirdos.’ Steve Bennett, Chortle ‘So odd that it became entrancingly funny.’ Bruce Dessau, Beyond the Joke

shows.title: A Leicester Comedy Roast Battle
shows.description: Hosted by our own Roastmaster General Joseph Johnson. Brace yourself for an epic night of savage humour at Inside No.9. Watch as top comedians go head-to-head in a no-holds-barred contest of insults, wit, and comebacks. Nothing is off-limits as they roast each other to ashes, delivering sharp one-liners and brutal burns. This high-energy showdown guarantees laughter and shocks in equal measure. Who will reign supreme? Find out at Inside No.9!

shows.title: Broken Bard
shows.description: PTSD isn’t much fun. Haunted by depression, and anxiety, this broken bard is quite frankly, battered. But if you don’t laugh you’ll cry – so Louis made a happy stand-up show about being sad. Laugh along with stories of the darkest experiences the human condition can put us through. Get some real earworms lodged in your head. Request your own topics for improvised songs. Funny, sad, relatable, Louis is a charming bard.

shows.title: CK Nath: “A Bit of Foreign Stuff” (Work In Progress)
shows.description: High energy and full of bite! Join CK as she takes you through her life growing up in India, finding herself in the UK and the inevitable culture clash in this work-in-progress show. Blending sharp stand-up, vivid storytelling, and cheeky character work as she channels the conservative Indian mother as easily as a middle class British nanny. CK Nath is a finalist of West End New old Act 2023; So You Think You’re Funny? 2022 and Komedia New Comedy Award 2024 semi-finalist and Soho Theatre Labs alumni

shows.title: Christian Dart: GUMSHOE!
shows.description: Christian Dart returns with his acclaimed, sell-out EdFringe 2025 show GUMSHOE! (KIDS SHOW 13:30, NORMAL SHOW 21:30) A grizzled New York Detective embarks on his final, most deadly and most ridiculous case yet. Join Gumshoe as he attempts to solve the unsolvable case. Who did the whodunnit?! Written and performed by award-winning comedian Christian Dart. Best Show: Leicester Comedy Fest 2025 – Nominee, Finalist: Sketch-Off! 2025 ***** – ThreeWeeks ***** – GetTheChance ***** – Number9 ***** – AdventuresInTheatreland ***** – TonyLovesTheFringe **** – The List **** – One4Review

shows.title: Alex Leam’s Absolute Scenes
shows.description: The panel show that has improv, stand up, and acts from the festival getting burned by large candles is back for 2026. “This was such good fun. A lovley team, new games, actual physical danger! See it, Play it , Love it! -Tony Slattery

shows.title: Stepdads: The Stepdads Les Mis
shows.description: Cult comedy pioneers Stepdads present the world’s first ever stage adaptation of Victor Hugo’s novel. They will be joined by alternative comedy’s finest to faithfully adapt this colossal epic, including the 58 page digression on the Battle of Waterloo. Featuring an all-star cast, including: Christian Brighty! Lil Wenker! Alex Franklin! Ben Alborough! Ellie BW! And more! Stepdads are BAFTA-winning Disney+ heartthrob Luke Rollason (★★★★ “gloriously daft” Telegraph) and The Flop’s Tom Penn (★★★★★ “Nothing happens” BeyondTheJoke). “Awe-inspiring… sensationally silly” ★★★★ The ReviewsHub

shows.title: Michelle Ahern: Are We There Yet? (WIP)
shows.description: Australian comedian Michelle Ahern brings a brand-new work-in-progress to the festival with Are We There Yet? (No, we’re not) — a raucous, high-energy joyride through heartbreak, reinvention, and midlife mischief. From sexploration to sangria, it’s the unfiltered story of starting life over — in your 40s, in Spain. Winner of Best Solo Show 2024, Barcelona Comedy Awards (for a previous production)

shows.title: Alexandra Haddow: Work In Progress
shows.description: Alex signed up to one year all you can yoga to try and quash her rage and it’s cured everything – psyche! Imagine, there’d be no show if she had. Come and hear some brand new ideas and probably some stuff she hasn’t even thought of yet. Best New Show nominee (Leicester Comedy Festival). Tour support for Frankie Boyle, Bill Bailey and Tommy Tiernan. Seen and heard on Channel 4, Comedy Central, BBC Radio 6 Music and BBC Radio 4 Extra. ‘Charmingly confessional’ (Guardian). ‘A whole lot of laughs’ (Skinny). ‘A comic with an impressive stage presence’ (Chortle.co.uk)

shows.title: Huge Davies: Work In Progress
shows.description: Edinburgh Comedy Award Nominee Huge Davies is writing a new show and you’re all invited to watch him perform at his most vulnerable. As seen on Cats Does Countdown, House of Games, Roast Battle and Live at the Comedy Store and of course Off Menu. Ed Fringe Reviews **** Telegraph **** To Do List ***** Chortle **** The List ***** Scotsman **** Broadway World *****

shows.title: Playing God with Benjamin Alborough (WIP)
shows.description: Join comedian Benjamin Alborough as he attempts to create a utopia. Through a series of interactive branching decisions and incredibly stressful quicktime events the audience shall guide him to either success (good) or failure (real life death). A follow-up to Benjamin Alborough’s anarchic gameshow Absolute Monopoly (and a distraction from his all-star chat show Late Night with Terry Wogan) this new WIP interactive comedy show will eventually have a couple hundred endings.

shows.title: Joke Spot @ Hamilton Library
shows.description: Roll up! Roll up! Joke Spot makes you the star as we invite anyone under the age of 18 to take the mic and become a comedian. Our pop-up stage will be touring Leicester throughout the festival and it’s up to you to drop-in and tell us your best jokes. More venues may be announced throughout the festival, so keep an eye on our socials @kidscomedyfest or our website!

shows.title: The Rubbish Shakespeare Company: Romeo and Juliet
shows.description: Enemies. Balconies. Kissing… SAUSAGE ROLLS!!?? Three hapless idiots perform Shakespeare’s famous tragedy using nothing but tatty wigs and a burst airbed they found by the bins. This frenetic 60 mins of fourth-wall-breaking, ludicrous action features clowning, slapstick, and mischievous storytelling, ensuring everyone from 5 to 105 knows what’s going on! This isn’t boring Shakespeare – it’s bonkers! ‘High-class entertainment’ ***** (Fringe Review) ‘Genius way to bring the Bard to fresh audiences’ ***** (West End Best Friend) ‘Side-splittingly funny’ **** (The List) Suitable for ALL AGES!

shows.title: Still Got It 2026
shows.description: Still Got It Productions presents a 3-show comedic whirlwind. 1. ‘How to Be Enough’ is a comedic uprising against not feeling enough (but becoming enough anyway!). 2. ‘Mischief and Mayhem’ crashes through next with clowning and high-energy depictions of life’s nonsense. 3. ‘Older and Bolder’ brings our show to a joyful climax with our maximum comedic fire. Starring: Derya Yilderim: Ethnic Minority Bob the Builder on espresso. Georgia Thorp: A master of deadpan humour. Kym Nelson: A comic with energy and sharp observations. Lissi Field: drum-wielding diva.

shows.title: Howard Anstock and James Allen: Exploratory Surgery
shows.description: Two work-in-progress shows from two of the circuit’s rising stars. Exploratory surgery is more fun than it sounds.

shows.title: Alison Spittle: Work In Progress
shows.description: A new work in progress show from Comedian’s Choice Award winner Alison Spittle. As seen and heard on Pointless Celebrities, Gogglebox, Off Menu, and House of Games. Dublin Fringe 2025’s Best Performer. One of the best reviewed shows of the Edinburgh Fringe 2025. ‘A kind of genius’ – Irish Times “Alison Spittle is f*cking hilarious… naked honesty and blazing soul” – Rolling Stone ★★★★★ “A gifted storyteller with an irresistible turn of phrase and a true gift for comedy” The Scotsman ★★★★ Daily Express ★★★★★ The Herald ★★★★ Evening Standard ★★★★ Metro ★★★★

shows.title: Camilla Borges: Be Not Afraid!
shows.description: Experience the Nativity like you’ve never seen it before! See the Nativity through Mary’s eyes, inspired by a star-making performance of Mary. Once you play Mary, everything else feels like a let down. Mary has hopes and dreams- she’s only 13 after all. 13 and pregnant. Who is Mary outside of her pregnancy and the Nativity? Using clowning, games, and lots of audience interaction, see how Mary can teach us about ourselves and what it means to really grow up. Silly, political, apolitical, angry, joyful and silly, it’s Christmas, every day!

shows.title: Comedy Club 4 Kids
shows.description: Like the name says it’s a Comedy Club 4 Kids! Cracking entertainment at Harborough Market Hall for everyone over six years old and under 400 years old (no vampires). We have the best comedians from the UK and world circuit doing what they do best… but without the rude bits! Adults accompanying a child are entitled to a free ticket – this must be booked alongside a full price ticket.

shows.title: ComedySportz
shows.description: TWO TEAMS. ONE WINNER. NO SCRIPT! The award-winning competitive comedy show where teams go for gold with quick-witted gags and games. A fast-paced, feel-good show for everyone with a referee on hand to ensure a good clean match. The teams have washed their kits and sharpened their wits, who wins? YOU decide! Nominated ‘Best Kids Show’ Leicester Comedy Festival 2025. “Very, Very, Very Funny.” ★★★★★ Mix Up Theatre “Brilliantly funny. Gags and games galore.” ★★★★ The Derek Awards “A feel-good show that celebrates the joy of improvisation.” ★★★★ Theatre Weekly “Skilled and funny.” ★★★★ Three Weeks

shows.title: Hudson Hughes: At Your Service
shows.description: For 20 years, TV’s Rev. Derek Gritt has shone a little bit of holy into Britain’s homes. This week, he heads to a quaint village to fulfill Mega-fan Jane Plemley’s last wish to have her funeral televised. As usual, he’ll lead the service and answer your burning questions. Except the ones about Jane. She’s NOT a witch. ‘An absurdly delightful hour of comedy’ ***** Broadway World ‘Raging, manic… anarchic’ ***** One4Review

shows.title: Richard Stott: Work in Progress
shows.description: Richard Stott (As seen on Comedy Central & ITV) brings a brand new show full of award winning one-liners and trademark anarchic storytelling to Leicester. Come on in, the fire’s fine… Please note, this show is listed as Richard Stott: Bin Fire The Show in our physical brochure.

shows.title: Gen Singer’s Radio Hour Featuring Gel Shitty
shows.description: Gen Singer hosts a variety show full of bizarre characters and call-ins, including tech bro Gel Shitty who will empower you to live your best life using microwaves, vitamins and the power of triangles.

shows.title: Richard Dadd: Not The Guy From Baby Reindeer
shows.description: Richard Dadd is just one letter away from being the multi award-winning star of a hit Netflix show. And what’s one letter between friends? His debut solo show involves: the day God created jokes! A life-changing event at Smethwick Galton Bridge! And a cardboard computer that heralds the future of comedy! Plus Satan gets summoned at about the 40min mark. “A weird & unique experience” (The People’s Comedy). Richard Dadd is the brains behind Brum’s cult Alternative Comedy show The Late Night Sweet Shop, and is a former nominee of the Birmingham Comedy Festival Breaking Talent Award.

shows.title: Emma Davies: Cultural Fit? (work-in-progress)
shows.description: Not a “cultural fit” at work no matter how hard you try? This comedy explores HR, the workplace, and the endless hunt to belong and feel valued. Hosted by morally grubby HR expert, Alllison Pope — expect “questionable” professional advice, power dressing and light audience participation. Emma was the runner up in the West End Women New Comedian of the Year 2025 and Sketch Off 2025 semi-finalist.

shows.title: Jack Campbell: Who are they? (WIP)
shows.description: In an increasingly divided world of Us and Them, Stand-Up Comedian and Creative Writing graduate from De Montfort University, Jack Campbell tries to tackle the subject of the history of human migration on a Sunday afternoon above a pub outside of Leicester. Returning to the city where he began performing stand-up comedy 15 years ago, to one of his favourite venues,

shows.title: Alex Franklin: Kiss Me (If My Girlfriend Allows It x) (WIP)
shows.description: What if we kissed right now? Like, obviously I’m kidding. But genuinely? I’m just asking questions. About kissing. Like what do we think of that? I’m kissi- I mean kidding! But we could! Right here! In theory of course, not practice. Do you have someone to practice kissing with? Do you want it to be me? X As seen / heard on Channel 4 / HBO Max / BBC Radio 4. ‘Deeply affecting and incredibly funny’ ★★★★★ (The Wee Review). ‘A one-woman multiverse of gleeful possibility’ ★★★★½ (The Reviews Hub). ‘Fabulously funny, absurd and intelligent’ ★★★★ (Everything Theatre).

shows.title: Amy Matthews: Definitions Of Toast – Work In Progress
shows.description: Amy Matthews (ITVx, Comedy Central) is scratching about in the dirt for new jokes and new ideas; come and help find them with her. This will be brand new stuff! The show is shaping up to be about what it means to support – or not support – someone dealing with alcoholism; queer joy; a stand off with a pigeon; learning to be angry; why Amy’s mum keeps milk in the car; learning about how a processing lag is affecting her life; why modern Shakespeare is so often very shite. “A must-see [… ] a searing wit, she makes the deeply personal feel like a universal truth “ – Rolling Stone.

shows.title: Marty Gleeson: Perfis (Work In Progress)
shows.description: Marty Gleeson has the strange and unusual comedy brain, that makes you excited for what comes next“ – Rolling Stone. A Work In Progress from Pleasance Reserve alumni, LGBTQ+ New Comedian of the Year Winner, BBC and Channel 4 Sean Lock Awards finalist Marty Gleeson. Over 40M Views, Tour Support for Vittorio Angelone. So take her by the hand as she promises to guide you safely head on into oncoming traffic, all laughy in your head and belly like, giddy with the rush of it all and out the other side. Dry, witty and real in the surreal. “So funny. Really original.” – Joe Wilkinson

shows.title: Alex Leam Breaks Wikipedia
shows.description: Alex heard the word ‘Eldorado’ on TV and it made him look up the wikipedia article on the failed 90’s soap. When he didn’t recgonise any of the actors names he wondered how long he could last if he put himself in the article. This is the true story of what happened when Alex, and many Facebook friends added him into a diffrent Wikipedia article each day, and where it lead him. From being credited in a book on Dad’s Army facts, to being named in the Glasow Herald as a founder memeber of D:Ream “A winning line is self deprication” – Chortle “He’s a funny man and great company” – Buxton Fringe

shows.title: Barry Ferns: My Seven Years as Lionel Richie
shows.description: The Edinburgh 2025 Sell Out show, in the top 25 best reviewed shows of the Edinburgh. The new show from Barry Ferns about being a stand-up comedian since the age of 15, the Edinburgh Fringe, going from being homeless to being offered half a million pounds as a TV presenter and living seven years of your life as the Grammy award-winning artist, Lionel Richie. Nominated for Best New Show at Leicester Comedy Festival, 2025.

shows.title: Jude Simpson: A Noise Annoys
shows.description: Poet, entertainer and three-time national slam champion Jude Simpson performs an uplifting hour of witty wordplay, silly songs and fun interaction for children aged 6-12 and their families. From a song celebrating peanut butter sandwiches to a tongue twister about naming your pet badger, there is lots of joy, a healthy dose of nonsense, and the occasional moment of beautiful hush… Described as “a cross between Nick Cope and Miranda,” Jude entertains and inspires in equal measure. “Funny, sharp, a terrific performer. She needs to be seen and heard wherever possible.” – Michael Rosen

shows.title: Spontadeity: Whomst Let The Gods Out?!
shows.description: IMpRovised MyThological MaDness! Tales of gods and monsters, heroines and heroes, mundane and mythological beings all made up on the spot from audience suggestions. Ever wondered what Zeus liked to eat for breakfast or how peanut butter was born?! You just might find out the answers to these mythological questions as well as unfold some rip-roaring epic tales with the help of Stägs Woodward, Josie Ettrick-Hogg and their fabulous guest improvisers. Come witness the birth of legends!

shows.title: Stella Graham: Loyal Family
shows.description: This Fringe veteran’s 10th solo show. Seen on Never Mind the Buzzcocks & Booze Britain. “If you’re a TV executive… see her now” (The Skinny) “Stella Graham is a powerhouse provider of lols who is destined for great things and should be hosting TV and radio – BBC listen up.” – ToDoList.london. Like The Godfather – but female, from Coventry. Family, loyalty, pride, and class collide in Stella Graham’s sharp, fast-paced comedy. Don’t miss it! With power and betrayal at its heart, Every family has its secrets. If The Crown was a bit brown

shows.title: HORN
shows.description: The rhino is going extinct! Professor Daniel Trengove, MD, PhD, is dedicated to saving these majestic beasts. His experimental conservation schemes have led to his prosecution in countries all over the world. He has been widely criticised by mainstream science and animal rights groups, but remains undeterred. Join him on a journey of nature, business, love, sex, AI, bankruptcy, divorce, and revelation.

shows.title: Olaf Falafel: I used to work in a helium balloon factory until they me go
shows.description: Edinburgh Festival Best Show ISH Award shortlisted in 2025. The best-joke-list-bothering, holey-cheese-flinging Falafel is back with another laundry basket full of stuff he hopes you’ll find funny. Including but not limited to: mind reading mic-stands, sausage-based nonsense and art-related buffoonery. It won’t be sensible. “On course to become an Edinburgh Fringe legend.” ★★★★★ Get Your Coats On “This is a must see show.” ★★★★★ Phoenix Remix. “One of the most creative shows I’ve seen at the Fringe.” ★★★★ Ed Fringe Review

shows.title: Rachel Baker Presents: GWEN – This is NOT a Pyramid Scheme
shows.description: Gwen here, I’ve recently been banned from Zumba instructing because I was putting subliminal messages into the songs in an attempt to sell my Avon body lotion. Anyway, onwards and upwards. This is my next venture, I will teach you how to become resilient, gorgeous and gregarious through storytelling, ’90s dance music, and interaction. Gwen was a finalist in Sketch Off Awards 2025 and the winner of the Luke Rollason Character Bursary. Rachel Baker is a Funny Women Finalist, Birmingham Breaking Talent Nominee and as heard on BBC radio 4.

shows.title: Sikisa: Werk in Progress
shows.description: An “irresistible force of nature” ★★★★ (BeyondTheJoke), the 4 time Leicester Comedy Festival nominee, Sikisa returns with a brand-new hour in development. Following the success of her 2025 Edinburgh Fringe show Serving Justice (Edinburgh ISH award nominated; “the gag rate is high” – On The Mic), Sikisa now turns her sharp eye to fear, adjustment and change. Sikisa brings brand new jokes, stories and chaos to the stage. Expect sharp, high-energy comedy as she tests out material – proceed with caution. As seen/heard on Live at the Apollo (BBC), The Off Menu Podcast, BBC Radio.

shows.title: Farhan Solo: Going Solo WIP
shows.description: Farhan Solo is one of the UK’s rising comedy voices, known for his sharp, dry, and darkly funny take on modern life. A BBC New Comedy Awards Regional Finalist, So You Think You’re Funny? Finalist, and runner-up in Lounges TV’s Best Stand-up Newcomer (judged by Omid Djalili & Paul Chowdhry), with an ITV writing credit, he’s performed at top clubs across the UK and Dubai, opening for leading UK comics, and was a Leicester Comedy Festival Circuit Breaker in 2025. Farhan now brings a brand-new work-in-progress hour that’s deadpan, awkward, and unapologetically funny.

shows.title: Tal Davies: Work In Progress
shows.description: Award winning comedian (BBC Three / Radio 4 / tour support for Milton Jones, Paul Chowdhry, Josh Pugh & more) presents a work in progress show about her life as a 30-something Brummie woman on the edge. Expect sharp observational gags, wild oversharing and a touch of weirdly relatable surrealism. She might even bring her pram full of guinea pigs if she can’t sort a babysitter. ‘A natural storyteller’ – Chortle ‘A brilliant performer who is destined for great things’ – Scott Bennett ‘Refreshingly relatable and highly amusing ★★★★’ – Lost in Theatreland

shows.title: Tasmin Sarkany: Chaconne
shows.description: Tasmin Sarkany (BBC New Comedy Awards Nominee 2025) plays Amelia Crotchet, a classical musician in a double act with her violin. She’s about to play the most important concert of her career: a complete performance of Bach’s Chaconne for solo violin – but unfortunately, Amelia is easily distracted. Expect silliness, musical puns, historically questionable facts about Bach and (if she gets round to it) some beautiful classical music. “Highly skilful… ingenious” Chortle “proof that you can still have a completely original (and slightly bonkers) idea” Funny Women Photo © Andy Hollingworth

shows.title: The Dodgy Anagram Show
shows.description: Come and play The Dodgy Anagram Show with Essex born, Yorkshire bred comedian Claire Oliver where you the audience are the contestants! Solve the Dodgy Anagrams on a variety of hilarious subjects selected by the Dodgy Anagram spinning wheel! Could you be the show’s champion Dodgy Anagram solver and win the prize? Age rating 16+

shows.title: Vinny Shiu: British. Broken. Chinese (WIP)
shows.description: Vinny Shiu is making serious waves on the UK comedy circuit, delivering bold, unfiltered humour that turns his personal struggles into laugh-out-loud moments. As an Asian man growing up in the UK, Vinny hilariously dives into identity, family drama, dating disasters, trauma and finding his path in life. With sharp jokes, immersive storytelling and musical comedy, his dynamic performances leave audiences buzzing. Winner of Southampton Comedian of the Year 2023 and a finalist in British Comedian of the Year 2024, Vinny’s meteoric rise is one to watch – go catch his work in progress show!

shows.title: Mike Rice: Cruel Little Man
shows.description: There’s a cruelty to Mike Rice, a wickedness. In this show Mike talks about doing psychedelics with his brother, an entanglement with a Spanish Sausage Dog named Nino, and many other such rotten adventures. ★★★★ ½ “A PHENOMENAL WORDSMITH, AND WORLD CLASS RACONTEUR” Chortle “IRELAND HAS YET ANOTHER LEGENDARY COMEDIAN” Dan Nightingale

shows.title: Edd Hedges: Open Tabs
shows.description: Fresh from hosting the Apple #1 Comedy and True Crime podcast “Wisecrack” Edd Hedges brings his new hour of stories and jokes to the Leicester comedy festival. Over the last year, Edd has been travelling across America, picking up stories he’d like to tell you and quietly wondering whether you’ll find them funny. From appearing at a true crime convention, to receiving a lap dance from a 90-year-old stripper and more places he definitely shouldn’t have ended up, this is an hour built from things that actually happened — or at least felt real at the time.

shows.title: Esther Manito: Slagbomb
shows.description: After a sold-out, rave-reviewed tour in 2024, Esther is back — this time embracing the sheer joy of having absolutely no dignity. She’s tried elegance. She’s aimed for sophistication. But somehow, chaos always wins. Because really — how do you keep your poise when you’re juggling kids, aging parents, and the crushing weight of unmet expectations? Esther is done pretending. Because when there’s war in the world and family back in Lebanon, there are bigger things to worry about than being a “slagbomb”. ★★★★ “An absolute riot from start to finish” Everything Theatre

shows.title: Rosalie Minnitt: Clementine 2.0 (WIP)
shows.description: Clementine 2 (WIP) Miss Lady Clementine is BACK (due to unpopular demand!). She’s off to The Big City. But soft – revolution’s in the air. Will our fearless heroine keep her wits or lose her head entirely? Guardian’s Top Ten Comedy of 2023. Absolutely barnstorming performance’ – ★★★★ (Telegraph) ‘Remarkable’ – ★★★★ (The Guardian). ‘Delirious, demented stuff’ – ★★★★ (Chortle) Telegraph’s Funniest Shows at the Fringe and one of the British Comedy Guide’s Top Reviewed Shows

shows.title: Sean Morley: Backchannel
shows.description: The future has arrived, mouth wet and eyes hungry. Elusive comedy cherub and fully adult citizen Sean Morley has reinvented comedy for the slurried minds of Broken Britain. You can say anything these days. “Brilliant, best thing I’ve seen at the fringe” (Chortle) “A one-of-a-kind comedian” (The Skinny) “Defies any sort of description … joyful, wonderful fun” (The Guardian)

shows.title: Sooz Kempner: Is Ugly
shows.description: Award-winning comedian Sooz Kempner (Doom in Doctor Who’s Doom’s Day, Amazon Prime’s Dinner With the Parents) is back with a brand new show about beauty, ageing, trolling and Barbra Streisand. When the world seems ugly it’s hard to feel beautiful, not like when you’re seven and Final Score is on and nothing has ever felt more beautiful because what follows is Big Break, the Generation Game, Noel’s House Party and then either Only Fools and Horses or Birds of a Feather. How can WE find beauty in these very unattractive times? ‘Brilliant’ (LA Times). ★★★★ (Scotsman).

shows.title: A Star Wars Improv Show: The One-Man Made-Up Movie
shows.description: Fresh from a sell-out residency at the Edinburgh Festival, the cult hit and acclaimed show embarks on its 2026 tour. Award nominated stand-up and improviser Jon Hipkiss brings together the ultimate celebration of comedy and fandom. Based solely on your suggestions, Jon will improvise an entirely new Star Wars film all by himself. Expect beautiful chaos! “Very funny, clever and totally entertaining” – “I was doubled over laughing for the whole show” – “Fantastic show for Star Wars fans or not” – “Genuinely brilliant” – “Hilarious with a highly skilled performer” – EdFringe.com Reviews

shows.title: Abbie Murphy: Garage Girl
shows.description: Run, come, gather round! A love letter to UK Garage and the iconic tunes that defined a generation. ‘Garage Girl’ is for anyone who lived it, loved it, or found it through its revival — all while asking: was life really better then, or were we just young? Murphy continues to cement her reputation as a rising comedic force. Finalist of Not So New Comedian of the Year 2025, Abbie Murphy is “nothing short of excellent” (Deadline News) and “One to watch” (The List). Star of David Brent: Life on the Road, Cheaters and Breeders.

shows.title: Andrew Bird WIP
shows.description: After 2 sellout Leicester tour shows in a row and having just supported Troy Hawke at the London Palladium, Andrew returns to one of his favourite venues for an hour of new and newer material

shows.title: Oadby Comedy Club
shows.description: Join us in Oadby for a triple headliner edition of Oadby Comedy Club in a terrific local venue. We’re joined by Live at the Apollo’s Lindsey Santoro, Would I Lie to You’s Shazia Mirza and Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year, Nina Gilligan. Hosted by Leicester Comedy Festival’s Best Show Winner, Alex Hylton.

shows.title: Queniborough Comedy Club
shows.description: Leicester Comedy Festival is coming to Queniborough! Join us at Queniborough Members Club (open to everyone) for a fantastic triple bill as Shazia Mirza (Would I Lie to You?) Lindsey Santoro (Live at the Apollo) and Matt Hollins (Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year) perform alongside top compere Anthony Williams in this gorgeous, intimate venue.

shows.title: RATMAGEDDON
shows.description: Welcome to Ratmageddon, the bizarre, apocalyptic comedy adventure you didn’t know you needed. Fresh from Soho Theatre’s Character Lab, join comedy duo RATBAG as they present the Work-In-Progress of their debut hour – a chaotic, narrative-driven explosion of sketch, clown, character comedy, and live music. Expect big characters, bold choices, surprising twists, and the kind of joyful theatrical mayhem that only emerges when two performers push each other right to the edge. If you love comedy that’s unpredictable, imaginative, and unashamedly silly, this is the show for you.

shows.title: The Totally Improvised Musical
shows.description: Don’t miss the opening – and closing – night of your very own musical! The story, songs, characters and “choreography” are all composed on the spot from your title suggestions by an award-winning team of improv comics. Previous titles include: Help! I Live With My Ex, Sweeney Toddlers and Miserable Les. Nominated ‘Best Variety Show’ Leicester Comedy Festival 2024. “Hilarity, absurdity, fantastic vocals, and catchy songs.” ★★★★½ Frankly My Dear UK “Inventive and riotously funny.” ★★★★ North West End “Joy every night.” ★★★★ Corr Blimey “A very good time.” What The Fringe Podcast

shows.title: Costa Del Comedy
shows.description: Get that holiday feeling with cocktails n laughs flowing at Costa Del Comedy. You’ll be living the vida local at Bar Dos Hermanos on Queens road, with hilarious pro comedians entertaining you as you get away from it all for the night. It’s comedy that doesn’t Costa fortune. “Great host, belly full of laughs”. ***** John Husain, Gigantic.

shows.title: Live at the Market Hall 2
shows.description: 7.30pm Age 18+ The second of our bumper comedy nights at the Market as part of the 2026 Leicester Comedy Festival. Headlined by Nina Gilligan and featuring some of THE BEST stand-ups the UK comedy circuit has to offer – El Baldhiniho, Jenny Collier, Jules O’Brian and David Eagle this is a night not to be missed. Sunday is Funday!!!!

shows.title: Daliso Chaponda: Topical Storm
shows.description: Daliso Chaponda has been writing jokes about the news for over a decade – on Have I Got News For You, Radio 4’s News Quiz, Australia’s Good News Week and many more besides. (In fact he’s seen the news from both sides, having been in the tabloids himself.) But recently the news has been so absurd, chaotic and overwhelming that it more or less mocks itself. Where do we go from here? Topical Storm is Daliso’s response. A show not about THE news but about news itself. ★★★★ ‘Full of sharp one-liners and well crafted gags…a real talent’ Metro

shows.title: Joe Wells: Daddy Autism
shows.description: Joe and his wife are having a baby. He’s autistic so statistically it’s quite likely the baby will be too. In this new show, critically acclaimed comedian Joe Wells explores fatherhood through the lens of neurodiversity. Plus, there’s a really good joke about a parrot. As seen on Rosie Jones’ Disability Comedy Extravaganza, BBC Two’s Ouch Storytelling Live and Channel 4’s Jokes Only a Neurodivergent Can Tell. Over 20 million online views. ‘Some of the most surprising and thought-provoking material coming from any comedian’ Guardian ‘One of my favourite comics’ Frankie Boyle

shows.title: Sam Eley is Basil Crumbwick: Soul Sewage
shows.description: Really horrid bloke. Funny though. Expect chaos and desperation. Will be burnt into your brain like when someone pauses a plasma TV for too long. Winner of Sketch-Off 2025 (over 300 entrants). “A virtuoso display of comic writing” – Steve Bennett, Chortle. “He makes a hell of an impression…something very special.” Tim Harding, Chortle. “[Truly] original humour.” Bruce Dessau, BeyondTheJoke. Did you know snails have over 14,000 teeth? This is vitally important.

shows.title: Stepdads: First Steps (WIP)
shows.description: A funk-comedy fever dream from the men who wish they were your dad (but who are glad he went to prison.) Show some respect for the sanctity of marriage and strap in for an action-adventure that makes Spy Kids look like a movie for children. From BAFTA-winning Disney+ heartthrob Luke Rollason (“gloriously daft” ★★★★ Telegraph) and Tom Penn ( “Nothing happens” ★★★★★ BeyondTheJoke). The cult comedy double act behind the Sell Out spectacular The Stepdads Les Mis. “Awe-inspiring” ★★★★ The ReviewsHub

shows.title: Tom Rosenthal: Whatever People Say I Am, That’s What I Am
shows.description: Arctic Monkeys’ album, Whatever People Say I Am, That’s What I’m Not, hit the shelves in January 2006. Tracks like ‘I Bet You Look Good on the Dancefloor’ and ‘When the Sun Goes Down’ became anthems, showcasing Alex Turner’s sharp lyrics and observational storytelling. Star of Friday Night Dinner Tom Rosenthal’s show, Whatever People Say I Am, That’s What I Am, tours the UK and Ireland in 2026. Jokes like ‘Wimbledon’, ‘Daniel Radcliffe’ and ‘Some Weather We’re Having’ have the potential to become classics, showcasing Rosenthal’s sharp nose and observational squawking.

shows.title: Crowd Work with President Obonjo
shows.description: President Obonjo is back with his first crowd work show where anything goes the President interrogates the audience for laughs, if you have never seen a President work the crowd this is a show not to be missed . Audience members are part of the show , be prepared to be interrogated its all fun as the President brings you into his own world.

shows.title: Lovdev Barpaga: Half Soaked
shows.description: Lovdev Barpaga – Half Soaked (2026) Back by popular demand, UK Pun Champion Lovdev Barpaga brings Half Soaked back to the stage — but this isn’t the same show as last year. With fresh edits, brand-new stories and unexpected twists, Lovdev explores family life, cultural quirks and everyday chaos in his own daft, feelgood style. Is it sharper, sillier, or simply soaked in more mischief than before? Come and decide for yourself in a night full of warmth, laughter and unforgettable comedy.

shows.title: Marcel Lucont: Liberté (Work In Progress)
shows.description: Remember liberty? Marcel Lucont (Comedy Central, Sky Atlantic, BBC1 etc.) delves into this antiquated concept popularised by the French., with his trademark deadpan wit and exquisite poetry. And who better to guide you through the downfall of society than a French miserablist? “Uniquely funny” ★★★★★ The Scotsman. “Comedy at its best” ★★★★★ Fringe Review. “Excellently dry… superb” – The Times. Previous winner: Best Comedy Show – Fringe World Awards. www.marcellucont.com

shows.title: Andrew O’Neill: Escape
shows.description: New stand-up from cult comedian. ‘In their own extraordinary way, O’Neill is one of the most powerfully, radically political comics in Edinburgh’ ***** (Scotsman). ‘No show at this year’s Fringe has made me laugh harder… a dizzyingly eclectic set’ ***** (Telegraph). ‘An hour of colossal scope. Their comedy shows are hilarious, wide-reaching affairs that have no peers’ **** (Chortle.co.uk). ***** (One4Review.co.uk). ***** (ScotsGay.co.uk).

shows.title: Maisie Adam: Work In Progress
shows.description: Straight off the back of the latest season of Taskmaster, Maisie’s working up her new tour show. Some jokes might work, some might not. It will be obvious which ones are which, to you and to her, but that’s part of the fun. Right? RIGHT? As seen on Live At The Apollo, A League of Their Own, and QI.

shows.title: The Bricklayers Quiz Night
shows.description: Get ready for a quiz night with a comedy twist! As part of the Leicester Comedy Festival, The Bricklayers ‘Big Weekend’ Comedy Quiz will test your knowledge of comedy icons, classic one-liners and Leicester trivia, with plenty of laughs along the way. Expect interactive rounds, unexpected twists and fun moments throughout the night, plus a cash prize for the winning team with plenty of mini prizes up for grabs along the way. Whether you’re a quiz regular, a comedy fan, or just in it for the laughs, this is one Big Weekend event you won’t want to miss.

shows.title: Marcel Lucont’s Whine List
shows.description: The multi-award-deserving deadpan Frenchman returns with his acclaimed interactive show, in which he serves up a unique Whine List from the audience’s past woes and misdemeanours. A kind of group therapy experience, but one where everybody may leave more depressed. As seen on Live At The Comedy Store (Comedy Central), Set List (Sky Atlantic), The John Bishop Show (BBC1) and Live At The Electric (BBC3). Winner: Best Comedy Show – Fringe World Awards. “Fresh, accessible and hilarious” (Guardian) “Uniquely funny” ***** (Scotsman) This show is being recorded for the Whine List podcast.

shows.title: David Eagle’s Funny Flim Flam
shows.description: I’m back! Your favourite blind folk singing comedian returns with another hour of songs and stories. My last hour won Best Variety Show at Leicester Comedy Festival, and the Spirit Of The Fringe Award (previously won by Ross Noble, Stewart Lee, Adam Hills), so I reckon it’s therefore statistically likely that this show will at the very least surpass mediocrity. Featuring pigeons, French lesbians, a talking teddy, Daleks, militant Morris dancers, a song from me at seven about my mate who pissed himself in the street, and some Princess Margaret themed erotica.

shows.title: Magic Gareth: Balloonatic
shows.description: Ever wanted to see a BALLOON fly on its own? Witness the BIGGEST Balloon in the WORLD? … and a whole load of other things that you really shouldn’t try at home? BALLOONATIC is full of MINDBLOWING Magic, bonkers balloons and fun for all the family! With over 10 million online views, MG is a pro and has a show that will have you believing magic really DOES exist! Ages 5+ ‘Takes you back to believing magic exists’ – BBC Radio WM ‘… magic doesn’t get much better than this!’ – World Magic Review ‘My daughter actually smiled for two hours straight after that show!’ – Russell Kane

shows.title: Benny Shakes: Slugageddon!
shows.description: Slugs, slugs and more slugs!! Can you help Benny defeat the slug army with a piano made of vegetables, some delicious compost and a final showdown with the boss? Interactive & multimedia games, plenty of facts about biodiversity and of course, slugs. With some actually really great gardening tips for the grown ups… Best Kids’ Show NOMINEE – UK Kids’ Comedy Festival ★★★★ “Benny Shakes is a great comic, end of story – Stageside UK WINNER – Disability Champions Award “Its most subtle lesson [is that] that we’re easily relating to somebody who happens to have cerebral palsy” Broadway Baby

shows.title: Leslie Bloom Solves A Murder
shows.description: Leslie Bloom welcomes all new members to the Toddlingham Neighbourhood Watch. Nothing could possibly go wrong, could it? A combination of crafted comedy, pure silliness, and whimsical improv, Leslie Bloom brings an hour of joyful laughter that celebrates the detective in us all. ‘Leslie Bloom was as intriguing as she was beguiling…’ ★★★★★ (Voice Mag)

shows.title: Achtung!! Das Third Coming!
shows.description: ACHTUNG!! The Germans are back… again. A gloriously absurd night of comedy, music and mischief from Jürgen Strack — and a special guest. Expect character-driven stand-up, surreal riffs and satirical twists on history and stereotypes, all delivered with Jürgen’s trademark blend of charm and chaos. Think Eurovision meets Dad’s Army via a Berlin beer hall singalong. It’s stand-up, it’s storytelling, it’s absurd silliness — and it’s one night only. What others say: “Very funny, memorable comedian” – The Stand “Wunderbar!” – Monkey Barrel Comedy

shows.title: Name of the Dame
shows.description: Dames, detectives, stylish hats, ‘car chases’… this parody of the film noir genre has got a gag rate that fires faster than a Tommy-gun and is marginally less painful. If you like Airplane, the oeuvre of Mel Brooks, dicey puns and sight gags, this show is probably for you. NOTD is influenced by the likes of satirical masterpieces AIRPLANE and POLICE SQUAD. Come see the play that reviewers say ‘has broad appeal – silly, daft, hilarious, and highly entertaining’, is ‘easily the best show I’ve seen at The Fringe’ and is ‘hilarious from the first second’.

shows.title: Robin Ince: Let the Quiet Ones Rise
shows.description: Robin, star of the Infinite Monkey Cage, winner of Author of the Year, Celebrity Mastermind AND House of Games, returns with an evening of stories and poetry about everything in the known Universe and some musing on the unknowns too. A show about the incredible diversity of our minds and the possibilities that come with that. “an absolute delight” Fest “a lovely hour” The List

shows.title: Catie Wilkins: We’ll See
shows.description: Drunk Women Solving Crime star explores how to deal with flashers, cope with a snoring husband who insists he isn’t snoring (or even asleep) and avoid being bullied by your own children. Plus how far into foreplay is it inappropriate to ask if the door is locked? How do you juggle work, family and healing generational trauma? Credits include Jon and Lucy’s Odd Couples, Pointless Celebrities, Guilty Feminist Mash-Up. Winner: Writer’s Guild Award for sketch comedy, Lollies Award for funniest teen fiction book. ‘Properly funny'(Independent). ‘Brilliantly funny and painfully true’ (JennyColgan).

shows.title: Hannah East: Express Yourself
shows.description: Hannah East’s brand-new show is a hilarious deep dive into the highs and lows of parenting. From pregnancy and labour to breastfeeding, postpartum struggles, and everyday parenting challenges, her sketches hit home with honesty and humour. Audiences love her for saying what mums are really thinking—but rarely say out loud. With her warm-hearted tone, relatable mum impressions, and fearless wit, Express Yourself is a must-watch. Expect brand-new skits, more wigs, celebrity send-ups, and laugh-out-loud moments every parent will relate to.

Not available Please contact the venue

shows.title: OK Zoomer – Young Comedian Showcase
shows.description: Award-winning 16 year old comedian Tom Williams comperes OK Zoomer. A showcase of the next generation of comedy, with a hand-picked line-up of the sharpest 16–25 year-olds taking the stage. From TikTok obsessions to cost-of-living chaos, dating apps to dodgy landlords, these comics bring raw honesty, fresh perspectives and fearless energy. Smart, silly and gloriously unpredictable, it’s a night that proves Gen Z aren’t just online—they’re live, loud and laughing at the madness of modern life. The future of stand-up is already here, and it looks like this. Suitable for all ages 16+

shows.title: Stevie Gray’s Flat Cap Comedy in Enderby
shows.description: Join the wonderfully warm and funny Stevie Gray, as he brings 3 more headline acts to the Mill Hill Cask and Coffee venue in Enderby. This show has been running several times a year since 2021 and has welcomed some of the best in the business to a tiny venue in Enderby. These shows always sell out, so make sure you are quick to purchase tickets to avoid disappointment.

shows.title: Everards Beer Hall – Comedy Quiz!
shows.description: Everards Beer Hall – Comedy Quiz! 8pm. £2pp Max 6 in a team Email tf@everards.co.uk to enter a team

shows.title: Russell Hicks: A Work That is Forever in Progress (an actual work in progress)
shows.description: Russell Hicks, who you’ve seen on BBC, Amazon Prime, or from his viral Dear Diary videos on social media, and in Edgar Wright’s Running Man, is building a new show.

shows.title: “The Hairy Indian Bikers” without the Bikes (because our mums won’t let us)
shows.description: oin hairy Indians Tharun Chelley and Hitz Unadkat as they join forces to provide you with pure laughter for an hour! They’re a bit like the Hairy Bikers but they’re not allowed to ride motorbikes as their mums say motorbikes are too dangerous. So basically, they’re not like the Hairy Bikers at all.. They’re just a bunch of hairy Indians doing stand-up comedy!

shows.title: Rahul Somia: Cooking (WIP)
shows.description: Chef Rahul is WIPping some jokes up, but what exactly is on the menu? Will the jokes be cooked? Will they be seasoned? Is Rahul cooked? Join Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year nominee, Rahul Somia, to see if he can get his Michelin Stars?

shows.title: Joke Spot @ Beaumont Leys Library
shows.description: Roll up! Roll up! Joke Spot makes you the star as we invite anyone under the age of 18 to take the mic and become a comedian. Our pop-up stage will be touring Leicester throughout the festival and it’s up to you to drop-in and tell us your best jokes. More venues may be announced throughout the festival, so keep an eye on our socials @kidscomedyfest or our website!
