shows.title: Duncan Shmuncan
shows.description: Songs, poems, stories and nonsense from award-winning musical funnyman Duncan Oakley. Joyously imaginative entertainment for children and parents alike. “Joyful, charming and very, very funny” – Gary Delaney “Brilliant. A true, funny entertainer” – BAFTA winner Dave Johns

shows.title: Alfie Moore: Fair Cop (Work In Progress)
shows.description: Alfie Moore returns with a fun-filled, interactive ‘warm up’ shows ahead of recording Series 10 of his hit BBC Radio 4 comedy ‘It’s A Fair Cop’. Alfie ‘swears in’ the audience as police officers before sharing brand new, real-life scenarios from his ‘casebook’. He playfully challenges the audience cops to say what they would’ve done in his shoes – with often unexpected and entertaining results! Every show is unique to the audience in the room – so why not come and find out what sort of cop you’d make?! It’d be a crime to miss it! “Brilliantly funny… genuinely hilarious” – David Mitchell

shows.title: Will Davies: Heroic Scale (Work In Progress)
shows.description: It’s a big, scary world out there and it’s easy to feel small and helpless in the face of it all. But is that true? Can just one little thing make a big change? Does every little help? Can you really make a mountain out of a molehill? Who’s to say? Join Will Davies as he attempts to find out in this new hour of fresh stand-up comedy. (Work in progress). “….relatable, clever comedy for audiences of all ages… subtle, subversive, and deeply funny….” – A Youngish Perspective **** NTK Pick of the Edinburgh Fringe 2025 The Times Best Jokes of the Edinburgh Fringe 2024

shows.title: Den Of Laughs: Festival Flavour
shows.description: Den of Laughs brings you a hand-picked lineup of funny acts from Leicester Comedy Festival, so you can get a flavour of their shows. Your host, the friendly, quick-witted and pun-loving Denzil de Cristo (“is armed with a brain that fires off puns like a malfunctioning Nerf gun” – One4Review), will guide you through an hour of comedic hilarity. Sizzling sets, spicy standup, pungent puns, moreish musical comedy and maybe mouth-watering magic. This is one taster menu you don’t want to miss. Find out what’s on the menu at www.DenOfLaughs.co.uk

shows.title: Hazed & Bemused
shows.description: Fresh off their sold out Rik Mayall festival run, Ash & Max are two comics with distinct styles of comedy, united by the fact they are both under-achieving stoners. Ash, equipped with dry one-liners & Max, an energetic, anecdotal performer. This is an 18+ work-in-progress that will be silly, dark & probably half-baked. Ash and Max are regulars on the Birmingham comedy scene, with Ash having won Project Mayhem Best Act 2024, and Max having been the support act for Scott Bennett. They’re both like, really cool too.

shows.title: Anstey Comedy Club
shows.description: Join us at The Kneaded Pint for Anstey Comedy Club as we get cosy in this intimate micropub, sit back and enjoy some of the best comedians on the UK comedy circuit and delicious craft beer. At previous shows Anstey Comedy Club has hosted the likes of Scott Bennett (Live at the Apollo) Shazia Mirza (Would I Lie to You?) Ian Stone (QI) and many more – don’t miss your chance to catch top acts in this tiny pub with huge laughs!

shows.title: Anthony Williams is a Pathological Penny Pincher
shows.description: Anthony Williams takes penny-pinching to extremes, but saving money doesn’t always pay. From loyalty points worth less than a Freddo to a “bargain” holiday that ends in chaos with the Bulgarian Mafia, his thrift spirals into disaster. Expect stories of haggles gone wrong, receipts examined like crime scenes, and savings that cost far more than they’re worth. A sharp, high-energy circuit comic in demand, Anthony turns the madness of money into riotous laughs. “The Bulgarian holiday was a great routine … a very impressive set” – Notts Comedy Review. A favourite on the UK circuit since 2019

shows.title: Clinton Baptiste: Spectral Intercourse
shows.description: Hot on the heels of his fourth sell-out UK tour, the nation’s favourite clairvoyant medium, from Peter Kay’s Phoenix Nights, Clinton Baptiste is back with a new live show for 2026 and beyond! In a rudderless world, mankind needs an envoy to gather solutions from the all-knowing, all-seeing Afterlife. But who should it be? Of course, there’s only one man for the job – Clinton Baptiste. Receiving the audiences’ queries and earthbound dilemmas, Clinton will then reach out to spirits for answers. Fear not. He will probe sensitively. Spiritual connection. Mystical congress… Spectral Intercourse.

shows.title: Gareth Gwynn: Cyril (Work in Progress)
shows.description: Cyril Gwynn (1897-1988), also known as The Bard Of Gower, was “a tall, sunburnt, unsmiling farmer”. Gareth Gwynn (1983-Present) is none of these things. Gareth did not spend WWI in the navy, has never been shipwrecked or tried to emigrate to Australia but he’s determined to find something he and his great-grandfather have in common. Gwynn (1983 ed.) has written for The Now Show, The News Quiz & HIGNFY and co-wrote Ankle Tag (BBC Radio 4) & Tourist Trap (BBC One Wales). He co-presents the podcast I’m So Not Over It & Gareth Gwynn Hasn’t Fin- on BBC Radio 4 (“Hilarious” – The Guardian).

shows.title: Bridging the Gap
shows.description: The second year of our new scheme which aims to make Leicester Comedy Festival more inclusive for comedians and audiences. We’ve selected 6 incredible comedians, and you can get a sample of their own shows – all part of the festival in various venues and dates. Hosted by Eshaan Akbar, come and have a laugh with Alice India, Salma Lyons, Lawrence Dodd, Kate Hammer, Verity Sharpe & Maxine Wade. All profit will be put forward next year’s scheme. Sponsored by Equity.

shows.title: Proper Funny Comedy’s Graduation Showcase
shows.description: Proper Funny Comedy proudly presents the graduates from it’s 2026 comedy workshops! Come watch new and established stand-up stars as they take to the stage (some for the very first time) to showcase new sets, all held together by local comedian (and their mentor for the past 6 weeks) Jay Neale.

shows.title: 101 Clean Jokes in 1 Hour
shows.description: Award-winning gag merchant Masai Graham, UK Pun Championship Winner 2016, Joke of the Fringe Winner 2016, 2021 and 2022, delivers over 100 clean jokes in 30 mins. Expect puns, one-liners and wordplay in this 3.3 laughs-per-minute bonanza. “Flashes of genius” ★★★★ (Chortle) Featuring guest spots from some of the best joke tellers on the circuit.

shows.title: Sophie Duker: The Sophie Duker Show (WIP)
shows.description: This IS a drill! The eldest daughter of UK comedy is back in Leicester trialling her spiciest material to date. Join Taskmaster champion & panel show princess Sophie Duker as she tests out scandalous new jokes for her 2026/27 epic. Strap in, sit tight and do not adjust your sets as we bring you… The Sophie Duker Show.

shows.title: Steve Hall Gives His Head A Wobble
shows.description: Tour support for Frank Skinner and Russell Howard. “Steve Hall is the most intelligent stand-up you’ve never heard of” (GQ). “Wonderfully misanthropic” (Sunday Times). “One of the finest comedic minds of our generation” (Russell Howard). This show was nearly called The Sighs of My Penis.

shows.title: James Cook: Very Good Comedian
shows.description: “a genuine laugh every 10 seconds ★★★★★” – Broadway Baby, “a top class comedian” – Birmingham Mail. British Comedian of the Year finalist. Can an award-winning professional stand-up comedian without any major TV credits or social media fill a small-ish room on the free on a Wednesday at 9pm? I’d like to live in a world where that was possible. Look, I’ve been doing this a while, I know what I’m doing. You’ll laugh for an hour.

shows.title: Lady Bolognese: CLASS WAR
shows.description: School dinner ladies, Barbara and Veronica, are in charge now. They’ve been through thick (custard) and thin (gravy). And now they’re serving up a scrumptious blend of greasy friendship and anarchic delight, with hints of impending peril. If you behave, you’ll be home in time for cocoa and Fray Bentos. It’s Thelma & Louise meets George’s Marvellous Medicine meets a big pile of offal. So feed, learn, and come of age. Lady Bolognese have prepared their specialty. Developed with Above Your Nerve and Soho Theatre Labs.

shows.title: Inf-Al-Grant-Ay
shows.description: Dirty Songs, Jokes & Magic. It’s Al Grant – If you you know – you know. Yes there will be excerpts from Breaking Bad the Musical. Oh, There may be spoilers. People have been begging me not to do Better Call Saul the whimsical Musical just yet. Until they have finished watching the finale. There are loads of ear worms that will infest your little head. You will be humming and whistling each of these bawdy songs for months. You deserve this. You really Deserve this. Turn up, buy some drinks, settle down and enjoy the show. Catch him in flagrante delicto

shows.title: Funny Fosse Comedy Quest
shows.description: No ticket required. Funny Fosse Comedy Quest Pick up your comedy quest maps at Mason’s Il Cappo Del Caffe, fosse meadows everyday 8:45am – 4pm. Fosse Meadows Country Park, Sharnford, LE10 3AB

shows.title: Fosse Fox Trail – Comedy Festival Takeover!
shows.description: No ticket required. Blaby District Fosse Foxes Trail – Follow the Funny Foxes! The Fosse Foxes across Blaby District are getting a comedy twist this February! Scan the QR code on each sculpture to unlock a quick laugh. It’s free, family-friendly, and part of Leicester Comedy Festival. How many will you find? Explore the trail and interactive map at: www.visitblaby.org.uk/fosse-foxes

shows.title: The Completely Made-up History of Coalville
shows.description: On this interactive walking trail created by pupil’s at Broom Leys Primary, hear the hilarious, mysterious, baffling and completely made-up history of some of Coalville’s most notorious landmarks. This a self-guided trail, use the app ‘GoJauntly’ on Android or iOS and search “The Completely Made-up History Of Coalville” from February 5th.

shows.title: The Completely Made-up History of Leicester 2!
shows.description: We’re back for another self-guided tour! It’s Leicester, but not quite as you know it…. On this walking trail, hear what the fabulous minds of Leicestershire primary schools have to say about the history of these Leicester landmarks. This is a self-guided trail, use the app ‘GoJauntly’ on Android or iOS and search “The Completely Made-up History Of Leicester” from February 4th.

shows.title: The Completely Made-up History of Leicester
shows.description: It’s Leicester, but not quite as you know it…. On this walking trail, hear what the fabulous minds of Leicestershire primary schools have to say about the history of these Leicester landmarks. This is a self-guided trail, use the app ‘GoJauntly’ on Android or iOS and search “The Completely Made-up History Of Leicester” from February 4th.

shows.title: Laugh Academy: Half-term Comedy School (11-14)
shows.description: Our dedicated half-term school for aspiring stand-ups is back for 2025! This specially designed course will give you the chance to learn tips and tricks of the trade from real life comedians. Plus, you get to perform at the Laugh Academy Showcase on the final day of the course. No experience necessary. Places are very limited, so participants get maximum support. Age 11-14, please see alternative listing for 15-18 workshops. Cost: £50 full price/£30 concession for the full week, booking of first session covers the entire course.

shows.title: Ask Granny – Kids
shows.description: Granny’s back—bringing giggles, tickles & a sprinkle of chaos! Ask Granny is the laugh-out-loud, interactive show where NaanE—the fruit-loving, fun-making granny—turns kids’ questions into silly games and hilarious life hacks. A sell-out hit, featured on BBC TV & NRTF shortlisted, and created by multi-award-nominated, internationally acclaimed Ishi2funny. “A tower of mischievous fun!” – Nottingham Post. Audience verdict: “Hug and best show I’ve ever seen!” – 10-year-old. No two shows are the same—bring your curiosity and join the fun!!

shows.title: Edy Hurst’s Dream Park!: Work-In-Progress
shows.description: Join comedian Edy Hurst (“Bursts with comedy joy” The Skinny) on a family fun-fuelled extravaganza as we build the world’s greatest theme park whilst also attempting to get planning permission. Spills, thrill, and local building regulations! ★ ★ ★ ★ ★- “Effortlessly Funny” ND review ★ ★ ★ ★ – The Skinny ★ ★ ★ ★ – “Absolutely Non-stop Bonkers” British Comedy Guide ★ ★ ★ ★ – “Explosive in comedy energy” One4Review ★ ★ ★ ★ – “Explosive in comedy energy” One4Review ★ ★ ★ ★ – “An awful lot of fun” OntheMic Supported by Z-arts and Waterside Arts

shows.title: Joke Spot @ New Parks Library
shows.description: Roll up! Roll up! Joke Spot makes you the star as we invite anyone under the age of 18 to take the mic and become a comedian. Our pop-up stage will be touring Leicester throughout the festival and it’s up to you to drop-in and tell us your best jokes. More venues may be announced throughout the festival, so keep an eye on our socials @kidscomedyfest or our website!

shows.title: Richard Atkinson: Saints Alive
shows.description: Whilst at primary school Richard was pulled up by his teacher for drawing Jesus wearing jeans and playing football. Stunned at his historical inaccuracy he has sought to right the wrongs and learn about the Saints of the Christian Church. “Saints don’t wear Jeans,” scoffed the teacher but now Carlo Acutis has been canonized Richard wonders if he was simply a visionary? Richard III isn’t a Saint but Henry VI nearly made it! A fascinating journey pulling up some of the more unusual elements of more than 20 Saints this promises to be an opportunity to explore faith with a light hearted twist.

shows.title: Laugh Academy: Half-term Comedy School (15-18)
shows.description: Our dedicated half-term school for aspiring stand-ups is back for 2025! This specially designed course will give you the chance to learn tips and tricks of the trade from real life comedians. Plus, you get to perform at the Laugh Academy Showcase on the final day of the course. No experience necessary. Places are very limited, so participants get maximum support. Age 15-18, please see alternative listing for 11-14 workshops. Cost: £50 full price/£30 concession for the full week, booking of first session covers the entire course.

shows.title: Leicester Comedy Festival Archive Exhibition
shows.description: The Leicester Comedy Festival archive is one of the biggest archives of British comedy. Usually preserved and stored at De Montfort University, this special exhibition gives you the chance to look through photographs, items, and more gathered over the more than 30-year history of the festival. Exhibition open during The Big Difference venue opening hours for Leicester Comedy Festival. Please note, this event is unticketed and you are welcome to drop in and view the exhibition at any point during its opening hours.

shows.title: Warren Martin: Proud Father, Exhausted Dad
shows.description: Warren Martin, the architect of his own troubles, strives to be a perfect father but barely manages to be adequate, a fact obvious to everyone except for himself. Story after story of incompetence and struggle will make you wonder how he’s even got this far. He tells the story of his life from the birth of his children to their teenage years, covering his work and interview misunderstandings, family holidays and oblique observations of life. This window into his existence will reveal the funny side of life to all, except him.

shows.title: Going Coastal with Donald McGinty
shows.description: TV Presenter Donald McGinty sets sail with his award-nominated show (Best Poster Design – Brighton Fringe 2024). He’ll share his TV mishaps and how he got over his fear of the sea after all those people drowned. There’s an earnest bit about the environment, a vaguely satisfying dramatic arc and a very niche reference to the TV show Neighbours. It’s a light hearted, light entertainment show that’s surprisingly dark for its time slot, with jokes about the seaside, seagulls and c-list celebrities. “McGinty proves an affable captain of this enjoyable pleasure cruise.” Chortle

shows.title: Desperate Sketchwives by Chaos Theory
shows.description: A sketch and character show like no other. Two women, two men, some music. Seen at Edinburgh, Brighton, Camden and Faversham Fringes, Vault and Sketchoff. Between them the company have played a puddle in an advert, worked with David Icke, worked with Dario Fo, stripped for Danish TV and written for BBC TV, BBC Films, ITV and West End. Sketches are short and quick-fire, from light to dark and disturbing to running for your mum – but in a good way! Always funny! Among others they include Dracula’s air b and b, a new take on Bowie’s Space Oddity, swingers, deranged art critics and shoe love.

shows.title: 5 Comedians do Comedy & Karaoke
shows.description: Do you like comedy? Do you like karaoke? If yes to both, then this is the show for you. Five comedians do their short comedy set followed by their favourite karaoke song, feel free to sing along!

shows.title: Currer Ball: The Neighbours
shows.description: A comedy show about the couple next door. The perfect couple. Except… What were those noises coming through the wall this morning? And who was that knocking at their door in the middle of the night? And what were they really throwing out at the recycling bins? Currer smells a rat and not just because his flat’s infested. Notting Hill meets Rear Window in a story packed with jokes and twists from a New Act of the Year finalist.

shows.title: Disabled Cants
shows.description: A revolving lineup of disabled comedians and friends present an irreverent comedy show for your enjoyment. We’re not brave, we’re not inspiring, we’re just here to make you laugh and park in the disabled bays. “Wonderfully relaxed and friendly” The Scotsman ★★★★★ “The most accessible, friendly and inclusive show I’ve ever seen” – Neurodiverse Review WINNER Disability Champions Award 2023 “Searing political rants, baited breath and a spit full of laughs ” LeftLion”

shows.title: Grace Mulvey: Did You Hear We’re All Going To Die?
shows.description: Grace doesn’t fear death. Just back fat, fascism and low-rise jeans. Dubbed The Death Queen, she will teach you how not to be weird about loss. Growing up in Ireland with a dad who casually reads his will over lunch at Yo! Sushi and a mum who takes a great funeral selfie, her approach to death is unconventional. A highly anticipated and darkly funny show. “one of the most uplifting shows I have seen” 4 Stars – EdFringe Reviews “She has the word funny running through her veins” 4 Stars – Beyond The Joke “her writing is razor sharp” 4 Stars – One4Review

shows.title: James Hately: Clutter
shows.description: In the moss-covered remnants of a comedy club, amongst broken props, a snail-crossed setlist taped to the stage reads: “The bins are breeding and the fortune cookies are spilling their slips into the gutters”. Like an unmuted silent movie character in full colour, Humptdumptian Cobble Charmer James Hately stumbles into the microcosmic maelstrom of his own tattered thoughts, attempting to sow them into a tapestry. Groundedly off the wall. Funny bits a gogo.

shows.title: Nathan Cassidy: Ewwww!
shows.description: Multi-award winning and critically acclaimed comic with a new show about something he doesn’t want to reveal. WARNING: CONTAINS FULL-FRONTAL NUDITY. Ewwww!’ ★★★★1/2 ‘Written and delivered with style. An excellent comedian’ One4Review 2025 ‘Few have been as deeply moving. A powerful force on stage’ The Scotsman 2025. Star of 3 Amazon Prime Specials, BBC Radio 5 Live and million downloaded podcast ‘Daily Notes’. Leicester Comedy Festival Best Show Nominee for ‘Observational’ (European Tour 2025). 13 Comedy Award wins/nominations 2019-2025. Work In Progress. www.nathancassidy.com/ewwww

shows.title: Sarah Johnson: Crafternoon With Carol
shows.description: Self-acclaimed Craftaholic, Carol, has been influencing the creative minds of multiple people for weeks now. Her work has been featured on all her own social media platforms. Carol’s mission -‘Inspire many humans to feel joy and confidence through cutting and sticking’. So why not join this phenomenal multi-crafter, in her Crafternoon Masterclass and take-home skills you never wanted. “Johnson is an excellent performer” 4.5**** (One4Review) https://sarahljohnson.co.uk/

shows.title: 100% Badgers with Matt Hobs
shows.description: 100% Badgers is the Edinburgh Fringe 2025 sell-out stand-up comedy show about how the worlds of humans and badgers collide. We’ll learn about the European badger and its dachshund nemesis, the presidential American badger, the world-famous internet sensation that is the honey badger and many more. “His storytelling is gripping, his facts are fascinating, and his punchlines are perfectly timed.” ★★★★.5 (Edinburgh Reviews). “… a fusion of badger facts, sharp jokes and winning West Country charm… it’s a show about badgers – but this is no gimmick.” ★★★★ (Broadway Baby).

shows.title: Gallowtree Radio
shows.description: To celebrate the 10 year anniversary of our first podcast release we have adapted an episode as a live performance for the festival. Gallowtree Radio is set in the parallel universe of a town called Gallowtree, where strange things happen to strange people. Come and join Max Black and Adam Aardvark and enter Gallowtree for a romp through time and a dubious presentation of historical events. What is real? What is fact? What the? You be the judge. Gallowtree Radio is a Gallowtree Entertainment Broadcast available on your podcast provider. Search for “Gallowtree Radio”

shows.title: Jordan Gray: Is That A C*ck In Your Pocket Or Are You Just Here To Kill Me?
shows.description: Following acclaimed runs in London and Edinburgh, the multi-award-winning star and creator of ITV’s Transaction hits the road with a guitar on her back, a bounty on her ballbag, and some very poorly written death threats in her DMs. When Jordan stripped off live on Channel 4 (and won a BAFTA in the process), bigots around the globe went ballistic. Luckily… so were her tits.

shows.title: Kathryn Haywood: Magic & Sex
shows.description: Kath has been asked to do some magic tricks during Barbara’s sex show to “fill in any holes” but Barb hasn’t shown up, leaving Kath to do it all on her own. “Non stop hilarity” The Reviews Hub “Hilarious and heartbreaking” Stagey Reviews You’ve never seen magic like this before and you never will again (& sex). A new show from the creators of hit comedy, YOGA & SEX…for women (over 40).

shows.title: Samantha Day: The Great British Menu (of Petty Complaints)
shows.description: Leicester Comedy Festival’s 2025 Award Winner returns this year with a new comedy show that treats Britain’s most trivial problems with the seriousness they deserve. It’s always Whine O’Clock in Britain. Other people! Driving too slowly, making grammatical errors and joking about the wrong things. Britain has never been so divided – and this show will certainly make it worse! “Just brilliant” Arthur Smith “A highly engaging performer” Chortle Funny Women Stage Award – Finalist (2025) British Comedy Guide Pro Award – Finalist (2025)

shows.title: Two Mr P’s in a Podcast Live: Let That be a Lesson
shows.description: Join the Two Mr Ps as they take their award-winning podcast back on the road with Let That Be A Lesson… Prepare for an evening filled with laughter as they share more hilarious stories and anecdotes about the challenges teachers, parents, and school staff face while working with the most unintentionally funny comedians of all – children. The Two Mr Ps will have you laughing until your cheeks hurt. And just like in school, audience participation is encouraged! You can submit your own stories, confessions, dilemmas and embarrassing moments to be read anonymously during the show here.

shows.title: An Asian Occasion
shows.description: An Asian Occasion is a compilation of the best stand up comics of Asian descent. The show has sold out the past 3 years at Leicester Comedy Festival and has welcomed the best comedians from award winners to Live At The Apollo stars. Previous headliners include Eshaan Akbar, Ahir Shah, Shazia Mirza and Imran Yusuf.

shows.title: Denzil de Cristo: Artificially Intelligent Procrastinating Pundit
shows.description: Puns, pedantry and parodies about robots, relationships and religion Whimsical Tales jam-packed with One-Liners. What was the very first dad joke ever told? What might happen when he dies? And why does he insist on singing? “Ludicrously bad” Simon Cowell Warning: Contains scenes of a sexually incompetent nature. “Fun, sharp one-liners” Comedy Lab “A performance full of delightful puns” Ram Comedy Festival “Witty one-liners backed up by genuinely funny concepts” 4/5 Lancaster Guardian “The gags arrive thick and fast Harry Hill–style surrealism meets George Formby era wordplay” **** One4Review

shows.title: 2 Slut Drops and a Chicken Burger
shows.description: Kirsty overshares about her sexy times, nights out and magnificent meltdowns. ‘She created an atmosphere where everyone let loose and enjoyed the wild ride. Munro’s candid storytelling had everyone in stitches’ ***** (BroadwayBaby.com). ‘Loveable, loud and bloody hilarious’ (TheFunnyFirm.co.uk). As seen on BBC Scotland’s Situationships.

shows.title: Big Backstory
shows.description: A debut solo show by Belgian artist Julian Gypens, combining stand-up comedy and contemporary dance to explore the amusing and fragile reality of living in a body that on a medical and scientific level has no ass…

shows.title: Foxy Frolics
shows.description: Join us for big laughs with top comedians! Every Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday at 8.30pm in the warm and cosy Georgian Room at Wygston’s House, and every Wednesday at 7.30pm at the Old Plough Inn in Birstall. A mixed bill featuring great headliners, held together by compere Ben Ennis. Don’t miss out!

shows.title: Garrett Millerick: We Tried It Your Way
shows.description: Garrett has spent the last year trying every self-help trend going. Healthier but not happier, he has some feedback for the influencers. Creator and star of BBC R4’s hit new comedy ‘Do Gooders’ brings his ‘Big Hitting Stand-Up’ (Guardian) back to Leicester for an evening of the no holds barred iconoclastic stand up that has made Garrett one of the stand out live acts of his generation. “A masterclass” ★★★★ The Telegraph “Has the room erupting with laughter. Cathartic. Clever. Funny.” ★★★★ The Scotsman “Smart, wide-ranging, playful and devastatingly funny” ★★★★★ Chortle

shows.title: Grace Mulvey: Work in Progress Show
shows.description: Hotly anticipated new Work in Progress show from BBC Galton & Simpson comedy winner Grace Mulvey, an Irish stand-up taking the UK comedy scene by storm. Co-host of the Fad Camp podcast (Irish Podcast Awards – Best Entertainment Podcast 2023), her debut show ‘Tall Baby’ was named one of Rolling Stone magazine’s ’12 stand-out shows of the Edinburgh Fringe 2024′. A finalist in the Vodafone Irish Comedian of the Year 2017, as well as Funny Women’s Ones to Watch 2019. ‘The kind of stand-up that offers everyone in the room an hour of guaranteed floor-to-ceiling laughs’**** (Beyond The Joke)

shows.title: Katie Pritchard is Sir Elton Scone (WIP)
shows.description: Leicester Comedy Festival Best Variety Show 2025 nominee Katie Pritchard is BACK with her latest ridiculous romp – Sir Elton Scone – he’s a bit like Elton John but he just looooves to bake (and for copyright reasons he is also nothing like Elton John). His shoulders are 40inches, his voice could fill 40 stadiums, and this b!tch is batch cooking! Expect high-octane musical comedy character madness from this “comedy music powerhouse”★★★★★ VoiceMag. WINNER Musical Comedy Awards

shows.title: Roar with Laughter at the Everards Beer Hall
shows.description: Roar With Laughter at Everards Beer Hall 8.30pm Age 18+ FREE As part of the 2026 Leicester Comedy Festival we welcome some of the finest stand up comedians on the scene to the our brilliant Beer Hall for your laughing pleasure! This evening fun will feature the most excellent and downright funny comedy delights of Jules O’Brian, Jon Wagstaffe and all held together by your host and MC Jason Neale! Do note that line-up is subject to change. LCF allocation sold out, please contact the venue on 0116 201 4101 for remaining tickets.

performances.mark: Not available Please contact the venue

shows.title: Chelsea Birkby is in full control the entire time (WIP)
shows.description: A stand-up hour on choice (or the illusion of it). You retain your free will or your money back. ★★★★★ EdFringeReview ★★★★ Telegraph ★★★★ Scotsman ★★★★ Chortle 2× Comedian’s Comedian Best Show nominee,Winner: Amused Moose Best Debut. Writer: Mock the Week. As seen on BBC1 and heard on RHLSTP. “She mixes pop culture silliness and smut with philosophy” British Theatre Guide ★★★★ Tour support: Fern Brady, Celya AB, Helen Bauer, Sarah Keyworth

shows.title: Alex Hylton: Don’t Worry, I’m Still A Man Of The People
shows.description: In 2025, Alex Hylton won Outstanding Lifetime Contribution to Leicester Comedy Festival aged just 29. Now he returns to make even more outstanding contributions as a little treat, just for you. (There’ll also be some average contributions and some mediocre at best contributions, working out which bits are which is part of the fun.) Join him as he works on a brand new show and warm your hands on the fire of a local legend. You’re welcome. A Storytelling Masterclass – Edfringereview.com

shows.title: The Odd Bite – Alternative Compilation Show
shows.description: A mixed-bill of somewhat unusual comedians. Perfect if you like your comedy on the quirkier end of the spectrum. Acts from our previous shows have gone on to Live at the Apollo, Russell Howard, Radio 4 etc. Audience reviews: ‘One of the best MCs I’ve ever seen’; ‘The acts were brilliant, compere was fantastic. We laughed so much’; ‘Loved this show! Great mix… a very warm, engaging and funny compere. Will definitely return: highly recommended!’ Who knows what you might see!

shows.title: Aaaaaaaargh: its the Monster Stand Up Show
shows.description: Feast on five of the tastiest up-and-coming comedians on the circuit in this stand-up comedy showcase, including your award-winning host, Masai Graham Joke of the Fringe Winner 2022, 2021 and 2016, Winner UK Pun Champion 2016. Showcasing a different line-up every night featuring the best of the fest. “A fun, lighthearted show thats a revolving door of comedians” Edinburgh Reviews.

shows.title: Oops my neurodiversity is showing!
shows.description: Nominated for Best Show by a Neurodiverse Artist at Brighton Fringe 2025, this joyful, chaotic, and heartfelt comedy experience brings real-life stories to the stage. LGBT+ and neurodiverse storytellers share moments of truth that inspire improvised scenes bursting with humour, connection, and radical visibility. No script, no limits — just bold, spontaneous theatre that celebrates the beauty of what makes us different. Come ready to laugh, feel, and embrace the unexpected!

shows.title: Joke Spot @ Pork Pie Library & Community Centre
shows.description: Roll up! Roll up! Joke Spot makes you the star as we invite anyone under the age of 18 to take the mic and become a comedian. Our pop-up stage will be touring Leicester throughout the festival and it’s up to you to drop-in and tell us your best jokes. More venues may be announced throughout the festival, so keep an eye on our socials @kidscomedyfest or our website!

shows.title: Make It Up As You Go! Mayhem
shows.description: Comedy, adventure and mayhem collide in this laugh-out-loud family show where kids are in charge! On-screen prompts let the audience decide what happens next, creating twists, silly surprises and big laughs. Leicester comedian Tej Dhutia (Funny Women Awards semi-finalist) teams up with daughter Tulsi and fellow comedian Thomas Hancock for comedy, storytelling and audience interaction. Perfect for children learning to read and upwards (and their grown-ups too!), this is wholesome chaos the whole family can enjoy! Babes-in-arms (under 12 months) go free if seated on an adult’s lap.

shows.title: Blaby – Comedy Creations for Families!
shows.description: Comedy Creations for Families! Come and create comedy props with Artist, Illustrator and Blaby Story Trail Creator Jessi Illustrates! Free event suitable for families with children 5 years and over.

shows.title: Story Time with Mama G
shows.description: Mama G will be sharing original stories and songs, and some of the best picture books on the market, in an uplifting story time for the whole family. There’ll be dancing and giggles galore as Mama G shares the power of being who you want and loving who you are! Described as “Everyone’s favourite pantomime dame,” (Metro), Mama G has been telling stories since 2018. In that time she has been a semi-finalist on Britain’s Got Talent, performed her show Off-Broadway, and performed at libraries, festivals, prides, museums and theatres all over the UK.

shows.title: Failfailfailfailwin!
shows.description: FailFailFailFailWin! is a joyful, interactive family comedy show from circus performers Mark and Loz. Circus is hard and this show doesn’t hide the many tries it takes to succeed! Through juggling, hula-hooping, diabolo, puppetry, plate spinning, and even a Swedish astronaut, audiences are invited on a playful adventure inside Loz’s brain after a big FAIL. Uplifting and agelessly relevant, it reframes mistakes as positive, vital steps in learning. With laughter, silliness, and plenty of chances to join in, this is circus and theatre at its most fun, physical, and heart-warming.

shows.title: The Supermalts: Comedy Workshops
shows.description: Clownprov duo ‘The Supermalts’ are back to help you with your comedy chops. Whether you’re an established performer keen to get reps in or a novice curious to try something new, all are welcome to: CLOWN FUNDAMENTALS – 3-6pm Fri 20th – learn and practice essential clown skills: creativity, resilience, sensitivity and pleasure to help you express your unique funny. Led by Carlos Sandin. IMPROV & PLAY – 5-8pm Sat 21st – play with joy, silliness and confidence in improvised scenes as we focus on following organic impulses, partner chemistry and identifying what’s funny. Led by Fred Newnes.

shows.title: Alice India: In Bloom
shows.description: Alice India has been through a lot, but it hasn’t dampened their spirit. “bubbly, effervescent” (Wee Review), Alice has had to make a lot of changes over the last few years from image to drinking habits, relationships and homes to jobs and manifestations. How does change in our lives change us as people? Fresh from a 5* award winning run at Edinburgh Fringe in 2025, Alice brings their new show In Bloom to Leicester Comedy Festival. ***** – Neurodiverse Review “Effortless” – Toothpaste on Toast “Charisma personified…. great routines delivered with aplomb” – Kiri Pritchard Mclean

shows.title: ACOMEDYTAPAS
shows.description: The LCF hit show with more comics than can be counted returns. Now in a new venue prize winning . Tickets usually sell out. Great fun & fast as f£$k… another comic every 4 minutes!!!! Fridays & Saturdays at 17.30, Sundays at 15.00.

shows.title: Grown-Up’s Story Time with Mama G
shows.description: Mama G will be sharing original stories and songs, and some of the best picture books on the market. Take a seat on the story carpet for an uplifting story time aimed at adults who want to re-discover the comfort of being who you want and loving who you are. It’s going to be a wholesome and very silly evening! Described as “Everyone’s favourite pantomime dame,” (Metro), Mama G has been telling stories since 2018. In that time she has been a semi-finalist on Britain’s Got Talent, performed her show Off-Broadway, and shared stories at literary festivals including Hay, Cheltenham and Edinburgh.

shows.title: 8 Out Of 10 Celts
shows.description: Eleanor Morton, Esyllt Sears and Mary Flanigan are back again with a chaotic gameshow that pits Wales, N Ireland and Scotland against each other in a series of increasingly silly tasks and games. Witness the stars of BBC Radio 4’s The Rest of US battle it out to see who will be crowned champion of the Celts and reign supreme over these sceptred isles. Guaranteed stupid fun. Over the course of three rounds, this live game show combines art attack challenges, jokes, general knowledge and general silliness, with enough good old-fashioned Celtic resentment to create stupid entertainment for all.

shows.title: Ben Barker: No More Mister Nice Guy
shows.description: Ben Barker is doing something he’s never done before. He’s going to tell the truth. For most of his life, Ben considered himself to be a nice guy who was “unlucky in love”. Now a husband and father, he had to reconsider… Was he really a nice guy? Or had he actually been a “Nice Guy” all this time? At last! We bring you the full story of this mild-mannered comic and his quest for Truth, Justice and the end to his Virginity! “…comic genius” – Three Weeks “Barker was hilarious” – Broadway Baby

shows.title: David Hoare: How To Live To 100 (WIP)
shows.description: Musical-One-Liner-Stand-Up Comedian David Hoare (aged 36) is going to teach you how to live to 100! The award winning Hoare brings his rude songs, stupid jokes and insightful expertise to Leicester Comedy Festival. David won the Audience Favourite Award at Musical Comedy Awards 2021, had a sell out run at Edinburgh Fringe 2022, a sold out shows at both Aberystwyth & Mach and was tour Support for Lauren Pattison, Alison Spittle & Dr Ed Patrick! “An annoyingly funny young man” Gary Delaney “With some slick one-liners and aggression akin to Bo Burnham, James Acaster or Tim Vine” -Deadline News

shows.title: Ele McKenzie: Work In Progress
shows.description: A work in progress from Ele McKenzie. That’s nice. Ele is an alumnus of The Pleasance Comedy Reserve and can be seen in Dave’s Live At The Moth Club, Channel 4’s BAFTA nominated Peaked and Everyone Else Burns and BBC Three’s RTS nominated Funboys.

shows.title: Katie Mitchell: Work in Progress
shows.description: The debut WIP of Katie’s brand new show. Expect a clownish sports movie, expect ANGER, expect Los Angeles vampires and an absolute banger of a song about 40 minutes in. Club Wormhole Gang Best in Class Alumni 2023 **** Wee Review **** Broadway World “A juggernaut of a comic performer” – Blizzard Comedy “Very inventive and very funny” – Wee Review “Katie Mitchell is an example of everything comedy should be” – Mark Dean Quinn

shows.title: Lawrence Dodd: This Can’t Be It (WIP)
shows.description: Loz Dodd believes he’s made something monumental in this playful, meta show exploring the strangeness of life and our inadequate attempts to grasp it. The show delights in losing its own thread, derailed by distractions, tangents and spontaneous song, whilst Loz perseveres, convinced he’s on the cusp of a profound insight. A feverish, experimental meander through the chaos of never quite knowing what it all means, but cracking on regardless. “A display of nuanced character comedy at its glorious best ★★★★★.” – Reviews Hub “A rare natural talent ★★★★.” – Theatre & Art Reviews

shows.title: Stuart Goldsmith: The Cosiest Year On Record (WIP)
shows.description: Two-time Leicester Comedy Festival award-winner Stuart Goldsmith works up a brand-new hour. As seen on Live at the Apollo (BBC), Conan (TBS), As Yet Untitled (U&Dave) and Russell Howard’s Stand Up Central (Comedy Central). Hilarious and candid climate comedy! Whether you’re frozen in fear or glued to the road, come and get unstuck as Stuart explores how to hold hope in your heart despite absolutely everything. “A master of the form” ★★★★★ Independent “The funny side of climate change… No, really!” ★★★★ Times “Piercingly funny” ★★★★ List ★★★★★ BroadwayWorld.com ★★★★★ TheReviewsHub.com

shows.title: Friz Frizzle’s Funny Turn
shows.description: Friz has been crafting parody songs for over two decades. Friz has also been pretty ill. A 2022 diagnosis of peripheral neuropathy almost made them retire from comedy. That is, until they got a big knee. A big knee that changed their life. ***** (NeurodiverseReview.co.uk). **** (BroadwayBaby.com). Winner of the Leicester Comedy Festival Best Show 2020, Writer for The Now Show, Mock the Week and Len Goodman’s Partners in Rhyme.

shows.title: Laugh Academy Showcase (11-14)
shows.description: Join us for the culmination of Laugh Academy! A showcase of young talent as participants from the programme take to the stage and perform comedy, some of them, for the very first time. These 11-14-year-olds have been working all week with professional comedians to learn the tricks of the trade. Come and spot the stars of the future.

shows.title: Adam Hopkins: Sorry, What? (Work In Progress)
shows.description: London-based stand-up Adam Hopkins’ work in progress show about how growing up with a deaf brother gave him a fascination with language and communication and helped him deal with the language barrier when he moved to Shanghai, China, for a new job. Hopkins performs at London’s top clubs such as Top Secret, Backyard, and The Bill Murray and opened for Kyle Kinane as part of Kinane’s 2025 UK tour. He has been featured by Comedy Central, and has written for VICE, Time Out, BBC Radio 4, and The Guardian, and was previously part of Leicester Comedy Festival’s Circuit Breakers programme.

shows.title: Becky Fury: My Dad paints Rainbows. Your Dad paints Roundabouts.
shows.description: A **** show by an award winning British Asian comic thats stuffed with great jokes and amazing insights about what it means to be a UK citizen at this weird time Funny and insightful this show celebrates multiculturalism and narratives of migration that have made Britain , if not Great then not quite so shit and uses historical observation and topical humour to look beyond the flag shagging and division and celebrates what it actually means to be British. If you can be proud the three lions are originally from Africa. Then this is the show for you ****tremendously talented ( off the mic)

shows.title: Jody Kamali: This Is My Dad
shows.description: After his father’s sudden death, Jody digs through his belongings, trying to uncover the man he thought he knew. Then suddenly – he’s back, just for an hour, to tell us who he was. A thoughtful, funny theatrical solo show about grief, secrets and the contradictions within us all. ‘exuberantly, unapologetically mindless… too funny’ The Guardian, ‘an astonishing tour de force’ Dark Chat, ‘Makes every individual moment entertaining’ The Stage Work in progress show.

shows.title: Louise Atkinson: Put t’kettle on, the show’s not ready.
shows.description: Winner of Leicester Comedian of the Year 2025 (oh have a word, love), Louise is bravely testing half-finished jokes and reckless ideas in front of actual humans in this WIP show. Expect sharp bits, daft tangents, and probably cookie crumbs. Come for the comedy, stay for the pint and a biscuit. Low expectations recommended. “Comparisons of Victoria Wood and Peter Kay” – Stuart Maconie. “An instantly likeable comic” – The Arts Desk

shows.title: Some-Antics Spoken Word and Comedy: LCF Special
shows.description: Join us for an evening of spoken word and comedy! We’ll have spoken word and comedy open mic, a poetry slam with cash prize, raffle, Ninja Bob (DJ) and feature Katie Slater. Sign up for the mic via Some-Antics socials or on the night.

shows.title: The Tale of the Original Jekyll and Hyde (told by a Mad Hatter from Stockport)
shows.description: Deacon Brodie isn’t that well known out of Edinburgh. Yet he inspired Robert Louis Stevenson to write Jekyll and Hyde. Similarly, Stanley isn’t that well known outside of Stockport. Yet he’s campaigned with Napoleon AND been up Everest with Mallory. Maybe. Possibly. Perhaps. By day, in the 18th Century, Deacon Brodie was a respectable cabinetmaker and councillor. Whereas by night, he was a masked burglar. In the Old Town. Somehow, Stanley gets roped into his escapades. And he could flipping well swing for it. In public! ‘Andy D commands the stage with an undeniable presence’ The Scotsman.

shows.title: Best in Class
shows.description: Best in Class proudly champions the rich talent of working class comedians. Sponsored by waste grounds, knock off trainers, spam, weed, the unions, crap schools, bunking off, failed MOT’s, failed GCSE’s, bus stops, payday loans, fierce mums, tired dads and empowerment. An extended fundraiser show hosted by award winning comedian Sian Davies (“Superb comedy timing” **** One4Review). Featuring new working class talent from across the UK and some very special guests. Winner Edinburgh Fringe Comedy Award **** The Scotsman **** Wee Review **** Broadway World ***** Theatre Village

shows.title: Darren Walsh: Do You Like Puns?
shows.description: ʞɔǝɥ ←flippin’ heck! Witness a pun Goliath in person, as Darren Walsh brings his 8ft frame and award winning act on the road. From appearing on Comic Relief to his ‘Jokes on the street’ series on social media, he’s been racking up millions of views, but live is where he thrives. Combining sound effects, videos, one-liners and improvised jokes based off audience suggestions, prepare for a comedy show like no other, bar pun. Book now, li is two short. “Punbelievable” ★★★★★ – The Mirror ★★★★ – The Sunday Express WINNER – Joke of the Edinburgh Fringe

shows.title: Dom McGovern: Stuns in New Photo (WIP)
shows.description: Stuns in New Photo is the work-in-progress show from award-entering comedian Dominic McGovern (Chicken Shop Date co-writer, BBC New Comedy Awards, Melbourne International Comedy Festival). Join Dom as he refuses to engage with any form of self-acceptance and instead yaps at you for 55 minutes about rock climbing, Miss Piggy, and the TV show Glee. Tour support for Sophie Duker and Olga Koch. “endlessly entertaining and outrageously funny” Rolling Stone “undeniable charisma” The Wee Review

shows.title: Jain Edwards: She-Devil
shows.description: Jain isn’t like other girls. She’s worse. But she’s finally ready to Lean In (and receive a little forehead kiss from hubby). She-Devil is a show about conspiracy theories, autism and men turning on you. Winner: Neurodiverse Review Actually Autistic Award 2025. 10 of the best shows to catch at this year’s Edinburgh fringe. (Guardian) ‘Exceptionally winsome surrealism…dementedly good’ (Scotsman) ‘Hugely talented’ (Skinny). ‘The laughs come thick and fast’ (Fest) ‘Genius writing…a working class laureate’ (British Comedy Guide) ★★★★★ Neurodiverse Review ★★★★ Scotsman ★★★★ Fest ★★★★ Herald

shows.title: Live at The Hub
shows.description: Laugh the night away at the Menphys Hub with an incredible line-up of comedy talent! Headliner Eshaan Akbar (Live at the Apollo, QI, Mock the Week, Netflix’s Sex Education) brings his sharp wit and unforgettable characters. Hosting the evening is the brilliant Olga Koch (Mock the Week, QI, Live at the Apollo), while rising star Pravanya Pillay (Chortle Best Newcomer Nominee) delivers surreal, anecdotal comedy. With one more fantastic comedian still to be announced, this is a night you won’t want to miss!

shows.title: Mary Flanigan: Scream If You Want To Go Slower
shows.description: Mary Flanigan wants to take you on a journey to the furthest reaches of the universe but she’s on a budget so have some comedy instead. Everything a bit much? Relax by watching an Irish woman do something. Characters? Special guests? Games? Mental breakdown? It’s all on the table. Comedy nonsense from a nonsensical comedian. 2025 Funny Women Awards Semi-Finalist. ‘Smart, pithy…sharp and astute’. Chortle

shows.title: Mikey Bligh-Smith: Full Frontal Mikey Mode
shows.description: A funny comedy show all about a silly little guy called me. Madcap prop chaos. Tremendous jokes and wordplay. Hardcore, unfiltered, full-frontal Mikey Mode. Mikey Bligh-Smith is an alternative comedian and kindly clown from Huddersfield. Member of anarchic sketch comedy group The Lovely Boys. ‘Very fun… meticulously weird’ Guardian ‘Unexpectedly and unexplainable brought me to tears’ Entertainment Focus ‘Cracking physical comedy’ Chortle Sketch Off Finalist As seen on Disney+

shows.title: Milton Jones
shows.description: Milton Jones, is an award-winning comedian whose shirt style reflects his comic style, eclectic and surreal. You may know him from Mock the Week, Live at the Apollo and, for one night only, he will be bringing his unique humour to Leicester Cathedral. Chris Stokes, who has previously supported Milton on his tours ‘Milton Jones is Out There’ and ‘Milton Jones and the Temple of Daft’, will be supporting him. Doors will open an hour before the performance starts. There will be a bar to purchase refreshments & toilets on site. Seats are unassigned and will be first come first in the band.

shows.title: Phil Green: Stripped
shows.description: Phil has decided to be honest about his deepest life regrets and will lay them bare… well, most of them anyway. As heard on BBC Radio 4. Following three sold-out Edinburgh Fringe runs, multiple award nominations, over 20 million views on TikTok and selling out London’s Soho Theatre, Phil brings us his latest work-in-progress show. **** The List **** North West End **** Theatre & Arts Review “Phil Green is the real deal….he wows the room into gushes of laughter” British Comedy Guide.

shows.title: Sue Perkins: The Eternal Shame of Sue Perkins
shows.description: You may know her as Bake-Off Sue, Taskmaster Sue, Just A Minute Sue, or the Sue that gives you travel envy – but stand-up Sue is full of surprises. In this brand-new show, she shares the unlikely happenings from a career in the spotlight. What’s the fallout when your pituitary gland goes haywire on live TV? How do you convince the public you didn’t really fall onto that hoover attachment? And when intimate photos get splashed all over the internet, how do you switch the shame to dignity and joy? Sue delivers a hilarious treatise on stigma, humiliation, and misunderstanding.

shows.title: Abbie Edwards: Knee Touch
shows.description: It’s easy to romanticise a look your friend gives you, but does he really like you? It’s easy to catastrophise when he starts seeing someone else, but is it the end of the world? Leicester Square New Comedian of the Year Runner Up Abbie Edwards takes you through her first love and how she almost ruined everything. “Original and compelling” – Chortle “Considerable style” – Beyond The Joke Abbie Edwards is a BBC Introducing Radio 4 Comedy Award and BBC New Comedy nominee. Her stand up has been broadcast on BBC Radio 4 Extra and BBC Radio Solent.

shows.title: 7 Acts for £7.99
shows.description: Just the Tonic brings you 7 comedians each Friday night for a total bargain of a mixed bill show – two and a half hours for just £7.99. These shows will sell out, so book early! Line ups: 6/2 – Tez Ilyas, Tadiwa Mahlunge, Henry Michael, Gareth Mutch, Edd Hedges, Benny Shakes, Darrell Martin 13/2 – Alex Stringer, Ian Murphy, Joshua Bethania, Aidan Jones, Jacob Nussey, Jon Pearson, Eric Lampaert 20/2 – Darren Walsh, Nathan Cassidy, Darrell Martin, Guests, Cerys Bradley, Jon Pearson Please note, this show is incorrectly listed as £7 in our brochure.

shows.title: Knightmare Live
shows.description: “Enter… stranger!” The smash hit comedy show of the cult 90s TV dungeon adventure is back! With devilish new puzzles, terrifying new monsters and as always, a talking wall. Dare you face the perils of Knightmare? Sidestep left into adventure as dungeon master Treguard opens the doors once more for the award-winning, live action, fantasy gameshow where you finally might get the chance to wear the iconic Helmet of Justice and take on Lord Fear’s army of goblins, spinning blades and tricky word puzzles. ★★★★★ “Spellcasting A-W-E-S-O-M-E” INDEPENDENT ★★★★★ TIME OUT

shows.title: Laugh Academy Showcase (15-18)
shows.description: Join us for the culmination of Laugh Academy! A showcase of young talent as participants from the programme take to the stage and perform comedy, some of them, for the very first time. These 15-18-year-olds have been working all week with professional comedians to learn the tricks of the trade. Come and spot the stars of the future.

shows.title: Laughter Loft
shows.description: Best Small Venue Leicester Comedy Festival 2017, 2019, 2020 and 2022, 2024, 2025 returns with it’s incredible Laughter Loft shows. Every show has four of the best comedians from the UK Comedy Circuit (You’ll even have seen some of them on your TV) performing in the best pub in Leicester is a recipe for success and that’s why these shows sell out.

shows.title: Proper Funny Stand-Up Comedy at the Old Newts
shows.description: Join Proper Funny Comedy for a Stand-Up Showcase in the heart of Leicester Forest East at the Old Newtonians Rugby Club! Featuring 3 of the best acts on the UK Comedy Circuit, along with local MC Jay Neale (“One of the best MCs in the country”: Chuckl).

shows.title: 101 Naughty Jokes in 1 Hour
shows.description: Award-winning gag-merchant and three-time Joke of the Fringe winner, Masai Graham, delivers over 100 naughty jokes in an hour. Expect punchy puns, outstanding one-liners and wizardry wordplay in this 3.3 laughs-per-minute bonanza. ‘Annoyingly good’ (Gary Delaney). Featuring guest spots from some of the naughtiest comedians on the circuit.

shows.title: Badflix
shows.description: For fans of outsider art and snarky comments, a five-star comedy about a one-star movie. Join three award-winning comedians as we watch a terrible, terrible film (imdb rating 2.1) and make jokes all the way through it. With James Cook, Mary Flanigan and Phil Pagett.

shows.title: David Anthony: Treason (Work In Progress)
shows.description: Join David Anthony for a work in progress about tradition, culture and coming to terms with being English.

shows.title: Morgan Rees: What A Bummer (WIP)
shows.description: Following a sold-out 2024 tour, acclaimed stand-up and online sensation Morgan Rees is back with a brand-new show. After Morgan and his partner went on separate holidays – one to a Mathematics Forum in Coventry and the other to a Bear Party in Barcelona – a massive revelation forced Morgan to re-evaluate everything. Being banned from Great Western trains, being fired as a Naked Butler, and ghosting Paul McCartney… were they really his fault? Has that got you hooked? Good, because that’s the only stuff appropriate enough to include in the blurb.

shows.title: The Bricklayers Live Music Night
shows.description: Friday 20th Feb: Live Music at The Bricklayers with a comedy twist from Wedrock! They say laughter is the best medicine—but a night out with friends and great live music comes pretty close! As part of The Big Weekend, Wedrock return to The Bricklayers with their high-energy mix of indie, rock and pop covers. No punchlines, just great tunes, a packed pub and feel-good vibes all night long! 8:30 – 11 PM Free Entry

shows.title: Zoe explains it all
shows.description: Join Zoe the dog obsessed eccentric outsider with unusual social skills and a fresh take on life, as she explains… it all. An immersive comedy experience, one which will have you laughing to the point of being unattractive. Prepare yourselves. Winner Funny Women 2025. As seen on UKTV’s Moth Club Live “ one of those wonderfully esoteric comedians with natural funny bones. She had the room spellbound – and in gales of laughter. Zoe’s a fully-formed character” Chortle

shows.title: Ali Woods: Basher
shows.description: Join Ali Woods, viral comedy sensation and star of Comedy Central and Stand Up Sketch Show, after his last sell-out UK tour, for his brand-new stand-up comedy show. Online, Ali has gained hundreds of millions of views and likes for his relatable and satirical sketches. On stage, he’s supported comedy greats like Russell Kane, Axel Blake, and Adam Kay. With his unique blend of sharp wit and relatable humour, his performances are a must-see. Please note, this show is listed as Ali Woods: Live in our physical brochure.

shows.title: Eleanor Morton: The Mermaid (WIP)
shows.description: After her award winning hit show “Haunted House ” Eleanor Morton is back with a new work in progress about sex, mermaids and sexy mermaids. When Eleanor was 9, all she wanted to be was a mermaid. But why? And does it matter that she hates the sea? Join Eleanor to laugh about folklore, sex ed, and our fascination with mermaids and their allure to men over the centuries. Praise for Haunted House: “This hour is truly a masterful construction” **** Pepper & Salt “Belly laugh funny” The Metro **** ½ “This is an excellent show from an excellent, strong-minded comedian” **** The QR

shows.title: Jon Pearson: Happy (ish)
shows.description: Multi award winning comedian Jon Pearson has been looking for happiness, it would appear in all the wrong places. It’s a deep question, but can anyone ever be truly happy… Come and see how Jon has tried to find out.

shows.title: Laurence Tuck: An Idiot’s Guide to Murder
shows.description: Laurence Tuck is Dr Laurence Tench, respected academic and expert in murder. This show is an abridged version of Dr Tench’s international lecture tour, a step by step guide in how to murder someone and get away with it. This absurdist comedy will have you laughing until you die. Which may be sooner than you think. In ‘An idiot’s Guide to Murder’ you’ll find that true crime has never been truer! Directed by Kyle McKensie.

shows.title: Su Mi and Ciaran Chillingworth: WIP WIP LOL LMAO comedy WIP WIP LOL
shows.description: My name is Ciaran Chillingworth and I want you all to have a good time. I have bought a tombola drum, but we don’t have to use it. During my 30 minutes, I will do my best to look after you. ****½ ‘My New Favourite’ – Chortle. One of The Telegraph’s Best Shows at the Edinburgh Fringe 2025. WHAT DO YOU WANT FROM ME. ANOTHER SHOW. HOW DARE YOU. GO ON THEN. ‘One man in the front row had the best time of his life, falling to his knees in worship during the standing ovation (I do not jest) – One4review ★★★★ Midlothian View ★★★★★ – Broadway Work UK ★★★★★.

shows.title: Telling Tinder Tales
shows.description: Telling Tinder Tales is a no-filters, interactive comedy show where the audience’s real dating and relationship stories take centre stage. Brave volunteers share their worst, weirdest and wildest tales, and watch them turn into big laughs live on stage. This is not a podcast recording — it’s a one-night-only experience where what happens in the room stays in the room and we make sure no one leaves needing therapy who did not arrive needing therapy. Come with friends. Leave with secrets. Laugh a lot.

shows.title: Your Concerns Are Unfounded. Niteskreen Is Here, and We Have Never Been More Ready
shows.description: Be prepared.

shows.title: Richard Todd: Pencil Case (WIP)
shows.description: October 2025. Writing through a haze of flu symptoms, as the seasonal shift, from warm to ever so slightly chilly, once again catches his immune system off guard, giving it a good thrashing in the name of mortality, Richard, trapped beneath a duvet of ill-researched and tyrannical tog levels, wheezes out the blurb for an as yet unwritten show. “A comic with the ability to do surrealism, storytelling and exquisitely crafted wordplay all in the same few minutes.” The Scotsman ★★★★ ★★★★ Chortle, The Skinny, The Scotsman, List, Fest.

shows.title: Thank God It’s Friday!: The Late Show
shows.description: Finally the weekend is here! Come celebrate with a showcase of stellar comedy, handpicked by the team behind Leicester Comedy Festival. A different line-up every Friday to start the weekend with laughter. Acts include Frankie Monroe, Sam Nicoresti, Mary O’Connell, Lil Wenker, Alex Kealy, Joz Norris & more to be announced! Friday 6th: Sam Nicoresti, Mary O’Connell, Tom Towelling, Tadiwa Mahlunge, Phil Ellis Friday 13th: Rosco McClelland, Joz Norris, Lil Wenker, Hasan Al-Habib, Lara Ricote Friday 20th: Joe Kent-Walters, Hannah Platt, Zoe Brownstone, Mama G, Alex Kealy

shows.title: Sex! With Becky Fury
shows.description: An outrageously adult show by an award winning comic, writer, former dominatrix, sex therapist and walking human interest story! A sexy funny show on the subject of SEX! humans and our weird, wonderful (and often hilarious kinks) and sexual eccentricities **** Tremendously Talented (Off The Mic) ****Blew me away with her comic ingenuity (Lancaster Guardian) This is a work in progress based on a selection of humorous articles I’ve written on the subject and previously performed works. There maybe a Q&A. If there’s time and if you’re good girls, boys (or anything in betweens!) 😉

shows.title: Adele Cliff’s Topical Late Show with Adele Cliff
shows.description: Do you like American Late Night shows, but you aren’t American? This show is the solution! Award winning standup and topical writer (Breaking the News and The News Quiz), Adele Cliff brings you Leicester’s first live Late Night topical comedy extravaganza. Expect standup, guests, games and more. Adele is joined by incredible one-woman house band Katie Pritchard and long-suffering field reporter/dogsbody Will Davies. Praise for Adele: ***** “Master of comedy” Theatre Matters Katie: ***** “creative, unique and hilarious” The Phoenix Remix Will: **** “deeply funny” A Young-ish Perspective

shows.title: Technical Failure Of All Our Show Equipment Nothing Works AI Apocalypse Now This Is Comfort Blanket Now
shows.description: Let’s keep that energy going yeah. Leicester Comedy Festival Best Impro/Music show nominees 2019 & 2022. “A sort of Brechtian Ketamine Clown Orgy” Stuart Goldsmith **** Chortle **** The Scotsman

shows.title: Peter Fleming’s Dismally Ill-Prepared TV Pub Quiz
shows.description: The retired BBC children’s pioneer and festival award winner puts you through your paces with some fearsome rounds on beloved TV memories best forgotten. Which celebrity actually vandalised the Blue Peter Garden in 1983? How many times was Peter banned from the TV Centre canteen? Who was real, Tony Hart or Morph? Those are the first three questions, so get revising. Best Debut Show – Leicester Comedy Festival 2018. As seen and heard on BBC Two and BBC Radio 4. ★★★★ “A comic love letter to a lost world of Reithian values” Stewart Lee.

shows.title: Lord Rodney and Lord Russell: House of Twaddle
shows.description: Following a sell-out show at the festival in 2025, this award nominated duo bring their unique Georgian gameshow back to the Guildhall. If you don’t know the difference between Bum Fodder, Fartleberries and Trundlers then this fun-packed gameshow for all the family will entertain you and your little urchins for at least 45 minutes.

shows.title: Mr Sleepybum’s Dream Machine
shows.description: Winner: Best Kids Show – Leicester Comedy Festival 2025. Mr Sleepybum is sad. He can’t dream. To solve this problem, he invents a machine that magically brings dreams to life, featuring dinosaurs, robots, car chases, the world’s largest blanket, and much more! This award-winning interactive show is filled with sketches, slapstick, and silliness, ensuring maximum fun for the whole family. ‘Kids are left screeching with glee while their parents are grinning at this circus of sheer silliness.’ The List ★★★★ ‘Kids are riotously entertained’ Three Weeks ★★★★

shows.title: Spencer Jones Kids Show
shows.description: Spencer Jones has been making Comedy for overage kids for ages. The television stuff he has done includes; The mind of Herbert Clunkerdunk, Mr winner, Ted Lasso, upstart Crow etc. But recently he’s decided to take his weird silly musical prop visual humour to actual children. This will be all of his best stuff but without any swearing or rude bits. It’s an experiment and he’d like your children to be the guinea pig pigs!

shows.title: A Political Brunch
shows.description: A Political Brunch is a lighthearted take on politics in a gloomy world now in the 2025 LCF New venue winner. with audience involvement this is on the must see list for Kate Copstick at the Edinburgh Fringe. It is where Have I Got News for you meets Question Time

shows.title: Kate Cheka: The Last Funny Woman [WIP]
shows.description: Last year Kate attempted to save the world, now she thinks perhaps it is time to burn it all down. Everything is falling apart. What does it mean to be a woman (and a feminist) in the midst of an apocalypse? A work-in-progress from 2023 Funny Women and 2025 DIVA Queer Comedian of the Year award winner, as seen on The Guilty Feminist and BBC Radio 4’s The News Quiz and Matt Forde’s Focus Group. “Political comedy may yet have found its new messiah.” The Guardian

shows.title: Kate Hammer: Government Approved Comedian
shows.description: A Canadian who sold everything to move to the UK and do comedy is here to make you laugh, because she’ll be deported if you don’t. Join Kate as she recounts navigating the Severance-like visa process, getting dominated on Vinted, and discovering her sexuality through daytime science TV. As seen on Breaking the News, BBC Scotland, and Roast Battle League. ‘A full package, all tools comedian…It is impossible not to vibe with Hammer’ (British Comedy Guide) ‘Frenetic and clownishly graphic’ (Chortle) ‘Dynamic and charismatic’ (Broadway World) ‘Delightful’ (One4Review)

shows.title: Low Effort Sketches: We Have A Problem (WIP)
shows.description: Join multi award-winning sketch duo/astronauts Low Effort Sketches as they prepare for a dangerous space mission. On the launchpad, Andy starts feeling the pressure, leaving Alice to contend with a string of unlikely characters hell-bent on scuppering the mission. Will they ever make it to space? Winners of Leicester Square Theatre Sketch Off and Get Up, Stand Up. ‘Unfollowable. Hilarious.’ (Chortle) ‘A masterclass in sketch comedy’ ★★★★.5 (The Tab) ‘Beautifully crafted.’ ★★★★.5 (The Reviews Hub) ‘An hour of endless laughs’ ★★★★.5 (Varsity) ‘A great offbeat hidden gem’ ★★★★ (Lothian Life)

shows.title: Maria Telnikoff: WOMEN (wip)
shows.description: Women! Can’t live with them! A deep dive, social commentary on women. Who are they? And why? “Telnikoff radiates star quality” (Chortle). “A young Lucy McCormick” (The Skinny). Creator of hit show “All The Men Are Going To Hate Me” (Soho Theatre) is back with a new show that WILL pass the Bechamel test this time.

shows.title: Afternoon Jokes On Us
shows.description: Not sure who to see? Jokes On Us are proud to present an afternoon showcase of some of our favourite acts appearing at this year’s festival to help you make up your mind! Join compere Alex Hylton (Winner Best Show Leicester Comedy Festival 2020) as he hosts this daytime delight. You’ll see a range of acts performing short snippets of their shows to help you decide who to see. And it gets better… It’s Pay What You Want! The Jokes On Us!

shows.title: Comedy Club 4 Kids
shows.description: Like the name says it’s a Comedy Club 4 Kids! Cracking entertainment for everyone over six years old and under 400 years old (no vampires). We have the best comedians from the UK and world circuit doing what they do best… but without the rude bits! “A highlight for children… giving them a taste of some of the biggest names in comedy with the fun, rowdy feel of a real comedy club.” The Guardian “The perfect way to entertain the whole family.” Three Weeks “The ethos is just right.” The Daily Telegraph “This show was great!” The Scotsman

shows.title: Joke Spot @ Central Library
shows.description: Roll up! Roll up! Joke Spot makes you the star as we invite anyone under the age of 18 to take the mic and become a comedian. Our pop-up stage will be touring Leicester throughout the festival and it’s up to you to drop-in and tell us your best jokes. More venues may be announced throughout the festival, so keep an eye on our socials @kidscomedyfest or our website!

shows.title: Chomical Reactions: The Laughter Experiment
shows.description: Two hopeless Victorian scientists have finally perfected their Time Travelling Rocket Launcher. But when an error flings them through time & space they crash land their rocket in 2026. How will they ever get back? By joining forces with their wonderful new recruits! Through a series of challenges and experiments, they try to fix the time machine to return to the 1840s! A lightly educational character comedy show, packed with plenty of silliness, laughter and interaction. By two comedian/improvisers, and former members of Improvabunga, where ‘cosmic silliness lifted us from our seats’ (Metro)

shows.title: Daniel Petrie & Valeria Vulpe
shows.description: Scottish surrealist standup Daniel Petrie won 2023’s Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year Award as well as Finalist Chortle Student Comedy Awards and BBC New Comedy Award. 2025) Pleasance Reserve, Edinburgh Fringe; also a working NHS Doctor and a baked potato super-fan (2023-present). ‘Scarily good’ Daniel Sloss Moldova’s Valeria Vulpe left her career as a mathematician to follow her dream of being a standup. Deadpan storytelling with mordant humour and a unique viewpoint. She recently opened for Ricky Gervais at Wembley Arena as her prize for Winning the (2025) Dutch Barn Spirit of Comedy

shows.title: Sam Coade: 10,000 Chords (WIP)
shows.description: Sam Coade (BBC Radio 4, BBC Scotland) brings a work-in-progress version of his debut solo show to Leicester. Join him as he dives into the world of jazz, wedding bands, and what it means to be in the moment in this offbeat show. “Fantastic” – The Evening Standard “You v v funny” – Sam Campbell “One of the best acts I’ve seen recently” – Rich Wilson Pleasance Reserve nominee, winner Best New Act, runner up West End New Act.

shows.title: Ali Brice: This Is The Way We Brush Our Teeth
shows.description: I like smiling. But only when I’m unaware of it. If you know you’re smiling, you’re doing it wrong. Unless you’re looking at a camera. Or a dentist. I hope this show makes you smile without realising it. That would make me smile. That’d be nice. It’ll be chaotic, heartfelt and silly. Hopefully. See you there. Cheeeeeeeeeeeeese! **** ‘comic genius’ Skinny **** ‘Ali Brice is funny’ List **** ‘the most entertaining experience I enjoyed at the Fringe’ EdFringeReview **** ‘a show like no other’ Chortle **** ‘a clever, offbeat talent with an appealing penchant for taking risks’ Beyond The Joke

shows.title: Chrislexia Comedy: Half Term Hilarity
shows.description: Chrislexia Comedy: Half Term Hilarity is a lively, interactive family comedy show celebrating laughter, curiosity and difference. HAVEN’t you heard of Chrislexia Comedy? Before becoming a teacher, Chris worked as a holiday park presenter across the UK & Europe, entertaining families across the UK. Intentionally neurodiverse-friendly, this show is warm, low-pressure and inclusive — designed so kids can enjoy it in their own way while parents relax. A perfect post–half term family treat. One last thing before school starts again. Best suited to ages 4–11 (parents welcome). Pay What You Want.

shows.title: Em Humble: Lady Of The Lakes (WIP)
shows.description: BAFTA-longlisted voice actor and comedian, Em Humble, brings you her work-in-progress debut character comedy show. Good ‘morrow, weary traveller! Lay thine arse upon a plastic seat and bear willing witness to a mythical and fantastically surreal procession of Arthurian-inspired freaks! In a land of fantasy and a time of sorcery, who will emerge victorious and be deemed the worthy wielder of the legendary Excalibur sword?! As heard in the award-winning video game, Thank Goodness You’re Here!, and seen in her “Every Northern character in a musical” sketch.

shows.title: Jacob Nussey: Primed
shows.description: Jacob Nussey spills the secrets of Amazon life with his trademark sharp jokes and a deadpan delivery. Chortle’s ‘one to watch’ 2023 and winner of Bury Met Comedian of the Year, he dives into the absurdities and chaos of warehouse life, exploring preconceptions, job interviews, stealing, and why things could always be worse. “Hilariously Nonchalant… Impeccable Deadpan Delivery” – Broadway World ★★★★★ “Insanely funny, he’ll be a household name before you know it” – Skiddle “Brilliant and bloody hilarious” – On The Mic

shows.title: Jeddy Bear & Gary’s Pie Wars
shows.description: Episode V: The Jest Star Rises The galaxy is in peril as the evil Empire has unleashed its ultimate weapon – the Jest Star, a humour-sucking force threatening to destroy all laughter across the universe. But hope is not lost. Multi award nominated double act, Jeddy Bear and Gary return with their fifth epic mission. With wit as their weapon and silliness as their shield, they must train a new generation of Jeddy Knights to fight back. Join the rebellion. Restore the laughter… And may the pie be with you…

shows.title: Noteworthy The Made-Up Musical
shows.description: Noteworthy is a group of talented performers who devise a brand new, one-hour musical right in front of your eyes, inspired by audience suggestions! It’s silly, it’s very funny, and it’s… amazing how they’re doing this on the spot? Like, with harmonies and everything?! Whether you love or loathe musicals, there’s something for everyone as this charismatic bunch serve up crazy characters, silly storylines and inexplicably catchy tunes. Following their Leicester Comedy Festival and Edinburgh Fringe Festival debuts in 2025 Noteworthy return to Leicester Comedy Festival 2026.

shows.title: Rosie Holt: Work in Progress
shows.description: Rosie Holt is back with her alter ego MP and other characters to tackle the new political world under Labour. Everything is fine now, right? “Can Holt’s comedy career survive the advent of a Labour government? On this evidence, you’d fancy her chances.” – The Guardian. “The Thick of It levels of writing and performance applied to a very current flavour of political bullshit” – The Times “Tightly crafted and brutal political satire with Orwellian flourishes” – The Evening Standard. “Hilarious and alarmingly close to the bone.” – The New World.

shows.title: The Full Irish
shows.description: The Full Irish, which has been a sellout hit at the Edinburgh Fringe for 12 years is coming to LCF. Irish is a broad term but all the acts will have a “connection”.. which may be a stretch… mainly they will be funny

shows.title: Absolutely! One-Liner Jokes!
shows.description: A quick fire one-liner joke show that covers the important things in life in a light hearted way. Includes Best Joke of Edinburgh Festival Fringe 2025, Runner-Up. (Some Guy Called Dave). Kevin was in the cast of Best Show Edinburgh Festival Fringe 2025. (Phil Ellis’s, Soppy Scorn). Clever Jokes. (Mick Miller, comedian). Great set of gags and a likeable stage presence. (Masai Graham, comedian). A Wonderful Comedian with a vast array of brilliantly constructed, clever and hilarious one-liners. (Richard Gill: A Rich Comic Life).

shows.title: Bingo’s Adventure
shows.description: Bingo the clown is going on an adventure to find Bongo and Bango, and he needs your help kids and big kids! Full of funny stuff, interactive activities and jokes for all the family.

shows.title: Dan Kelly: How I Went to Every Supermarket in the World
shows.description: Could you find the price of a tyre in Liberia? How about the price of a sausage, in Norway? Dan has been a data collector for 10 years. You know when they say how much it costs to live somewhere? He’s the guy who has to find out. He goes round the world and walks around supermarkets recording the prices of apples/cheese/you name it into his Dictaphone. He’s been to almost every supermarket, in every country, in the world. This is the (entirely true) story of how. From the man who brought you How I Came Third in the North Korean Marathon.

shows.title: Chris Norton Walker : Only Here for the Award
shows.description: A brand new show with brand new jokes for 2026! Chris Norton Walker is one of the “most exhilarating and exciting one liner comedians working today” (JestAnother). This show is a culmination of hundreds of hours on stage in 2025 where Chris has been “setting every room on fire with delicious crowdwork and surgically crafted material” (BareBones Comedy) Will this show win an award. Thats what we’ll find out together!

shows.title: Chris Ford: Jehovah’s Witness for the Prosecution (WIP)
shows.description: Chris Ford, with his sharp wit and infectious charm, brings his debut WIP show Jehovah’s Witness for the Prosecution to Leicester Fringe 2026. In this forty-minute set, plus an opener from the London queer comedy circuit, Chris shares his journey from growing up as a strict Jehovah’s Witness to life on the frontline as an A&E nurse. Blending personal storytelling with big laughs, this is an honest, heartfelt and hilarious show from a promising queer comedian with a story worth telling.

shows.title: Connor Burns: Gallus
shows.description: Don’t miss the all-new show from Scotland’s hilarious global break-through stand-up star! GALLUS is Connor’s fourth solo hour. A prolific joke writer whose lightning fast, razor-sharp wit combines with his signature single malt Scottish-level cynicism to help create the perfect storm of brilliant jokes performed by a disarming comedy powerhouse and, now more recently, has seen Connor become a social media star. ‘Hilarious… he is fearless and it is wonderful… !’ ★★★★★ (Scotsman) ‘Burns has arrived… An authentic Scottish voice. And a gallus one at that’ ★★★★ (Entertainment Now)

shows.title: Instascam: Inside The Murky World Of Instagram Scammers
shows.description: Get ready for a side-splitting hour of laughs as comedian James Billington dives into the bizarre world of Instagram scammers! From fake kidnappings and dog threesomes to a £2m armed robbery theatre play, no scam is too strange. James also chats with real scammers and explores what Instagram is doing to fight the chaos (spoiler: not much). Based on his book of the same name, this show blends satire, silliness, and shocking true stories. Don’t miss it!

shows.title: Paul F Taylor: Cloudcuckoolander (WIP)
shows.description: Master of hilarity Paul F Taylor returns with a new show exploring his recent diagnosis of being “too hilarious”. Expect a joyous and imaginative hour packed with sharp one liners, delightful act outs and improvised nonsense. Then at the end he will get all serious about how difficult it is being this funny and you will all go home feeling deeply. As seen on Channel 4. “He was hilarious” ***** absolutely everyone

shows.title: The Supermalts
shows.description: Guzzle the vibes and grab a pint in the unique and ludicrous company of Carlos and Fred. Two humble hombres who will try everything in the pursuit of fun, where anything could happen and probably will. Expect a mega dram of clownprov, sketch and sweat. ‘Is this comedy? Summer 2056’ (Angel McMannon).

shows.title: A History Comedy Show
shows.description: Three comedians deliver stand-up sets on their favourite period and place in history and why, or do stand-up as their favourite character from history. So want to see stand-up comedy from Gandhi, Joan of Arc or Osama Bin Laden? Well now’s your chance!
