A great way to laugh, learn and discover which comics you want to see at the festival. ***** (Guardian). ‘Inspiringly Intelligent’ (Paul Sinha, The Chase).

shows.title: Amy Annette: Busy Body
shows.description: Best New Show at Leicester Comedy Festival nominee. BroadwayWorld ★★★★★ EdFringe Review ★★★★★ What happens when you mix a child who was called an “Old Soul” with a woman who has been called a “Fun Aunt”? You get Amy Annette. Who is Amy Annette? “Amy is one of my favourite comedians”- Aisling Bea. Busy Body was one of the Best Reviewed Shows of 2025 at the Fringe (according to British Comedy Guide). – “a delight to behold” ★★★★ Guardian. – “convivial company over an hour that whips by” ★★★★ Chortle. – “by the end of the show Annette feels like an old friend.” ★★★★ The List

shows.title: Andy Barr: A Comet Appears
shows.description: In 989 AD, Eilmer of Malmesbury saw Halley’s Comet in the night sky. In 1066 he saw it again as England fell. In 2026, 2025 Best New Show nominee, Andy Barr returns to Leicester with a new hour of material. Coincidence? I think not. “Get ready to meet your new favourite comedian.” John Kearns, “Highly enjoyable and incredibly funny” – ***** – A Young(ish) Perspective, “Andy Barr is the real deal.” – **** – The Skinny, “Andy Barr is proven. Bonafide as an untapped goldmine of bizarre potential just waiting for that wider audience to embrace him.” – British Comedy Guide, “Never dull” – Chortle

shows.title: Pravanya Pillay’s: Vaguely Bollywood Themed Work In Progress Show
shows.description: Pravanya is not 100% sure what this is yet, but it is vaguely Bollywood themed and she has big plans to eventually include a dance in the final show. But there won’t be one in this work in progress. This is not one of those times where someone says there’s no dance and then there’s a dance. She’s working on the dance – she hasn’t danced since she was 16 – so she has to rebuild a lot of those muscles before she throws herself into the choreography. Don’t come to this show expecting a dance. You’ll be disappointed. As seen on Rhod Gilbert’s Growing Pains Writer for BBC Radio 4

shows.title: Archit and Carwyn: Split Bill WIP
shows.description: Work in Progress: Two rising comic forces share the stage in one unforgettable night. Archit, a So You Think You’re Funny finalist 2024 turned Leicester Comedian of the Year 2024 contender, blends sharp storytelling and wry social insight. Carwyn, winner of Welsh Unsigned Stand Up 2024, So You Think You’re Funny finalist 2024, radio & TV writer-performer and recent tour support for Elis James, delivers charm with razor wit. Expect a night of pure Hilarity!

shows.title: Hannah Weetman: Something a bit Different
shows.description: Hannah Weetman, a self-proclaimed walking disaster, shares stories of failure and embarrassment. Listen to how she navigates (badly) her life in her late twenties. Buying a house, then going back to her parents’ spare room and sleeping on a deflating air bed. Observational gags ranging from relationships, families and crap Christmas presents. Things like taking a chance on a comedy festival because you don’t have to pay to get in! With (hopefully) relatable content! It’s sure to be something a bit different!

shows.title: Keep It Clean: Family Comedy Club
shows.description: Keep It Clean is a comedy club just like any other. The only difference? This one’s for everyone: so everything is a bit more silly and it’s all 100% clean material. Expect chaos, embarrassed dads, and truly laugh out loud moments for all the family! It’s a fresh lineup for every show starring some of the best acts on the circuit – keep an eye on our websites for lineups to be announced!

shows.title: Ryan Kenny: Some Words, in an Order, on a Stage
shows.description: Ryan Kenny brings alternative comedy to the festival, blending music, props, and sharp wit. Described as “must see” and “incredibly original,” his act stands unmatched. Awarded Circuit Breaker 2024 and New Comedian of the Year runner-up, Ryan promises a unique, intelligent, and hilarious experience. Don’t miss out!

shows.title: Chris Kehoe: Stand Up for Your Rights
shows.description: Speech, free to a good home. Barrister turned comedian Chris Kehoe turns his critical eye on human rights and with his trademark subversive wit and half arsed philosophical musings asks whose rights are they anyway? “So funny he almost turned me right wing” – Geoff Norcott “An important voice in the world of satirical comedy” – Manchester Wire

shows.title: Jay Neale: It’s The End Of The World As We Know It (And I Neale Fine)
shows.description: A BRAND NEW 1-Hour Show from Leicester’s very own, renowned for his quick wit, relatable storytelling, and commanding stage presence. If sharp anecdotes and out-for-belly-laughs storytelling sounds like your bag then this will be right up your street. “One of the best MCs in the country” Chuckl “Guy next door’ charm; if the guy next door happens to be absolutely hilarious!” Comedy Cow

shows.title: Nathan Cassidy: Weeee!
shows.description: Multi-award winning standup comic on how this year’s Ashes series changed his life. A story of love, loss and Travis Head’s moustache. ‘A master of the genre’ ★★★★ One4Review. ‘The best show at this year’s Fringe. Star in waiting. He is untouchable’ ★★★★ The Times. 13 Best Show wins/nominations in UK Comedy Festivals since 2019 including Leicester Comedy Festival for ‘Observational’ with which he completed a European tour in Autumn 2025. Star of 3 Amazon Prime specials, BBC Radio 5 Live, Times Radio and million downloaded podcast Daily Notes. Work in Progress. www.nathancassidy.com/weeee

shows.title: Steffan Alun: Stand Up
shows.description: Welsh optimist Steffan Alun finally presents his hilarious debut hour. As seen on BBC Wales, S4C, supporting Elis James on tour and performing slightly less than an hour of stand-up at the Fringe every year since 2015. Steffan returns to Edinburgh to work through his latest identity crisis with an hour of excellent comedy about sexuality, pop culture and, of course, all the best things about Wales. ★★★★1/2 “A fantastic insight into the human experience. Will lift the spirits of anyone in attendance” A Young(ish) Perspective “Best Jokes Of The Fringe 2025” – The Times & The Telegraph

shows.title: Alex Kealy: Work-in-progress
shows.description: The “sharply witty, almost sexily cerebral” (The Telegraph) stand-up and tour-support for Jack Dee brings a new hour of comedy to Leicester. As heard on BBC Radio 4’s The News Quiz and The Now Show. Co-host of the Gig Pigs podcast with Ivo Graham. “So technically clever that it’s almost beautiful…a career-defining show.” ★★★★★ Broadway Baby, “Breakneck pace with surprising turns in eloquent comic’s wonderful new hour” ★★★★ – The List, “A storming show from the whimsical funnyman” The Sunday Times, The Times’ Top Jokes of Edinburgh 2024

shows.title: Arthur Vinegar: Good Boy
shows.description: Imagine waking up, wearing only pants and a grubby vest, to find a room full of strangers staring at you. Suddenly thrust into the spotlight, the unsuspecting Arthur scrambles to create magic, joy and absurd worlds with the only thing he knows—the humble carrot—as his muse. All the while wondering, ‘Am I being a good boy?’ “It’s weird, wonderful and beautiful… A magical hour of incredible clowning and comedy.” ***** A Young(ish) Perspective “Laughter rolling, shrieks bouncing, and joy spilling over. What a gift.” ***** One4Review. Nominated: Best Newcomer (ISH) Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2025

shows.title: Emmanuel Sonubi: Life After Near Death
shows.description: Emmanuel Sonubi is back on tour after sold-out performances at the Edinburgh Fringe, and across Europe and New York. Emmanuel’s hilarious and heartfelt show explores his life after surviving heart failure, facing the cause of the trauma, and the strange and funny ways we all find to keep going when life gets hard. It’s about turning life’s toughest moments into comedy gold, finding the laughs in survival and the punchlines in perseverance. “Big laughs, engaging tales, you’re seduced by the easy authority of his storytelling” The Guardian

shows.title: Katie Norris: Work In Progress
shows.description: Fresh from a string of major comedy accolades, including Winner of the Musical Comedy Awards 2023, Leicester Comedy Festival Best Show 2025, Nominee for Best Show at the Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2025 and British Comedy Guide’s Next Big Thing 2025, Katie Norris brings a brand-new hour of something she genuinely hopes will be good.

shows.title: Mark Silcox: Gold Trader
shows.description: Dr Silcox will start gold trading with a £500 account, and will keep his audience entertained with his charming life stories as the trades progress through the show. This show is going to be the best show for people who are confused, have lost trust in their abilities, and want to be their own boss and financially independent. XAUUSD is the way forward.

shows.title: Rob Copland: Work In Progress
shows.description: Giddy up yee locals, Giddy up yee towns folk, Giddy up yee venue staff, giddy up yee me. Let’s get on with it and get through this as a whole. I’ll rant, I’ll rave, I’ll sit alone after and ponder, was I too much… A work in progress show from Edinburgh Comedy Award 2024, Chortle Comedy Award 2025, and Comedian’s Choice Award 2022 winner Rob Copland. “A virtuoso of silliness and a performer of fantastic energy” Chortle ★★★★★ “One of British comedy’s best kept secrets” The Guardian ★★★★ “Copland has real star power.” The Times ★★★★

shows.title: 10 years later Ron
shows.description: Mad Ron is celebrating 10 years in Comedy – expect the 30 minute club set, some new stuff and maybe some questions and answers. Mad Ron (Leicester Comedy Festival “Best Show” nominee 2023) is a multi award winning comedian and a regular in comedy clubs all over the country, appearing at Downstairs at the Kings Head, Backyard, Chuckl, Manfords, Funhouse Comedy among others – “keeps the onslaught of jokes coming,……. (Steve Bennett – Chortle)

shows.title: Improv Wolves
shows.description: The fearless Improv Wolves create completely new comedy characters, scenes and stories on the spot from audience suggestions. Every show is different! We might see a film noir detective pastiche, hear surprising confessions from some of the most famous names in history or have the dubious honour of being present for the debut of a brand-new improvised song. Improv Wolves have appeared at venues around the UK including Bath Fringe Festival, Birmingham Comedy Festival, Edinburgh Fringe Festival, Leicester Comedy Festival, Beardy Folk Festival and Guildford Fringe Festival.

shows.title: Kevin Hudson Talks the Walk
shows.description: ‘A truly gifted storyteller with natural wit and charm’ (Proper Funny) ‘Belting punchlines’ (Jokes On Us) Kevin’s house hadn’t been repossessed, he hadn’t committed any major financial fraud, he just fancied a walk. He’d heard of the Offa’s Dyke Path and decided to walk it. Then he discovered it was a blimmin’ long way, from the bottom of Wales (Chepstow) to the top (Prestatyn). Averaging 15 miles a day, Kevin set two personal records on Offa’s Dyke: the furthest he’d ever walked, and the most consecutive full English breakfasts ever eaten. This is the story of that walk. And those breakfasts.

shows.title: Vix Leyton: Chief Petty Officer (work in progress)
shows.description: Pettiness. We’re told it’s a character flaw – small-minded, time-wasting, beneath us. But what if that little spark of spite is actually a superpower? In Chief Petty Officer, Vix Leyton (Spendology, The Comedy Arcade) puts pettiness on trial. Across an hour of stand-up storytelling, she unpicks history’s pettiest moments – from empires collapsing over missing chairs, to the British literally building a giant hedge to stop people smuggling salt – and asks whether they were truly ridiculous, or secretly revolutionary.

shows.title: Mike Keenan : Impossible Dream
shows.description: Nominated for Best Debut Show in 2025. From festival fan to festival favourite. Mike spent 30 years in the audience before finally getting over his misgivings and grabbing the mic. Eight years later, he’s a regular on the UK circuit and at last year’s festival, his first ever hour-long performance was nominated for Best Debut. Now this ‘quarter-professional’ comedian delivers the completed show, a laugh-out-loud mix of heart and humour, as he tackles midlife crises, second chances and pursuing your dreams. A must-see for anyone who’s ever wondered if it’s too late to follow theirs.

shows.title: Candace Bryan: Don’t Be Ridiculous, Everybody Wants This (Work in Progress)
shows.description: “Sharp wit and expertly crafted stand-up…an extraordinary talent” (Edinburgh Reviews) “A gag count other comics should envy” (Chortle). The apocalypse is nigh—let’s go to the mall! Comedian and high-functioning shopaholic Candace Bryan is working on a new show about her bad buying habits and the hyper-consumerist society that enables her. In this joke-packed hour, she explains why microplastics are chic, talks about the time she bombed a job interview at Vogue Magazine, and proves that shopping is more intellectual than reading book.

shows.title: Freya McGhee: Work in Progress
shows.description: Freya is using science to try and make her life more successful. Although she only got a 2:2 from the University of Brighton, so perhaps she shouldn’t back herself on that ability. With over 45K followers online and millions of views, her science jokes are quickly becoming a cult favourite.

shows.title: Richard Wrighting his last will and testament
shows.description: Richard Wright is in his 40’s and he hasn’t made a will. Who gets his stuff? Who would even want it? And can he leave someone his 4 star reviews? The 7 time competition semi finalist returns to the Leicester Comedy Festival to Wright his last will and testament.

shows.title: James Ellis: Craig (Work in Progress)
shows.description: EXTRA DATE ADDED! Join award-winning comedian James Ellis as he tests material for his debut hour—an hour he originally thought would tackle big ideas, but which somehow ended up being about some bloke called Craig. South Coast Comedian of the Year, BBC New Comedy Award regional finalist, Leicester Comedian of the Year nominee, and tour support for Angela Barnes, Zoe Lyons & Jason Manford. ‘A talented comedy craftsman’ – Chortle.

shows.title: Ellen Turnill Montoya: Mr Handsome
shows.description: Meet Mr Handsome, a giant hand. Playful props and physical buffoonery set in an illustrated world. When you think of hand models one name has defined the game – Mr Handsome. But beyond the glamour, awards, and cuticle lifts there is …a yearning. Can he hold on to success? Can he stay relevant in a world of feet-pics? Can he recover his missing Left Hand? Take his hand and find out… ★★★★★ Reviews Hub ★★★★½ “Brilliantly bonkers comedy that takes silliness seriously” To Do List A Weirdos Comedy Production. Directed by Adam Larter (Chortle Awards winner). Produced by Charlie Miller.

shows.title: Alex Kitson: Now Look Here [WIP]
shows.description: Multi-award winning comedian Alex Kitson presents a brand new hour of stand-up about attention. If you could direct yours his way temporarily he’d be very grateful. Tour support for Fin Taylor, Tom Ward, and Vittorio Angelone. “A natural comic… The energy is almost Robin Williams level.” Chortle. “Incredible… so clever.” BBC Radio “Expertly constructed punchlines… insanely original.” European Comedy Review

shows.title: Hannah Platt: Work In Progress
shows.description: A work in progress of a new show from ‘voice of a new generation’ (Skinny) and wannabe cult figure/leader Hannah Platt. ‘Humour sharp enough to draw blood’ – The Guardian ‘Platt is in the form of her life’ – Rolling Stone Magazine ‘A supremely accomplished example of how to reconstitute deep, personal trauma into punchy and effective standup’ The Scotsman As seen on Comedy Central Live, BBC 3 and tour support for Fern Brady, Harriet Kemsley and Fin Taylor.

shows.title: James Acaster: Cinemagoers Welcome – Advance Screening
shows.description: Comedian James Acaster unleashes his infectious energy as he explores his love/hate relationship with stand-up – while welcoming a heckle or two. Filmed in Truro, Dublin and Northampton, we see how this experiment panned out in front of three very different audiences. This is a special advance screening for Leicester Comedy Festival before the general release on March 6th. 16+ (certification TBC)

shows.title: Just the Tonic’s Saturday Night Special with Ed Byrne
shows.description: Ed Byrne headlines this special Saturday night comedy gig. A rare chance to see this stand up legend in a small venue. “It is rare for a comic to merit the word “masterful” but in this case it is no overstatement” **** The Scotsman. An extended set from Ed Byrne plus support from Ben Silver. Compere TBC. For updates check www.justthetonic.com

shows.title: Ruby Carr: Bite Me
shows.description: New silly stand up show from “enchanting human shaped hurricane”, Ruby Carr. Ruby has been promised a Hollywood smile from her dentist in 32 weeks. In other news, Ruby only has 12 weeks to fix her OCD on the NHS. Working on her teeth and her brain all means one thing, there’s a lot going on in her head. Nominated for the Neurodiverse Review ADHD Comedy Award 2024 Winner of Funny Women Comedy Writing Award 2022 Previous reviews: “Fizzy with energy and so funny off the cuff” – Chortle “An enchanting human shaped hurricane spreading (eBay) joy and utter chaos” – Edinburgh Reviews, 5 stars

shows.title: Saaniya Abbas: Hellarious
shows.description: Saaniya Abbas takes audiences on her most personal and side-splitting journey yet. After a hugely successful and critically acclaimed Edinburgh Fringe debut, she’s now bringing Hellarious across the country on her first UK tour. ★★★★ “Brilliantly sharp and punchy” – The Skinny ★★★★ – Fest ★★★★ – Broadway Baby ★★★★ – The Comics Comic

shows.title: Sian Davies: Watch Me (WIP)
shows.description: A new work in progress show for the end of days from award winning, working class, queer comedian, Sian Davies. It might be about the future, or the past. Or even the present hell we inhabit. Fresh ideas, fragments, thoughts and jokes on topics as yet unknown. As seen on Comedy Central Live and Next Up. Nominated for Next Up Biggest Prize in Comedy at Edinburgh Fringe 2023. Winner of Edinburgh Comedy Awards Panel Prize 2022 for Best in Class. Winner Best Debut Show Leicester Comedy Festival 2020. Runner up Funny Women Stage Award 2019.

shows.title: 101 Rules for a Better World (by Comedians)
shows.description: Comedians put the world to rights – because somebody has to – in this new panel show. Host Leslie Gold (as seen at the Comedy Store) and three of the finest guest comics present ideas to improve the world at large. Whether their rules are adopted is down to an audience vote. Imagine the opposite of Room 101. It’s daft… but is it just daft enough to work? As seen at Edinburgh Fringe, and soon to be a hit podcast. “Seasoned mischief-makers ensure that even the most hare-brained rule gets a fair (and funny) trial.” – **** One4Review

shows.title: Eric Rushton: Innkeeper
shows.description: In 2004, Eric Rushton was cast in his primary school Nativity. Despite absolutely smashing it, he immediately retired from being a child actor. Now he’s found the correct antidepressants to give showbusiness another go. WINNER Channel 4 Sean Lock Comedy Award. WINNER Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year. “No wonder it sold out. A thinking man’s comedian with a gift for subverting standard tropes hilariously” ★★★★⯪ One4Review ★★★★ The Arts Desk ★★★★ EdFestMag ★★★★ The List ★★★★ Beyond The Joke ★★★★ Fest

shows.title: Howes Percival Leicester Comedian of the Year Competition 2026
shows.description: Our flagship competition is back! The stellar list of past winners include Josh Widdicombe, Johnny Vegas, Jason Manford, Seann Walsh and Rhod Gilbert. Join us as we present this year’s finest up and coming acts, nominated by top comedy promoters from across the UK. A serious comedy competition, headlined by 2025 winner Louise Atkinson, and hosted by Live at the Apollo & QI comedian Emmanuel Sonubi. Book fast to avoid disappointment. Participating in 2026 are: Oliver Moore Ciara O’Connor Jack Kelly Oro Rose Sydney May Valeria Vulpe Chloe Reynolds Sapphire McIntosh

shows.title: Red Light Comedy
shows.description: Since 2012, Red Light Comedy has transformed Leicester’s Town Hall Bike Park into a pop-up comedy club like no other. Enjoy three special mixed-bill charity fundraisers featuring some of the finest stand-up talent from across the festival. Quirky, underground and uniquely Leicester, these nights blend the city’s cycling culture with top-class comedy- all in aid of Action Homeless Leicester.

shows.title: Shaparak Khorsandi
shows.description: Shaparak Khorsandi established herself as one of the UK’s finest comedians with her sell-out Edinburgh show, Asylum Speaker. Despite the basis for the show being her experiences as a child refugee fleeing Iran, Shaparak’s sensitive yet witty exploration of these events creates an instant comedy hit. Shaparak will be supported by Esther Manito who won the Best Show Award at the 2021 Leicester Comedy Festival. Doors open an hour before the show starts. There will be a bar to purchase refreshments and toilets are available on site. Seats are unallocated and first come first serve in the band.

shows.title: Ask Granny- adults (Ishi’s Gran)
shows.description: Granny’s here—spilling wisdom, mischief, fruity life hacks… and maybe even a rogue cucumber! Ask Granny is the laugh-out-loud, improvised comedy chat show you didn’t know you needed. NaanE Swami—the sharp-witted, fruit-flinging, advice-giving granny—trades audience woes for wildly unfiltered life hacks, belly laughs & chaos. Fresh from a Leicester Comedy Festival sell-out, BBC feature & NRTF shortlist. Created by multi-award-nominated, internationally acclaimed Ishi2funny. “A tower of mischievous fun!” – Nottingham Post. One rule: don’t tell Ishi her Granny’s on the mic!

shows.title: Chris McCausland: Yonks!
shows.description: You might have seen him on Strictly Come Dancing, Would I Lie to You, Have I Got News for You, The Royal Variety, QI, Blankety Blank, The Last Leg, and tons more as well. He’s been called an “overnight success” – even though he’s been doing this for bloody yonks! Chris McCausland is hitting the road again with another masterclass in stand-up comedy that has literally been yonks in the making. The last tour was a sell-out, so get your tickets now!

shows.title: Lucy Pearman: Lunartic
shows.description: The Moon is putting on a show. But, as the Sun keeps reminding her, the Moon will never be a star – and without him, she’d be invisible altogether. Through her trademark blend of surreal character comedy, joyful audience participation and prop-fuelled silliness, Lucy Pearman takes us into a huge-hearted story about loneliness, big dreams, and wanting to be seen. As the Sun threatens to switch off the light altogether with a total eclipse, the Moon faces the dark – and the audience is invited to join her in a wonderfully daft celestial adventure.

shows.title: Midlands Mashup: Ravi Saini & John Hassan – WIP
shows.description: East Midlands meets West Midlands as Nottingham-based Ravi Saini & Birmingham-based John Hassan bring you their first split bill show. Expect these two rising stars of the comedy circuit to deliver well crafted jokes and clever wordplay; with a few puns and one liners thrown in for good measure.

shows.title: Roar with Laughter at The Rose and Crown, Thurnby
shows.description: Get ready to Roar with laughter as three side splitting comedians and a compere descend into the Rose & Crown, Thurnby for a mixed bill of comedy and uncontrollable laughter!

shows.title: Slater Street Comedy Club
shows.description: Join us for the launch night of Slater Street Comedy Club as Leicester Indoor Bowls Club transforms into a top-tier comedy club with a TRIPLE HEADLINE SHOW featuring ARTHUR SMITH (Star of Grumpy Old Men, QI, Have I Got News For You, Red Dwarf and many more) PHIL NICHOL (Perrier Award Winner) and KEITH FARNAN (As seen on Michael McIntyre’s Comedy Roadshow). Hosted by ALEX HYLTON (Leicester Comedy Festival ‘Best Show’ Winner)

shows.title: The Comedy Store – O2 Academy Leicester
shows.description: With nearly 40 years’ experience in the business and as the premier name in comedy, The Comedy Store is renowned as a breeding ground for new comedy talent and remains the place to see tomorrow’s stars today. The likes of Eddie Izzard, John Bishop, Jimmy Carr, Rhod Gilbert and Sarah Millican, have all cut their comedy teeth with us. The Comedy Store brings you “the best in stand up” from around the globe, showcasing the brightest names in comedy today. Simply the funniest show you’ll see all year! Line up: Michael Akadiri Lindsey Santoro Peter Brush Daisy Earl

shows.title: Thomas B. Wild Esq. & The Fancy Chaps – Live Band musical comedy
shows.description: Thomas Benjamin Wild Esq. has been delivering his own brand of singalong musical humour since 2016. His sweary anthem ‘I’ve No More F***s To Give’ has been viewed 16 million+ times on YouTube, sending his debut album ‘Awkward Encounters While Walking My Dog’ to no 3 in Billboard Comedy Album Chart His band The Fancy Chaps add to the mirth. Thomas takes inspiration from the wit & wisdom of early-mid C20th songwriters & combines them with punk rock sensibilities to create pithy songs full of catchy tunes, satire & social & political commentary Support act Chris Tavener 16+ (under 17s with adult)

shows.title: Cabaret of Filth
shows.description: Come inside the Cabaret of Filth and indulge in a night of pure debauchery, burlesque and drag in this comedy riot! Will contain nudity, adult content, anti-establishment rebellion and all the good swear words. Come and join in the revelry. ‘Hysterically funny’ **** (TheRealChrisparkle.com).

shows.title: Cock-Kane The Clown and his Many Games
shows.description: Clowns have an unfair bad rep, thanks to the likes of John Wayne Gacy, Pennywise and Myself. If you haven’t experienced any of this output before, you are in for a serious treat. A couple of years back, someone proudly walked away with the Sam Smith Balloon Sculpture standing in at 18″ People regularly battle and beg over taking home special balloon models. So – expect balloons – and no – this isn’t for kids. There will be Clown songs, Clown magic, Clown Games as well. Embrace your Coulrophobia “One of my favourites from last year!” – The actual James from James Bistro

shows.title: Johnny White Really-Really: Work In Progress
shows.description: Johnny White Really-Really is back from the murky depths just in time to do something new and as yet unknown!

shows.title: Proper Funny Comedy’s Saturday Showcase
shows.description: There’s no better way to spend the final Saturday of the Festival than seeing some of the very best Acts on the UK Comedy Circuit at Proper Funny Comedy’s Saturday Showcase! Once again, they’re teaming up with TripleCeePee and Firebug to bring another belting Show to the Leicester Comedy Festival, all seamlessly held together by Leicester’s own Jay Neale (MC) Book Early!!!

shows.title: Spencer Jones: Work in progress
shows.description: Spencer Jones is doing a work in progress show. Should be good. Fingers crossed. Why not come and have a look at it. There will be some stupid songs. There will be some characters. There will be some stories. He’s had a couple of years off, and now really fancies it again.

shows.title: Zoe Brownstone: Wink In Progress
shows.description: With sharp observations, surreal detours, and a dash of personal chaos, Zoe Brownstone spins a career history that’s less “LinkedIn ready” and more “what on earth is she doing?” Part job interview, part confessional, part stoner comedy without the haze, this is a story about work, identity, and finding humour in the bizarre ways we make a living.

shows.title: Michael Shafar: Inappropriate
shows.description: BEST SHOW NOMINEE – LEICESTER COMEDY FESTIVAL 2025 Since moving to London from Australia, Michael Shafar has quickly become one of the most exciting new acts on the UK comedy circuit. In this unfiltered and unapologetic hour, Michael will weigh into the topics that most comedians are smart enough to avoid. “Shafar has a disarmingly relaxed approach and an intelligent sense of humour with a wildly inventive, darkly comic imagination.” ★★★★★ The Edinburgh Reporter “Shafar circumnavigates the line between edgy and offensive with beautiful finesse.” ★★★★½ The Age

shows.title: Comedy Arcade Live
shows.description: The Comedy Arcade: competitive anecdotes game returning for its fourth year. Vix Leyton holds a bingo ball of surprise subjects and invites four brilliant comedians to spar with never-before-told stories, from the hilarious to the scandalous, to win points awarded by host and audience. ‘Lives up to its billing likening it to a fabulous dinner party. Punters feel they are among spontaneously funny friends rather than hearing well-rehearsed professional anecdotes. We know these stories – and this particular alchemy will not be repeated again’ **** (Steve Bennett, Chortle.co.uk).

shows.title: Rich Spalding: Not My Story to Tell – WIP
shows.description: In 2024 lots of stuff happened in my life. Just not directly to me. But I was there for it all. So now I’m trying to work out how much of it I’m allowed to talk about, and, crucially, how to make it funny. Come be part of that process, if you fancy. Rich Spalding is an award-winning comedian, following up his 2024 debut ‘Gather Your Skeletons’. “Razor sharp, understated brilliance’ – Tom Ward “An original and offbeat commentator on everything” – Steve Bennet, Chortle

shows.title: Adam Larter: Who Remembers the 90s?
shows.description: Not a lot has been written about the decade ‘the nineties’ and so Adam Larter will FINALLY try to get to the bottom of what happened in this decade. Decade. Expect well researched journalism and not a lot of surreal nonsense. ‘Looking more like Andy Kaufman than ever.’ Chortle

shows.title: MAYA RICOTE: Ay Am! (WIP)
shows.description: Maya Ricote is a Mexican telenovela actress turned professionally idiot. Taking clown courses all over the world. Philippe Gaulier’s school included. She’s been frozen alive for a long and nonspecific time. Why? She needs answers and she WON’T stop til she gets them. Come watch Maya Ricote unfreeze. There will be dancing. There will be singing. There will be tears. And more. In this, work-in-progress show, Maya Ricote brings her hilarious and unique sense of humour to her telenovela background to create a wild hour of clowning. CO-Created AND DIRECTED BY DAN LEES

shows.title: Wrestling with the Champ: FistyMania!
shows.description: The hilarious wrestling-themed gameshow where only egos get hurt! Watch the Pub Wrestling Federation champion the Ginger Ninja battle a guest comedian for the FistyMania title. Grab a pint, pick a side and may the best team win. Featured by LADbible, Daily Mail, BBC Radio 5 Live and CNN after competing in the World Gravy Wrestling Championships. Top Ten Shows About Sport (Chortle.co.uk). WINNER: Best Sports Podcast, Independent Podcast Awards.

shows.title: Dirty Stop Out
shows.description: Late night, unpredictable comedy. Host Darrell Martin is let loose after 10.30pm with other acts from around the festival, join us if you like your Live comedy a bit unplanned Look out online at Justthetonic.com for act announcements.

shows.title: Nate Kitch: Something Different!!!!!
shows.description: Kitch is back with his absurd, alternative quad-award-nominated sold out Edinburgh Fringe show. “It’s sort of about Charlatans, voices & a Rasputin book that as it stand I haven’t read; there’s big laughs, lulls, shouting & faffing. Oh & I’ve got a hat.” “Comedy Masterclass..like a Matisse painting or jazz.” ***** The Scotsman “a love letter to comedy.. breaking the form and building laughs that come from out of nowhere” ***** Entertainment Now “Postmodern yet oldschool..this could be as fringey as it gets” **** The List “absurdist & not funny..I wasn’t very impressed.” arrse.co.uk

shows.title: Cerys Bradley on Road Signs (WIP)
shows.description: STOP. Cerys Bradley (Actually Autistic Excellence Award 2022, as seen on Comedy Central, UKTV, BBC One Wales) has hyperfixated on road signs. Road signs are very pretty and they make Cerys’ brain go brrrrrrrrp. If you like road signs, follow the directions below for a silly and short history of road sign design as well as some heartfelt musings on the monotony of everyday life and the joys of autistic obsessions. GO. Outstanding Neurodiverse Performance Award Nominee 2025 ★★★★★ “Hilarious, absurd and utterly joyful” The Neurodiverse Review ★★★★★ “I really loved this show” – On The Mic

shows.title: Emmeline Downie: Work In Progress
shows.description: A brand new work in progress from comedian Emmeline Downie. Emmeline brings her provincial, playful, and unpredictable style to the stage in Channel 40, a character comedy show about the very last broadcast of Milton Keynes’ grassroots cable TV channel in 1979. Best known on the alternative circuit for her creation Gail Summerfield, Emmeline has collaborated with Taskmaster’s Ania Magliano, Leo Reich, and Bella Hull, and written for BBC Studios.

shows.title: Crafternoon with Carol
shows.description: Crafternoon with Carol’s Comedy & Craft Extravaganza! Self-acclaimed Craftaholic, Carol, has been influencing the creative minds of multiple people for weeks & now she’s teaming up with the Cosby Yarn Bombers to help raise funds for their summer Yarn Bomb. Doors open 1pm for Bargain Yarn & Crafts Sale Seating & refreshments from 2pm Show starts 2.45pm 3.45pm Crap Craft Competition & Raffle – bring along your worst craft fails & terrible homemade gifts & win a (not so crap) prize! A Fundraiser for Cosby Yarn Bomb 2026 See @cosbyyarnbomb on FB for more details

shows.title: Joke Spot @ Belgrave Library
shows.description: Roll up! Roll up! Joke Spot makes you the star as we invite anyone under the age of 18 to take the mic and become a comedian. Our pop-up stage will be touring Leicester throughout the festival and it’s up to you to drop-in and tell us your best jokes. More venues may be announced throughout the festival, so keep an eye on our socials @kidscomedyfest or our website!

shows.title: Michael Brunström: William Tell versus the Algorithm
shows.description: Swiss folklore meets Artificial Intelligence in this surreal take on the William Tell legend. Meet a reluctant freedom-fighter who accidentally challenges the systems that threaten to divide and oppress us. Michael Brunström is a surrealist comedian, whose numerous shows include ‘Parsley’, ‘The Great Fire of London’, ‘One Thousand New Ideas before Bedtime’ and ‘Copernicus Now’, which was nominated for the Best Show award at the 2024 Leicester Comedy Festival. Malcolm Hardee Award Winner. ★★★★ ‘A joy’ (Scotsman). ★★★★ ‘An artistic genius’ (Skinny). ‘Hilariously silly’ (Chortle).

shows.title: 2 Comedians Telling Jokes
shows.description: It’s pretty simple. Two of London’s top up-and-coming comedians share some of their funniest gags. Vinny Shiu (Portsmouth Comedian of the Year 2023) and Callum Mackenzie (Chucklemania Comedy Contest, silver medalist) cover everything from hobnobs to heartbreak, eggplants to existential dread in an hour guaranteed to make your list of fringe highlights.

shows.title: Big Value Comedy Showcase
shows.description: A legendary Fringe favourite since 1995, Big Value has launched the careers of comedy greats from Milton Jones and Sarah Millican to Romesh Ranganathan and Jason Manford. Now it brings its 2026 lineup of rising stars to Leicester – and this is your chance to catch the next big names in stand-up before they hit the big time. This is the 2026 lineups first time all performing together under the Big Value title after winning our regional auditions.

shows.title: Den of Fools: The funny punny panel show where improv meets standup
shows.description: Punny, funny, and full of improv! Join Den & his Fools for ridiculous comedy games and jokes galore. Den is seeking 21st century jesters to entertain the royal court. Fools play improv games, generate jokes on random topics, tell tall tales and silly stories, and participate in a pun off. Popular rounds include: Jester Minute, I Didn’t Expect That, Guess the Guest, News at Den, and The Good, The Bad and The Ugly Advice. Hosted by Denzil de Cristo “Very funny, and a brilliant set up” BBC Radio Derby “A lot of fun” Tony Cowards As seen at Edinburgh Fringe & Nottingham Comedy Festival

shows.title: Erika Ehler: Work In Progress
shows.description: Emmy-nominated Canadian comedian and writer Erika Ehler is bringing you a new work-in-progress hour, showcasing her dark, incisive comedy and sharp delivery. Erika has appeared on Frankie Boyle’s New World Order, Comedians Giving Lectures, and Comedy Central Live. Erika is a Chortle Student Comedy Award winner, and has written for Have I Got News for You, Roast Battle, Never Mind the Buzzcocks, and Netflix, establishing her as one of the UK’s most distinctive comedy voices.

shows.title: Nick Kirk: Absolute Nickhead
shows.description: Nick Kirk (West End New Act Finalist 2023) just wants to put on a silly character show. His own inner monologue has other ideas. Who will win? Will it make any sense? Does that even matter? These questions and fewer might be answered in Absolute Nickhead… “[Safety officer Dave Steed is] an amusing tragi-comic conceit and expertly performed with fine timing” – Chortle

shows.title: Caitriona Dowden: Sesh Head (WIP)
shows.description: Combining award-winning stand-up comedy with reasonably good harp playing, Caitriona invites you into the world of traditional Irish folk music. Join her on a journey through time, from medieval banquets to 21st-century pub sessions. Along the way, expect stories of mythological harpists, family history, and run-ins with Morris Dancers. Chortle Awards Best Newcomer nominee 2025. Chortle Student Comedy Awards winner 2022. ‘Blissfully esoteric… a special talent’ – Fest. ‘irresistibly idiosyncratic’ – Wee Review. ‘a unique voice in UK comedy’ – The Scotsman

shows.title: 5 acts for £5
shows.description: 5 acts for £5 comes to Peter’s Pizzeria, the perfect afternoon show. See 5 acts under one roof for just £5. Line Ups: 8/2 – Pauline Eyre, Alex Stringer, David Eagle, Guests, Louise Leigh 15/2 – Ben Treloar, Joshua Bethania, Edd Hedges, Dom McGovern, Kevin Daniel 22/2 – Guests, Nathan Cassidy, Madeleine Brettingham, Jack Kelly

shows.title: An Interview With Fatiha El-Ghorri
shows.description: Underneath Fatiha’s colourful hijab is a mind full of cutting observations and engaging witticism of the life and times of a British Muslim woman. Fatiha smashes the Muslim stereotypes and challenges people to think about what they think they know about Islam, Muslims, Muslim women especially. She tackles some tough subjects like Islamophobia and dating by sharing her own experiences which are funny, thought provoking and honest! In aid of Big Difference Company

shows.title: Enrico Touché: Hot Knees – It’s Just Business
shows.description: Enrico Touché is coming to Leicester with some serious business chocolate. Expect briefcases, suitcases and cases of uncontrollable laughter. From sold-out cabarets across Europe, Enrico Touché brings their unique brand of comedy in an hour of unbelievable business. “Enrico Touché exemplifies why classic slapstick still #slaps.” Fringe Biscuit Magazine “…neatly executed physical comedy, with their performances in each scene completely on the money.” The List. “…the shtick is absolutely delightful…” Kate Copstick, The Scotsman Enrico Touché – you will be touched.

shows.title: Graeme Rayner: KrowdWerk
shows.description: “KrowdWerk” is exactly what you might think – an unscripted crowdwork show. Comedian Graeme Rayner will be relying on the audience to get involved and help make a unique show. “One of the most accomplished MCs I’ve ever seen. In total command of the audience.” – Joe Pasquale “Heckle him if you dare. You’ll be smashed to pieces if you try” – On Yorkshire Magazine “One of the best MCs around” – Leeds Laughter Lounge “How he isn’t a regular at every big club in the country is unfathomable.” – Barnsley Comedy Shop “The laughs come thick and fast.” – Lancashire Post

shows.title: Anna Leong Brophy: Work In Progress
shows.description: Anna’s great-grandmother was a healer. Anna needs healing. Can a great-granddaughter get some help here? Anna Leong Brophy (How to Train Your Dragon, Shadow & Bone, half of sketch duo EGG) delves into hope, healing and what’s actually going ON on the inside with a cheeky blend of comedy and clownery, sharing stuff she probs shouldn’t with a room full of strangers but what the heck. PRAISE FOR EGG: “Great physical comedy chops… just perfect” ★★★★ Chortle “An absolute blast” ★★★★ Fest “Superior Fare” ★★★★ The List “Supremely confident” ★★★★ The Skinny “infectiously fun” ★★★★ Three Weeks

shows.title: Harriet Richardson: Creep (WIP)
shows.description: A rare opportunity to see self-proclaimed ‘online performance artist’, Harriet Richardson as she develops her debut live show. Trying out new material for her upcoming solo show, Harriet blends diaristic writing, comedy, and performance art- turning intimacy, obsession, and self-exposure into something disarmingly funny and strangely relatable. Her work has been featured in The Guardian, The New York Times, Artnet, Dazed, LadBible, METRO, De Volkskrant and It’s Nice That.

shows.title: Marcel Lucont: Les Enfants Terribles 2 – Another Gameshow For Awful Children (W.I.P)
shows.description: Marcel Lucont (Winner: Best Kids Show – UK Kids Comedy Festival) returns to test out a new set of games to reveal the true awful nature of children. “An absolute gem… If you don’t have kids, borrow someone else’s… a treat from beginning to end” ★★★★★ Edinburgh Festivals magazine. “An hour with something for everyone… the kids aren’t the only ones having a ball…. I can’t recommend this show more to kids and parents… insanely funny” ★★★★ The Scotsman. Top 10 Kids Shows of Edinburgh Fringe – Time Out, The Scotsman and Broadway World.

shows.title: Nate Kitch Replica: a work in progress
shows.description: Hi I’m Nate Kitch the basically awarding winning & most overrated comedian you’ve never heard of. People are trying to kill me these days & I guess you could say I’m building another show. (it’s 30th Sept as I wrote this & I’ve got loads of ideas so imagine what I’ll have by now*?! Please come love/hate it. “unique..pushing at the edges of what stand-up can be defined as” Chortle, “Masterclass..like jazz” ***** The Scotsman, Best Show nominee 2025 Comedian’s choice award, Next Up biggest award in comedy nominee 2025 etc. etc… “clearly a case of emperor’s new clothes” anon *present day

shows.title: The Elephant in the Room: An Improvised Comedy Show
shows.description: Leamprov will perform our ‘Elephant in the Room’ show, our quick-fire, family friendly improvised sketch show chock full of fast-paced performing and silly short comedy sketches. The Elephant in the Room is… we have no idea what the show will be about! We will be performing comedy sketches and theatre games crafted from suggestions from the audience and made up completely on the fly. In the style of such classics as “Whose line is it anyway?”, we’ll be bringing a whole heap of giggles, games and silliness.

shows.title: Urban & Turban Comedy Show
shows.description: Come n enjoy a line up of the best up n coming Black and Asian comedians at this year’s Leicester Comedy Festival. Hosted by award winning comedian Masai Graham. Joke of the Fringe Winner 2016, 2021 and 2022.

shows.title: Jonny Brook: This Isn’t The Life I Expected
shows.description: Jonny Brook……………. A boy, failing at being a man, failing to understand how to adapt to disabled life, now that he’s become a certified member of the PIP claiming world. Whether it’s, horrendous interactions with medical professionals, kind prostitutes, or his own family, there is hilarity to enjoy in Jonny’s failings in all these areas, and many many more………………………….

shows.title: Maxine Wade ‘A Bit Of Blue For The Dads’
shows.description: Maxine Wade (BBC New Comedy Award Regional Finalist, NHS nurse, and lover of dads) brings you a gloriously smutty hour of stand-up — flirty, filthy, and delivered with a wicked grin. A Bit Of Blue For The Dads does exactly what it says on the tin: cheeky jokes, strong opinions, and bedside manner with absolutely no boundaries. She’s here to raise pulses and lower standards. Don’t forget to take your blood pressure meds, lads. ‘Riotously funny’ Ed Fringe Review.

shows.title: Kathy Maniura: The Cycling Man
shows.description: Middle-aged & newly single, he’s spent the salary of an NHS nurse in Decathlon & he’s on the verge of a breakdown. Get to know this absurd & deeply flawed man as he gets to know himself. One of the ‘Best reviewed Edinburgh Fringe shows 2025’ – a Goofy drag king show from award-winning character comedian Kathy Maniura, BBC New Comedian shortlisted 2023 and Sketch “A Lycra clad masterclass in character comedy” ****The Skinny “Maniura’s show is, to put it simply, genius” ***** EdFringeReview “Maniura’s character work is pitch perfect” **** Fest 15 Best LGBTQ+ Shows at The Edinburgh Fringe 2025

shows.title: Melanie Bracewell: A Little Treat
shows.description: Bad day? Time for a little treat. Good day? I think that deserves a little treat. With the end of her twenties rapidly approaching, one of New Zealand’s most popular comics unpacks the last decade of her life. As seen on Taskmaster NZ, and after complete sell-out seasons at Edinburgh Fringe and Melbourne Festivals. Go on, you’ve earned it. ‘Prepare to be captivated’ ★★★★ Chortle ‘An expert in her craft’ ★★★★ Time Out ‘Fantastic’ ★★★★ One4Review

shows.title: 200 Puns In 1 Hour with Roger Swift
shows.description: The twice sold-out show returns. The comedic prop pun lunatic, Roger Swift shoots out his infamous 200 puns in one hour! So come and enjoy his trademark crazy homemade props, audio cues and PowerPoint slides. Expect corny jokes and silliness with no theme besides wordplay. Do not expect someone taking himself seriously with this 2026 Update! Dave’s Best Gag of the Edinburgh Fringe list 2016, 2023 and 2024. UK Pun Finalist 2016 & 2017

shows.title: Daman Bamrah: Work in Progress
shows.description: Recently named by Rolling Stone Magazine as ‘The Next Big Thing’ and having supported the likes of Mo Gilligan (Netflix) and Munya Chawawa (Taskmaster) catch Daman with his brand new work in progress show. AS SEEN ON: The Lateish Show with Mo Gilligan (C4), as well as the BBC New Comedy Awards (BBC)

shows.title: Ed Aczel: High Plains Drifter
shows.description: A show from and about actor/comedian and DIY enthusiast “Ed Aczel?” Aczel does his best, but it isn’t going to offer a solution to the unbearable lightness of being – as planned. Some stories, anecdotes and random thoughts – but who knows? “This is anti-comedy. And it is irresistibly funny” SCOTSMAN “Dead-pan dynamo and very funny.” ★★★★ MIRROR “Master of the genre.” ★★★★ Kate Copstick – SCOTSMAN “He could stand totally rigid, silent, unmoving, and still make an audience laugh.” ★★★★ EDINBURGH FESTIVALS MAGAZINE

shows.title: Matthew Highton: We Are Who We Pretend To Be
shows.description: I read that boobytrap spelt backwards is partyboob. If that doesn’t make you giggle, maybe this isn’t the show for you. Expect a silly hour to make you laugh, smile and possibly one of you poop yourself. Life affirming, stand-up storytelling with an abstract offbeat flavour. Positive nonsense for these bleak days. Don’t think about it, just book now. Be impulsive – you deserve it after the week you’ve had. “An enviably prolific comic.” British Comedy Guide “Wonderful.” The Guardian “Highton has the storytellers gift” Chortle

shows.title: 14/48 Takeover: Performance
shows.description: 4 brand new plays, written by young people, and brought to life by professional theatre makers for the UK Kids Comedy Festival! 14/48 Takeover gives young writers the chance to work with professional playwrights and theatre makers to produce four new plays, brought to life for family audiences. What have our young writers produced this time? Join us to see the results!

shows.title: Alasdair Beckett-King: King Of Crumbs
shows.description: ABK is the crumbliest comedian in the game: a multi-award-winning stand-up comic and (occasionally) an internet sensation. Come vagabonds, come mountebanks, come coney-catchers and cutpurses and meet the King of Crumbs! As seen on Mock the Week and 8 out of 10 Cats Does Countdown. ★★★★★ “AN ABSOLUTE TREASURE TROVE” Chortle “EITHER A GENIUS OR A VERY SILLY MAN” Rolling Stone

shows.title: Graeme Rayner: Dadology
shows.description: “Dadology” is Graeme Rayner’s debut 1 hour show, and includes everything they’re not telling you about being a dad. Graeme was a semi-finalist in the 2023 British Comedian of the Year competition and is , more importantly, a dad who has spent almost two decades navigating fatherhood with varying degrees of success. “Dadology” offers insight on everything from conception through to adulthood. “A Stand-Up Masterclass – This is stand-up with soul, and it deserves a national stage ” – Sussex News “The laughs come thick and fast” – Lancashire Post

shows.title: Laughter Loft Gong Show
shows.description: The award winning Laughter Loft brings you it’s hilarious Gong Show! 10 acts go up against each other to try and win the prize! If the audience aren’t impressed then they will be Gonged off! Who wins? You decide

shows.title: Ahir Shah: Tour Preview
shows.description: 2023 Sky Edinburgh Comedy Award winner for Best Show, Ahir Shah returns to the Leicester Comedy Festival with a preview ahead of a new international tour. It’s about love, money, family, responsibility, fear, forever, and frogs. Shah’s last show, Ends, toured the UK, Ireland, US, Australia, New Zealand and India, and is now available on Netflix. ★★★★★ Guardian ★★★★★ Chortle ★★★★★ Independent ★★★★★ Telegraph ★★★★★ Standard ★★★★★ Mail on Sunday

shows.title: Ted Milligan: UNITED
shows.description: Crubchester United Football Club are at rock bottom: relegated to non-league. Now, purchased by a 6 year old billionaire, can the club win promotion? Join award-winning character comedian Ted Milligan for this live mockumentary following Crubchester’s fervent fans, oligarch owners and pitiful players. “A masterclass in character comedy” ****** Broadway World. “Charming and very funny” **** ThreeWeeks “Ted Milligan is a Star” Rolling Stone Don’t miss your chance to see one of the best reviewed shows of the Edinburgh Fringe 2025 (British Comedy Guide)!

shows.title: Aalex Mandel-Dallal – Where was I?
shows.description: Funny Women 2025 Stage Award semi-finalist & Musical Comedy Awards 2026 semi-finalist, Aalex is overwhelmed and she’s not afraid to show it. In this work-in-progress show, she unpacks the elaborate (and often ridiculous) lengths she’s gone to in pursuit of clarity to find the real root cause of it all. Expect an abundance of misunderstandings, a rap about questionable life choices, and a whirlwind of overcomplications that somehow lands right here, the moment you’ve chosen (or not) to see her. ⭐⭐⭐⭐ “a charming humility that brings the audience together in laughter” – The Student

shows.title: Edy Hurst: Pick Up Thy Bow and Swim, Oh Mighty King of Ithica! (WIP)
shows.description: Set sail on the Odder-sea, as Edy Hurst (“Effortlessly Funny” ND Review) journeys out on a voyage across the ancient tale through the medium it was meant to be told – early 2000s electro-punk. Cyclops, Giants and Live looping Synth nonsense. As seen on Next Up Comedy, BBC Radio 4, BBC Manchester Nominated ‘Best Comedy Show’ Buxton Fringe 2025 & 2022 Nominated BBC New Comedy Award Nominated Best Alternative Act, NW Comedy Awards “Absolutely Non-Stop Bonkers” British Comedy Guide “A complete Hoot” The QR “Fringe Epic” Chortle

shows.title: Harri Dobbs: Escape North Wales!
shows.description: A comedy show where you die at the end! (Probably) After a not so successful night out in Cardiff, you fall asleep on what you think is the bus home. But when you wake up you are not home, you are somewhere unfamiliar, terrifying and altogether alien. NORTH WALES!! You have to find your friends, escape and most importantly, SURVIVE!! (Apologies to anyone from North Wales, I’ve never actually been) Let comedian, storyteller and possible control freak Harri Dobbs guide you through an adventure where the decisions are up to you, and most pathways end in your own death… in the game.

shows.title: Leicester Comedy Festival Closing Gala Show
shows.description: The Festival is almost over… sad face… Join us for a brilliant night to end the festival on a spectacular finale at Curve Studio. Hosted by the fabulous Kate Butch, with some of the best comedians on the circuit, including the winner of Leicester Comedian of the Year 2026. In aid of Big Difference Company Line up: Daman Bamrah, Katie Norris, Rob Copland, Anna Leong Brophy & Dan Tiernan

shows.title: The Bricklayers ‘Big Weekend’ Bingo Night
shows.description: As part of Leicester Comedy Festival’s ‘The Big Weekend’, we’re putting a playful spin on our monthly Bingo Night! Expect traditional bingo rules with a fun twist for those who want to get involved—alongside mini challenges, lots of laughs, and a mix of funny prizes and cash prizes up for grabs. Whether you’re a bingo regular or just in it for the comedy and chaos, it’s all about good vibes and a great Sunday night out. No booking required, just bring your sense of humour, dabbers if you’ve got them, and get ready for a brilliantly silly evening!

shows.title: Cracking Jokes at The Cradock
shows.description: Join us for an evening of the best of the Leicester Festival at your friendly local The Cradock Arms. Featuring a cracking line up of pro comedians storming it on the circuit, with your resident MC Kirsty Munro-Graham “Loveable, Loud and Bloody Hilarious!”. The Funny Firm.

shows.title: Madeleine Brettingham: Work-in-progress
shows.description: Madeleine Brettingham is a writer and rising star on the stand-up circuit, who’s recently scooped a string of competition wins including winning the prestigious So You Think You’re Funny 2025 and taking silver in Funny Women in the same year, a unique double. “A suffer-no-fools attitude that own the stage, a formidable gag rate and a precision with language that conjures up the perfect images” – Chortle.

shows.title: Paul Merton & Suki Webster’s Improv Show
shows.description: Following critically acclaimed seasons in London and Edinburgh, Paul Merton and Suki Webster, two of the UK’s leading improvisers, present an evening of wonderfully unscripted cutting-edge comedy. Expect a show full of fast, fabulously funny improvised games, scenes, stories and laugh out loud surrealism as these two masters of comedy improvisation join forces with their very special guests to create cascades of laughter and joyful silliness. “Some of the most experienced improvisers around…always impressive.” ***** British Theatre Guide

shows.title: Stephen Catling: Clownfish Out Of Water
shows.description: When clowns can’t breathe water and fish can’t breathe air- what’s a poor clownfish to do in this cruel world? In 2025, Catling (Malcolm Hardee Award Nominee 2023 & 2025) lost his slug mask. It was kinda essential part of his cult hit show ‘Moving on…really really slowly.’ This time, Stephen explores his life now that Autism has been “unmasked,” as well as his fin flapping rage against an increasingly soulless entertainment industry. “Fans of Harry Hill will appreciate the quickfire absurdity of the hour, cascading with daft jokes, preposterous props and manic sound effects. ” Chortle

shows.title: The Same Faces: Improvised Comedy
shows.description: Leicester’s own improv group, The Same Faces return for their eleventh year at Leicester Comedy Festival, with another round of improvised silliness. This short-form show will feature scenes, games, songs and one liners, all completely made up on the spot. Regulars Tom Young, Allan Smith, and Dave Gotheridge will be joined by some of their talented friends, in order to bring you some of the best improvisation in the midlands, if not the country! “An endless feast of brilliant improv.” A Small Mind at the Theatre “Short-form improv done the way it SHOULD be done.” Improv London

shows.title: Tom Short: Content until I’m famous
shows.description: Tom Short: Content Until I’m Famous Tom Short is trying to become famous—but not the old-fashioned way. He’s diving headfirst into the world of AI-generated content, viral algorithms, and digital chaos, where every post, clip, and meme is carefully engineered for clicks. In this live comedy show, Tom experiments with AI scripts, auto-generated jokes, and bizarre online trends, all while questioning who’s really in control: him—or the algorithm. Expect absurd stunts, awkward tech fails, and a hilarious look at our obsession with online validation.

shows.title: Jessica Fostekew: Iconic Breath
shows.description: A monster’s guide to tolerance and temperance. Jess can feel herself becoming an emotional wildebeest right when her world (and the whole world, thanks) demands cool, collected ultra detached saint-like kindness and understanding. S**t. She goes digging around in her DNA for answers and finds so many beautiful horrors. Witness her effort to become a brand new, mythical, mystical ‘coper.’ OR NOT. She gets cancelled, she gets touched and she gets a dolphin-based epiphany all in one show. The silliest of comedy for the scariest of days from Edinburgh Best Show Award Nominee.

shows.title: Aaaaaaaargh: its the One Liner Show
shows.description: Enjoy an hour of the best up-and-coming one-liner comedians on the circuit in this celebration of puns, one-liners and wordplay. Hosted by Joke of the Fringe winner 2016, 2021 and 2022, Masai Graham.

shows.title: Bruce Edhouse: Self Care Fun Fair
shows.description: What do you get when you cross a psychotherapist and an alternative comedian? You get Bruce Edhouse! (And DON’T cross him – he’ll work with you to resolve your issues, and then demand payment for it.) He’s here to give you a new perspective on self care, via jokes, songs, badly made props, and genuinely useful psychotherapeutic exercises. If all this sounds like some Patch Adams bullshit it’s not, it’s actually funny. “”Full of laid back, tender wit and charm”” – Leicester Mercury “”Laced with a wonderful absurdity” LeftLion All profits for this show will support The Big Difference Company.

shows.title: Muhsin Yesilada: Muhsin’s Best Best Show Ever
shows.description: Having opened for Mo Gilligan, Babatunde Aléshé, Guz Khan, Richard Blackwood, Tez Ilyas, and Kae Kurd. .Muhsin Yesilada is one of the UK’s fastest-rising comedy stars. With razor-sharp punchlines and hilarious insights into his Turkish Cypriot family, he’s back with his biggest, boldest and you guessed it.. best best show ever! ‘.. Entertaining stories with the poise of an experienced pro in command of the room and his material’ – Chortle
